1123.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1123.t: kaam karodh lobh moh bibarajit har padh cheen(h)ai soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1123.e: Ignoring sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, such a person becomes aware of the Lord's Feet. ||1||Pause||

1123.g: ਰਜ ਗੁਣ ਤਮ ਗੁਣ ਸਤ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1123.t: raj gun tam gun sat gun kaheeaai ieh teree sabh maiaa ||
1123.e: Raajas, the quality of energy and activity; Taamas, the quality of darkness and inertia; and Satvas, the quality of purity and light, are all called the creations of Maya, Your illusion.

1123.g: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1123.t: chauthe padh kau jo nar cheen(h)ai tin(h) hee param padh paiaa ||2||
1123.e: That man who realizes the fourth state - he alone obtains the supreme state. ||2||

1123.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਕਾਮਾ ॥
1123.t: teerath barat nem such sa(n)jam sadhaa rahai nihakaamaa ||
1123.e: Amidst pilgrimages, fasting, rituals, purification and self-discipline, he remains always without thought of reward.

1123.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
1123.t: tirasanaa ar maiaa bhram chookaa chitavat aatam raamaa ||3||
1123.e: Thirst and desire for Maya and doubt depart, remembering the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||3||

1123.g: ਜਿਹ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
1123.t: jeh ma(n)dhar dheepak paragaasiaa a(n)dhakaar teh naasaa ||
1123.e: When the temple is illuminated by the lamp, its darkness is dispelled.

1123.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
1123.t: nirabhau poor rahe bhram bhaagaa keh kabeer jan dhaasaa ||4||1||
1123.e: The Fearless Lord is All-pervading. Doubt has run away, says Kabeer, the Lord's humble slave. ||4||1||

1123.g: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਬਨਜਿਆ ਕਾਂਸੀ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਕਿਨਹੀ ਲਉਗ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ॥
1123.t: kinahee banajiaa kaa(n)see taa(n)baa kinahee laug supaaree ||
1123.e: Some deal in bronze and copper, some in cloves and betel nuts.

1123.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਬਨਜਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕਾ ਐਸੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
1123.t: sa(n)tahu banajiaa naam gobidh kaa aaisee khep hamaaree ||1||
1123.e: The Saints deal in the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. Such is my merchandise as well. ||1||

1123.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ॥
1123.t: har ke naam ke biaapaaree ||
1123.e: I am a trader in the Name of the Lord.

1123.g: ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1123.t: heeraa haath chaRiaa niramolak chhooT giee sa(n)saaree ||1|| rahaau ||
1123.e: The priceless diamond has come into my hands. I have left the world behind. ||1||Pause||

1123.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਏ ਤਉ ਸਚ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
1123.t: saache laae tau sach laage saache ke biauhaaree ||
1123.e: When the True Lord attached me, then I was attached to Truth. I am a trader of the True Lord.

1123.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਕੇ ਭਾਰ ਚਲਾਏ ਪਹੁਚੇ ਜਾਇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
1123.t: saachee basat ke bhaar chalaae pahuche jai bha(n)ddaaree ||2||
1123.e: I have loaded the commodity of Truth; It has reached the Lord, the Treasurer. ||2||

1123.g: ਆਪਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਆਪੈ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
1123.t: aapeh ratan javaahar maanik aapai hai paasaaree ||
1123.e: He Himself is the pearl, the jewel, the ruby; He Himself is the jeweller.

1123.g: ਆਪੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਆਪ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
1123.t: aapai dheh dhis aap chalaavai nihachal hai biaapaaree ||3||
1123.e: He Himself spreads out in the ten directions. The Merchant is Eternal and Unchanging. ||3||

1123.g: ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਲੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੈਡਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੋਨਿ ਭਰਿ ਡਾਰੀ ॥
1123.t: man kar bail surat kar paiddaa giaan gon bhar ddaaree ||
1123.e: My mind is the bull, and meditation is the road; I have filled my packs with spiritual wisdom, and loaded them on the bull.

1123.g: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
1123.t: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu nibahee khep hamaaree ||4||2||
1123.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: my merchandise has reached its destination! ||4||2||

1123.g: ਰੀ ਕਲਵਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਰਿ ਮੂਢ ਮਤਿ ਉਲਟੋ ਪਵਨੁ ਫਿਰਾਵਉ ॥
1123.t: ree kalavaar gavaar moodd mat ulaTo pavan firaavau ||
1123.e: You barbaric brute, with your primitive intellect - reverse your breath and turn it inward.

1123.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰ ਮੇਰ ਸਰ ਭਾਠੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
1123.t: man matavaar mer sar bhaaThee a(n)mirat dhaar chuaavau ||1||
1123.e: Let your mind be intoxicated with the stream of Ambrosial Nectar which trickles down from the furnace of the Tenth Gate. ||1||

1123.g: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਹਾਈ ॥
1123.t: bolahu bhieeaa raam kee dhuhaiee ||
1123.e: O Siblings of Destiny, call on the Lord.

1123.g: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਿਆਸ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1123.t: peevahu sa(n)t sadhaa mat dhuralabh sahaje piaas bujhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1123.e: O Saints, drink in this wine forever; it is so difficult to obtain, and it quenches your thirst so easily. ||1||Pause||

1123.g: ਭੈ ਬਿਚਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਾਇ ਕੋਊ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
1123.t: bhai bich bhaau bhai kouoo boojheh har ras paavai bhaiee ||
1123.e: In the Fear of God, is the Love of God. Only those few who understand His Love obtain the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

1123.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਈ ॥੨॥
1123.t: jete ghaT a(n)mrit sabh hee meh bhaavai tiseh peeaaiee ||2||
1123.e: As many hearts as there are - in all of them, is His Ambrosial Nectar; as He pleases, He causes them to drink it in. ||2||

1123.g: ਨਗਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
1123.t: nagaree ekai nau dharavaaje dhaavat baraj rahaiee ||
1123.e: There are nine gates to the one city of the body; restrain your mind from escaping through them.

1123.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਦਸਵਾ ਦਰੁ ਖੂਲੑੈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
1123.t: tirakuTee chhooTai dhasavaa dhar khool(h)ai taa man kheevaa bhaiee ||3||
1123.e: When the knot of the three qualities is untied, then the Tenth Gate opens up, and the mind is intoxicated, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

1123.g: ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਪੂਰਿ ਤਾਪ ਤਹ ਨਾਸੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
1123.t: abhai padh poor taap teh naase keh kabeer beechaaree ||
1123.e: When the mortal fully realizes the state of fearless dignity, then his sufferings vanish; so says Kabeer after careful deliberation.

1123.g: ਉਬਟ ਚਲੰਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੋਂਦ ਖੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
1123.t: aubaT chala(n)te ih madh paiaa jaise kho(n)dh khumaaree ||4||3||
1123.e: Turning away from the world, I have obtained this wine, and I am intoxicated with it. ||4||3||

1123.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
1123.t: kaam karodh tirasanaa ke leene gat nahee ekai jaanee ||
1123.e: You are engrossed with unsatisfied sexual desire and unresolved anger; you do not know the State of the One Lord.

1123.g: ਫੂਟੀ ਆਖੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਡਿ ਮੂਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
1123.t: fooTee aakhai kachhoo na soojhai boodd mooe bin paanee ||1||
1123.e: Your eyes are blinded, and you see nothing at all. You drown and die without water. ||1||

1124.g: ਚਲਤ ਕਤ ਟੇਢੇ ਟੇਢੇ ਟੇਢੇ ॥
1124.t: chalat kat Tedde Tedde Tedde ||
1124.e: Why do you walk in that crooked, zig-zag way?

1124.g: ਅਸਤਿ ਚਰਮ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਮੂੰਦੇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਬੇਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1124.t: asat charam bisaTaa ke moo(n)dhe dhuraga(n)dh hee ke bedde ||1|| rahaau ||
1124.e: You are nothing more than a bundle of bones, wrapped in skin, filled with manure; you give off such a rotten smell! ||1||Pause||

1124.g: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
1124.t: raam na japahu kavan bhram bhoole tum te kaal na dhoore ||
1124.e: You do not meditate on the Lord. What doubts have confused and deluded you? Death is not far away from you!

1124.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
1124.t: anik jatan kar ih tan raakhahu rahai avasathaa poore ||2||
1124.e: Making all sorts of efforts, you manage to preserve this body, but it shall only survive until its time is up. ||2||

1124.g: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
1124.t: aapan keeaa kachhoo na hovai kiaa ko karai paraanee ||
1124.e: By one's own efforts, nothing is done. What can the mere mortal accomplish?

1124.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
1124.t: jaa tis bhaavai satigur bheTai eko naam bakhaanee ||3||
1124.e: When it pleases the Lord, the mortal meets the True Guru, and chants the Name of the One Lord. ||3||

1124.g: ਬਲੂਆ ਕੇ ਘਰੂਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਫੁਲਵਤ ਦੇਹ ਅਇਆਨੇ ॥
1124.t: balooaa ke gharooaa meh basate fulavat dheh iaane ||
1124.e: You live in a house of sand, but you still puff up your body - you ignorant fool!

1124.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਹ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਬੂਡੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਨੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
1124.t: kahu kabeer jeh raam na chetio boodde bahut siaane ||4||4||
1124.e: Says Kabeer, those who do not remember the Lord may be very clever, but they still drown. ||4||4||

1124.g: ਟੇਢੀ ਪਾਗ ਟੇਢੇ ਚਲੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਬੀਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥
1124.t: Teddee paag Tedde chale laage beere khaan ||
1124.e: Your turban is crooked, and you walk crooked; and now you have started chewing betel leaves.

1124.g: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਾਮੁ ਦੀਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
1124.t: bhaau bhagat siau kaaj na kachhooaai mero kaam dheevaan ||1||
1124.e: You have no use at all for loving devotional worship; you say you have business in court. ||1||

1124.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ॥
1124.t: raam bisaario hai abhimaan ||
1124.e: In your egotistical pride, you have forgotten the Lord.

1124.g: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1124.t: kanik kaamanee mahaa su(n)dharee pekh pekh sach maan ||1|| rahaau ||
1124.e: Gazing upon your gold, and your very beautiful wife, you believe that they are permanent. ||1||Pause||

1124.g: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਨਿ ॥
1124.t: laalach jhooTh bikaar mahaa madh ieh bidh aaudh bihaan ||
1124.e: You are engrossed in greed, falsehood, corruption and great arrogance. Your life is passing away.

1124.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਰ ਆਇ ਲਾਗੋ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੨॥੫॥
1124.t: keh kabeer a(n)t kee ber aai laago kaal nidhaan ||2||5||
1124.e: Says Kabeer, at the very last moment, death will come and seize you, you fool! ||2||5||

1124.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਅਪਨੀ ਨਉਬਤਿ ਚਲੇ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
1124.t: chaar dhin apanee naubat chale bajai ||
1124.e: The mortal beats the drum for a few days, and then he must depart.

1124.g: ਇਤਨਕੁ ਖਟੀਆ ਗਠੀਆ ਮਟੀਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1124.t: eitanak khaTeeaa gaTheeaa maTeeaa sa(n)g na kachh lai jai ||1|| rahaau ||
1124.e: With so much wealth and cash and buried treasure, still, he cannot take anything with him. ||1||Pause||

1124.g: ਦਿਹਰੀ ਬੈਠੀ ਮਿਹਰੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਲਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
1124.t: dhiharee baiThee miharee rovai dhuaarai lau sa(n)g mai ||
1124.e: Sitting on the threshhold, his wife weeps and wails; his mother accompanies him to the outer gate.

1124.g: ਮਰਹਟ ਲਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
1124.t: marahaT lag sabh log kuTa(n)b mil ha(n)s ikelaa jai ||1||
1124.e: All the people and relatives together go to the crematorium, but the swan-soul must go home all alone. ||1||

1124.g: ਵੈ ਸੁਤ ਵੈ ਬਿਤ ਵੈ ਪੁਰ ਪਾਟਨ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਇ ॥
1124.t: vai sut vai bit vai pur paaTan bahur na dhekhai aai ||
1124.e: Those children, that wealth, that city and town - he shall not come to see them again.

1124.g: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥੬॥
1124.t: kahat kabeer raam kee na simarahu janam akaarath jai ||2||6||
1124.e: Says Kabeer, why do you not meditate on the Lord? Your life is uselessly slipping away! ||2||6||

1124.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
1124.t: raag kedhaaraa baanee ravidhaas jeeau kee
1124.e: Raag Kaydaaraa, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

1124.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1124.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1124.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1124.g: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੁਲ ਸੰਜੁਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1124.t: khaT karam kul sa(n)jugat hai har bhagat hiradhai naeh ||
1124.e: One who performs the six religious rituals and comes from a good family, but who does not have devotion to the Lord in his heart,

1124.g: ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਕਥਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਪਚ ਤੁਲਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
1124.t: charanaarabi(n)dh na kathaa bhaavai supach tul samaan ||1||
1124.e: one who does not appreciate talk of the Lord's Lotus Feet, is just like an outcaste, a pariah. ||1||

1124.g: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਚੇਤ ਅਚੇਤ ॥
1124.t: re chit chet chet achet ||
1124.e: Be conscious, be conscious, be conscious, O my unconscious mind.

1124.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਬਾਲਮੀਕਹਿ ਦੇਖ ॥
1124.t: kaahe na baalameekeh dhekh ||
1124.e: Why do you not look at Baalmeek?

1124.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਤੇ ਕਿਹ ਪਦਹਿ ਅਮਰਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਸੇਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1124.t: kis jaat te keh padheh amario raam bhagat bisekh ||1|| rahaau ||
1124.e: From such a low social status, what a high status he obtained! Devotional worship to the Lord is sublime! ||1||Pause||

1124.g: ਸੁਆਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਜਾਤੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿ੍ਰਸ੍ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
1124.t: suaan satr ajaat sabh te kirarasan laavai het ||
1124.e: The killer of dogs, the lowest of all, was lovingly embraced by Krishna.

1124.g: ਲੋਗੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਰਾਹੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ॥੨॥
1124.t: log bapuraa kiaa saraahai teen lok praves ||2||
1124.e: See how the poor people praise him! His praise extends throughout the three worlds. ||2||

1124.g: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਲੁਭਤੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਗਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
1124.t: ajaamal pi(n)gulaa lubhat ku(n)char ge har kai paas ||
1124.e: Ajaamal, Pingulaa, Lodhia and the elephant went to the Lord.

1124.g: ਐਸੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਤਰਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ॥੩॥੧॥
1124.t: aaise dhuramat nisatare too kiau na tareh ravidhaas ||3||1||
1124.e: Even such evil-minded beings were emancipated. Why should you not also be saved, O Ravi Daas? ||3||1||

1125.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
1125.t: raag bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
1125.e: Raag Bhairao, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

1125.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1125.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
1125.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

1125.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
1125.t: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hoi ||
1125.e: Without You, nothing happens.

1125.g: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
1125.t: too kar kar dhekheh jaaneh soi ||1||
1125.e: You create the creatures, and gazing on them, you know them. ||1||

1125.g: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1125.t: kiaa kaheeaai kichh kahee na jai ||
1125.e: What can I say? I cannot say anything.

1125.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਹੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1125.t: jo kichh ahai sabh teree rajai ||1|| rahaau ||
1125.e: Whatever exists, is by Your Will. ||Pause||

1125.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
1125.t: jo kichh karanaa su terai paas ||
1125.e: Whatever is to be done, rests with You.

1125.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
1125.t: kis aagai keechai aradhaas ||2||
1125.e: Unto whom should I offer my prayer? ||2||

1125.g: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1125.t: aakhan sunanaa teree baanee ||
1125.e: I speak and hear the Bani of Your Word.

1125.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
1125.t: too aape jaaneh sarab viddaanee ||3||
1125.e: You Yourself know all Your Wondrous Play. ||3||

1125.g: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
1125.t: kare karaae jaanai aap ||
1125.e: You Yourself act, and inspire all to act; only You Yourself know.

1125.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
1125.t: naanak dhekhai thaap uthaap ||4||1||
1125.e: Says Nanak, You, Lord, see, establish and disestablish. ||4||1||

1125.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1125.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1125.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1125.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
1125.t: raag bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa ||
1125.e: Raag Bhairao, First Mehla, Second House:

1125.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
1125.t: gur kai sabadh tare mun kete i(n)dhraadhik brahamaadh tare ||
1125.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, so many silent sages have been saved; Indra and Brahma have also been saved.

1125.g: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਤਪਸੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥
1125.t: sanak sana(n)dhan tapasee jan kete gur parasaadhee paar pare ||1||
1125.e: Sanak, Sanandan and many humble men of austerity, by Guru's Grace, have been carried across to the other side. ||1||

1125.g: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
1125.t: bhavajal bin sabadhai kiau tareeaai ||
1125.e: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

1125.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਰੋਗਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੁਬਿ ਡੁਬਿ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1125.t: naam binaa jag rog biaapiaa dhubidhaa ddub ddub mareeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
1125.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is entangled in the disease of duality, and is drowned, drowned, and dies. ||1||Pause||

1125.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
1125.t: gur dhevaa gur alakh abhevaa tirabhavan sojhee gur kee sevaa ||
1125.e: The Guru is Divine; the Guru is Inscrutable and Mysterious. Serving the Guru, the three worlds are known and understood.

1125.g: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੨॥
1125.t: aape dhaat karee gur dhaatai paiaa alakh abhevaa ||2||
1125.e: The Guru, the Giver, has Himself given me the Gift; I have obtained the Inscrutable, Mysterious Lord. ||2||

1125.g: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
1125.t: man raajaa man man te maaniaa manasaa maneh samaiee ||
1125.e: The mind is the king; the mind is appeased and satisfied through the mind itself, and desire is stilled in the mind.

1125.g: ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਓਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੩॥
1125.t: man jogee man binas biogee man samajhai gun gaiee ||3||
1125.e: The mind is the Yogi, the mind wastes away in separation from the Lord; singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the mind is instructed and reformed. ||3||

1125.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
1125.t: gur te man maariaa sabadh veechaariaa te virale sa(n)saaraa ||
1125.e: How very rare are those in this world who, through the Guru, subdue their minds, and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

1125.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
1125.t: naanak saahib bharipur leenaa saach sabadh nisataaraa ||4||1||2||
1125.e: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is All-pervading; through the True Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated. ||4||1||2||

1125.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1125.t: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
1125.e: Bhairao, First Mehla:

1125.g: ਨੈਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੀਨਾ ਜਰਿ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੋ ॥
1125.t: nainee dhirasaT nahee tan heenaa jar jeetiaa sir kaalo ||
1125.e: The eyes lose their sight, and the body withers away; old age overtakes the mortal, and death hangs over his head.

1125.g: ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਛੋਡੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੋ ॥੧॥
1125.t: roop ra(n)g rahas nahee saachaa kiau chhoddai jam jaalo ||1||
1125.e: Beauty, loving attachment and the pleasures of life are not permanent. How can anyone escape from the noose of death? ||1||

1125.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
1125.t: praanee har jap janam gio ||
1125.e: O mortal, meditate on the Lord - your life is passing away!

1126.g: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1126.t: saach sabadh bin kabahu na chhooTas birathaa janam bhio ||1|| rahaau ||
1126.e: Without the True Word of the Shabad, you shall never be released, and your life shall be totally useless. ||1||Pause||

1126.g: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਹਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਠਿਨ ਪੀਰ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
1126.t: tan meh kaam karodh hau mamataa kaThin peer at bhaaree ||
1126.e: Within the body are sexual desire, anger, egotism and attachment. This pain is so great, and so difficult to endure.

1126.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
1126.t: gurmukh raam japahu ras rasanaa in bidh tar too taaree ||2||
1126.e: As Gurmukh, chant the Lord's Name, and savor it with your tongue; in this way, you shall cross over to the other side. ||2||

1126.g: ਬਹਰੇ ਕਰਨ ਅਕਲਿ ਭਈ ਹੋਛੀ ਸਬਦ ਸਹਜੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
1126.t: bahare karan akal bhiee hochhee sabadh sahaj nahee boojhiaa ||
1126.e: Your ears are deaf, and your intellect is worthless, and still, you do not intuitively understand the Word of the Shabad.

1126.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੩॥
1126.t: janam padhaarath manmukh haariaa bin gur a(n)dh na soojhiaa ||3||
1126.e: The self-willed manmukh wastes this priceless human life and loses it. Without the Guru, the blind person cannot see. ||3||

1126.g: ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
1126.t: rahai udhaas aas niraasaa sahaj dhiaan bairaagee ||
1126.e: Whoever remains detached and free of desire in the midst of desire - and whoever, unattached, intuitively meditates on the Celestial Lord

1126.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
1126.t: pranavat naanak gurmukh chhooTas raam naam liv laagee ||4||2||3||
1126.e: - prays Nanak, as Gurmukh, he is released. He is lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||||2||3||

1126.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1126.t: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
1126.e: Bhairao, First Mehla:

1126.g: ਭੂੰਡੀ ਚਾਲ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਖਿਸਰੇ ਤੁਚਾ ਦੇਹ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥
1126.t: bhoo(n)ddee chaal charan kar khisare tuchaa dheh kumalaanee ||
1126.e: His walk becomes weak and clumsy, his feet and hands shake, and the skin of his body is withered and wrinkled.

1126.g: ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਧੁੰਧਿ ਕਰਨ ਭਏ ਬਹਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
1126.t: netree dhu(n)dh karan bhe bahare manmukh naam na jaanee ||1||
1126.e: His eyes are dim, his ears are deaf, and yet, the self-willed manmukh does not know the Naam. ||1||

1126.g: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਆਇ ॥
1126.t: a(n)dhule kiaa paiaa jag aai ||
1126.e: O blind man, what have you obtained by coming into the world?

1126.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1126.t: raam ridhai nahee gur kee sevaa chaale mool gavai ||1|| rahaau ||
1126.e: The Lord is not in your heart, and you do not serve the Guru. After wasting your capital, you shall have to depart. ||1||Pause||

1126.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਬ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਬ ਫੀਕੇ ॥
1126.t: jihavaa ra(n)g nahee har raatee jab bolai tab feeke ||
1126.e: Your tongue is not imbued with the Love of the Lord; whatever you say is tasteless and insipid.

1126.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪਸਿ ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਨੀਕੇ ॥੨॥
1126.t: sa(n)t janaa kee ni(n)dhaa viaapas pasoo bhe kadhe hoh na neeke ||2||
1126.e: You indulge in slander of the Saints; becoming a beast, you shall never be noble. ||2||

1126.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
1126.t: a(n)mirat kaa ras viralee paiaa satigur mel milaae ||
1126.e: Only a few obtain the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Amrit, united in Union with the True Guru.

1126.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥੩॥
1126.t: jab lag sabadh bhedh nahee aaiaa tab lag kaal sa(n)taae ||3||
1126.e: As long as the mortal does not come to understand the mystery of the Shabad, the Word of God, he shall continue to be tormented by death. ||3||

1126.g: ਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਏਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
1126.t: an ko dhar ghar kabahoo na jaanas eko dhar sachiaaraa ||
1126.e: Whoever finds the door of the One True Lord, does not know any other house or door.

1126.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
1126.t: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa naanak kahai vichaaraa ||4||3||4||
1126.e: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status; so says poor Nanak. ||4||3||4||

1126.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1126.t: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
1126.e: Bhairao, First Mehla:

1126.g: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
1126.t: sagalee rain sovat gal faahee dhinas ja(n)jaal gavaiaa ||
1126.e: He spends the entire night in sleep; the noose is tied around his neck. His day is wasted in worldly entanglements.

1126.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1126.t: khin pal ghaRee nahee prabh jaaniaa jin ih jagat upaiaa ||1||
1126.e: He does not know God, who created this world, for a moment, for even an instant. ||1||

1126.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
1126.t: man re kiau chhooTas dhukh bhaaree ||
1126.e: O mortal, how will you escape this terrible disaster?

1126.g: ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਆਵਸਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਵਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1126.t: kiaa le aavas kiaa le jaavas raam japahu gunakaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
1126.e: What did you bring with you, and what will you take away? Meditate on the Lord, the Most Worthy and Generous Lord. ||1||Pause||

1126.g: ਊਂਧਉ ਕਵਲੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
1126.t: uoo(n)dhau kaval manmukh mat hochhee man a(n)dhai sir dha(n)dhaa ||
1126.e: The heart-lotus of the self-willed manmukh is upside-down; his intellect is shallow; his mind is blind, and his head is entangled in worldly affairs.

1126.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗਲਿ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
1126.t: kaal bikaal sadhaa sir terai bin naavai gal fa(n)dhaa ||2||
1126.e: Death and re-birth constantly hang over your head; without the Name, your neck shall be caught in the noose. ||2||

1126.g: ਡਗਰੀ ਚਾਲ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਫੁਨਿ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
1126.t: ddagaree chaal netr fun a(n)dhule sabadh surat nahee bhaiee ||
1126.e: Your steps are unsteady, and your eyes are blind; you are not aware of the Word of the Shabad, O Sibling of Destiny.

1126.g: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧੁਲਉ ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
1126.t: saasatr bedh trai gun hai maiaa a(n)dhulau dha(n)dh kamaiee ||3||
1126.e: The Shaastras and the Vedas keep the mortal bound to the three modes of Maya, and so he performs his deeds blindly. ||3||

1126.g: ਖੋਇਓ ਮੂਲੁ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਹ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ॥
1126.t: khoio mool laabh keh paavas dhuramat giaan vihoone ||
1126.e: He loses his capital - how can he earn any profit? The evil-minded person has no spiritual wisdom at all.

1126.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
1126.t: sabadh beechaar raam ras chaakhiaa naanak saach pateene ||4||4||5||
1126.e: Contemplating the Shabad, he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; O Nanak, his faith is confirmed in the Truth. ||4||4||5||

1126.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1126.t: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
1126.e: Bhairao, First Mehla:

1126.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
1126.t: gur kai sa(n)g rahai dhin raatee raam rasan ra(n)g raataa ||
1126.e: He remains with the Guru, day and night, and his tongue savors the savory taste of the Lord's Love.

1126.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਸਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
1126.t: avar na jaanas sabadh pachhaanas a(n)tar jaan pachhaataa ||1||
1126.e: He does not know any other; he realizes the Word of the Shabad. He knows and realizes the Lord deep within his own being. ||1||

1126.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1126.t: so jan aaisaa mai man bhaavai ||
1126.e: Such a humble person is pleasing to my mind.

1126.g: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1126.t: aap maar apara(n)par raataa gur kee kaar kamaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
1126.e: He conquers his self-conceit, and is imbued with the Infinite Lord. He serves the Guru. ||1||Pause||

1126.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੋ ॥
1126.t: a(n)tar baahar purakh nira(n)jan aadh purakh aadheso ||
1126.e: Deep within my being, and outside as well, is the Immaculate Lord God. I bow humbly before that Primal Lord God.

1126.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸੋ ॥੨॥
1126.t: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa sach veso ||2||
1126.e: Deep within each and every heart, and amidst all, the Embodiment of Truth is permeating and pervading. ||2||

1127.g: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਈ ॥
1127.t: saach rate sach a(n)mrit jihavaa mithiaa mail na raiee ||
1127.e: Those who are imbued with Truth - their tongues are tinged with Truth; they do not have even an iota of the filth of falsehood.

1127.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
1127.t: niramal naam a(n)mirat ras chaakhiaa sabadh rate pat paiee ||3||
1127.e: They taste the sweet Ambrosial Nectar of the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; imbued with the Shabad, they are blessed with honor. ||3||

1127.g: ਗੁਣੀ ਗੁਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
1127.t: gunee gunee mil laahaa paavas gurmukh naam vaddaiee ||
1127.e: The virtuous meet with the virtuous, and earn the profit; as Gurmukh, they obtain the glorious greatness of the Naam.

1127.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
1127.t: sagale dhookh miTeh gur sevaa naanak naam sakhaiee ||4||5||6||
1127.e: All sorrows are erased, by serving the Guru; O Nanak, the Naam is our only Friend and Companion. ||4||5||6||

1127.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1127.t: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
1127.e: Bhairao, First Mehla:

1127.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਰਬ ਧਨੁ ਧਾਰਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
1127.t: hiradhai naam sarab dhan dhaaran gur parasaadhee paieeaai ||
1127.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the wealth and support of all; It is enshrined in the heart, by Guru's Grace.

1127.g: ਅਮਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਤੇ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
1127.t: amar padhaarath te kirataarath sahaj dhiaan liv laieeaai ||1||
1127.e: One who gathers this imperishable wealth is fulfilled, and through intuitive meditation, is lovingly focused on the Lord. ||1||

1127.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
1127.t: man re raam bhagat chit laieeaai ||
1127.e: O mortal, focus your consciousness on devotional worship of the Lord.

1127.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1127.t: gurmukh raam naam jap hiradhai sahaj setee ghar jaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
1127.e: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name of the Lord in your heart, and you shall return to your home with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

1127.g: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
1127.t: bharam bhedh bhau kabahu na chhooTas aavat jaat na jaanee ||
1127.e: Doubt, separation and fear are never eradicated, and the mortal continues coming and going in reincarnation, as long as he does not know the Lord.

1127.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
1127.t: bin har naam ko mukat na paavas ddoob mue bin paanee ||2||
1127.e: Without the Name of the Lord, no one is liberated; they drown and die without water. ||2||

1127.g: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਸਗਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵਸਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਸਿ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
1127.t: dha(n)dhaa karat sagalee pat khovas bharam na miTas gavaaraa ||
1127.e: Busy with his worldly affairs, all honor is lost; the ignorant one is not rid of his doubts.

1127.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
1127.t: bin gur sabadh mukat nahee kab hee a(n)dhule dha(n)dh pasaaraa ||3||
1127.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mortal is never liberated; he remains blindly entangled in the expanse of worldly affairs. ||3||

1127.g: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮੂਆ ॥
1127.t: akul nira(n)jan siau man maaniaa man hee te man mooaa ||
1127.e: My mind is pleased and appeased with the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. Through the mind itself, the mind is subdued.

1127.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥
1127.t: a(n)tar baahar eko jaaniaa naanak avar na dhooaa ||4||6||7||
1127.e: Deep within my being, and outside as well, I know only the One Lord. O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||4||6||7||

1127.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1127.t: bhairau mahalaa pehilaa ||
1127.e: Bhairao, First Mehla:

1127.g: ਜਗਨ ਹੋਮ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖੀ ਨਿਤ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੈ ॥
1127.t: jagan hom pu(n)n tap poojaa dheh dhukhee nit dhookh sahai ||
1127.e: You may give feasts, make burnt offerings, donate to charity, perform austere penance and worship, and endure pain and suffering in the body.

1127.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
1127.t: raam naam bin mukat na paavas mukat naam gurmukh lahai ||1||
1127.e: But without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained. As Gurmukh, obtain the Naam and liberation. ||1||

1127.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਗਿ ਜਨਮਾ ॥
1127.t: raam naam bin birathe jag janamaa ||
1127.e: Without the Lord's Name, birth into the world is useless.

1127.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਲੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਮਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1127.t: bikh khaavai bikh bolee bolai bin naavai nihafal mar bhramanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1127.e: Without the Name, the mortal eats poison and speaks poisonous words; he dies fruitlessly, and wanders in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

1127.g: ਪੁਸਤਕ ਪਾਠ ਬਿਆਕਰਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਤਿਕਾਲ ਕਰੈ ॥
1127.t: pusatak paaTh biaakaran vakhaanai sa(n)dhiaa karam tikaal karai ||
1127.e: The mortal may read scriptures, study grammar and say his prayers three times a day.

1127.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਰਝਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੨॥
1127.t: bin gur sabadh mukat kahaa praanee raam naam bin urajh marai ||2||
1127.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, where is liberation, O mortal? Without the Lord's Name, the mortal is entangled and dies. ||2||

1127.g: ਡੰਡ ਕਮੰਡਲ ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
1127.t: dda(n)dd kama(n)ddal sikhaa soot dhotee teerath gavan at bhraman karai ||
1127.e: Walking sticks, begging bowls, hair tufts, sacred threads, loin cloths, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and wandering all around

1127.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੩॥
1127.t: raam naam bin saa(n)t na aavai jap har har naamu su paar parai ||3||
1127.e: - without the Lord's Name, peace and tranquility are not obtained. One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, crosses over to the other side. ||3||

1127.g: ਜਟਾ ਮੁਕਟੁ ਤਨਿ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਈ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
1127.t: jaTaa mukaT tan bhasam lagaiee basatr chhodd tan nagan bhiaa ||
1127.e: The mortal's hair may be matted and tangled upon his head, and he may smear his body with ashes; he may take off his clothes and go naked.

1127.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਰਤ ਕੈ ਬਾਂਧੈ ਭੇਖੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੪॥
1127.t: raam naam bin tirapat na aavai kirat kai baa(n)dhai bhekh bhiaa ||4||
1127.e: But without the Lord's Name, he is not satisfied; he wears religious robes, but he is bound by the karma of the actions he committed in past lives. ||4||

1127.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤ੍ਰ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥
1127.t: jete jeea ja(n)t jal thal maheeal jatr katr too sarab jeeaa ||
1127.e: As many beings and creatures as there are in the water, on the land and in the sky - wherever they are, You are with them all, O Lord.

1127.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਝੋਲਿ ਪੀਆ ॥੫॥੭॥੮॥
1127.t: gur parasaadh raakh le jan kau har ras naanak jhol peeaa ||5||7||8||
1127.e: By Guru's Grace, please preserve Your humble servant; O Lord, Nanak stirs up this juice, and drinks it in. ||5||7||8||

1127.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
1127.t: raag bhairau mahalaa teejaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
1127.e: Raag Bhairao, Third Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

1127.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1127.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1127.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1127.g: ਜਾਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
1127.t: jaat kaa garab na kareeahu koiee ||
1127.e: No one should be proud of his social class and status.

1127.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
1127.t: braham bi(n)dhe so braahaman hoiee ||1||
1127.e: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows God. ||1||

1127.g: ਜਾਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
1127.t: jaat kaa garab na kar moorakh gavaaraa ||
1127.e: Do not be proud of your social class and status, you ignorant fool!

1128.g: ਇਸੁ ਗਰਬ ਤੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1128.t: eis garab te chaleh bahut vikaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
1128.e: So much sin and corruption comes from this pride. ||1||Pause||
Everyone says that there are four castes, four social classes.

1128.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
1128.t: braham bi(n)dh te sabh opat hoiee ||2||
1128.e: They all emanate from the drop of God's Seed. ||2||
The entire universe is made of the same clay.
The Potter has shaped it into all sorts of vessels. ||3||

1128.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
1128.t: pa(n)ch tat mil dhehee kaa aakaaraa ||
1128.e: The five elements join together, to make up the form of the human body.
Who can say which is less, and which is more? ||4||

1128.g: ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਮ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
1128.t: kahat naanak ih jeeau karam ba(n)dh hoiee ||
1128.e: Says Nanak, this soul is bound by its actions.

1128.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੧॥
1128.t: bin satigur bheTe mukat na hoiee ||5||1||
1128.e: Without meeting the True Guru, it is not liberated. ||5||1||
Bhairao, Third Mehla:
The Yogis, the householders, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the beggars in religious robes
- they are all asleep in egotism. ||1||
They are asleep, intoxicated with the wine of Maya.

1128.g: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮੂਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1128.t: jaagat rahai na moosai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
1128.e: Only those who remain awake and aware are not robbed. ||1||Pause||
One who has met the True Guru, remains awake and aware.
Such a person overpowers the five thieves. ||2||
One who contemplates the essence of reality remains awake and aware.
He kills his self-conceit, and does not kill anyone else. ||3||
One who knows the One Lord remains awake and aware.
He abandons the service of others, and realizes the essence of reality. ||4||
Of the four castes, whoever remains awake and aware
is released from birth and death. ||5||
Says Nanak, that humble being remains awake and aware,

1128.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥੨॥
1128.t: giaan a(n)jan jaa kee netree hoi ||6||2||
1128.e: who applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom to his eyes. ||6||2||
Bhairao, Third Mehla:
Whoever the Lord keeps in His Sanctuary,
is attached to the Truth, and receives the fruit of Truth. ||1||

1128.g: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
1128.t: re jan kai siau karahu pukaaraa ||
1128.e: O mortal, unto whom will you complain?
The Hukam of the Lord's Command is pervasive; by the Hukam of His Command, all things happen. ||1||Pause||
This Creation was established by You.

1128.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
1128.t: khin meh binasai karat na laagai baaraa ||2||
1128.e: In an instant You destroy it, and You create it again without a moment's delay. ||2||
By His Grace, He has staged this Play.

1128.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1128.t: gur kirapaa te param padh paiaa ||3||
1128.e: By the Guru's Merciful Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. ||3||
Says Nanak, He alone kills and revives.

1128.g: ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
1128.t: aaisaa boojhahu bharam na bhoolahu koi ||4||3||
1128.e: Understand this well - do not be confused by doubt. ||4||3||
Bhairao, Third Mehla:
I am the bride; the Creator is my Husband Lord.
As He inspires me, I adorn myself. ||1||

1128.g: ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਕਰੇ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
1128.t: jaa(n) tis bhaavai taa(n) kare bhog ||
1128.e: When it pleases Him, He enjoys me.

1128.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1128.t: tan man saache saahib jog ||1|| rahaau ||
1128.e: I am joined, body and mind, to my True Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
How can anyone praise or slander anyone else?
The One Lord Himself is pervading and permeating all. ||2||
By Guru's Grace, I am attracted by His Love.
I shall meet with my Merciful Lord, and vibrate the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds. ||3||
Prays Nanak, what can anyone do?
He alone meets with the Lord, whom the Lord Himself meets. ||4||4||
Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1128.g: ਸੋ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
1128.t: so mun j man kee dhubidhaa maare ||
1128.e: He alone is a silent sage, who subdues his mind's duality.
Subduing his duality, he contemplates God. ||1||

1128.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
1128.t: eis man kau koiee khojahu bhaiee ||
1128.e: Let each person examine his own mind, O Siblings of Destiny.

1128.g: ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1128.t: man khojat naam nau nidh paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1128.e: Examine your mind, and you shall obtain the nine treasures of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

1128.g: ਮੂਲੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
1128.t: mool moh kar karatai jagat upaiaa ||
1128.e: The Creator created the world, upon the foundation of worldly love and attachment.
Attaching it to possessiveness, He has led it into confusion with doubt. ||2||

1128.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਪਿੰਡ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥
1128.t: eis man te sabh pi(n)dd paraanaa ||
1128.e: From this Mind come all bodies, and the breath of life.

1128.g: ਮਨ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
1128.t: man kai veechaar hukam bujh samaanaa ||3||
1128.e: By mental contemplation, the mortal realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merges in Him. ||3||

1129.e: When the mortal has good karma, the Guru grants His Grace.

1129.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਰੈ ॥੪॥
1129.t: eih man jaagai is man kee dhubidhaa marai ||4||
1129.e: Then this mind is awakened, and the duality of this mind is subdued. ||4||
It is the innate nature of the mind to remain forever detached.
The Detached, Dispassionate Lord dwells within all. ||5||
Says Nanak, one who understands this mystery,
becomes the embodiment of the Primal, Immaculate, Divine Lord God. ||6||5||
Bhairao, Third Mehla:
The world is saved through Name of the Lord.
It carries the mortal across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||
By Guru's Grace, dwell upon the Lord's Name.

1129.g: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1129.t: sadh hee nibahai terai naal ||1|| rahaau ||
1129.e: It shall stand by you forever. ||1||Pause||
The foolish self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Without the Name, how will they cross over? ||2||
The Lord, the Great Giver, Himself gives His Gifts.
Celebrate and praise the Great Giver! ||3||
Granting His Grace, the Lord unites the mortals with the True Guru.
O Nanak, the Naam is enshrined within the heart. ||4||6||
Bhairao, Third Mehla:
All people are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Those who become Gurmukh are blessed to receive It. ||1||
When the Dear Lord showers His Mercy,
He blesses the Gurmukh with the glorious greatness of the Naam. ||1||Pause||
Those who love the Beloved Name of the Lord
save themselves, and save all their ancestors. ||2||

1129.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
1129.t: bin naavai manmukh jam pur jaeh ||
1129.e: Without the Name, the self-willed manmukhs go to the City of Death.
They suffer in pain and endure beatings. ||3||
When the Creator Himself gives,
O Nanak, then the mortals receive the Naam. ||4||7||
Bhairao, Third Mehla:
Love of the Lord of the Universe saved Sanak and his brother, the sons of Brahma.
They contemplated the Word of the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord. ||1||
O Dear Lord, please shower me with Your Mercy,
that as Gurmukh, I may embrace love for Your Name. ||1||Pause||
Whoever has true loving devotional worship deep within his being
meets the Lord, through the Perfect Guru. ||2||
He naturally, intuitively dwells within the home of his own inner being.
The Naam abides within the mind of the Gurmukh. ||3||
The Lord, the Seer, Himself sees.
O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart. ||4||8||
Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1129.g: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
1129.t: kalajug meh raam naam ur dhaar ||
1129.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, enshrine the Lord's Name within your heart.
Without the Name, ashes will be blown in your face. ||1||
The Lord's Name is so difficult to obtain, O Siblings of Destiny.

1129.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1129.t: gur parasaadh vasai man aaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1129.e: By Guru's Grace, it comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||
That humble being who seeks the Lord's Name,
receives it from the Perfect Guru. ||2||

1129.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
1129.t: har kaa bhaanaa ma(n)neh se jan paravaan ||
1129.e: Those humble beings who accept the Will of the Lord, are approved and accepted.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they bear the insignia of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

1129.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਜੋ ਕਲ ਰਹਿਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1129.t: so sevahu jo kal rahiaa dhaar ||
1129.e: So serve the One, whose power supports the Universe.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh loves the Naam. ||4||9||
Bhairao, Third Mehla:
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, many rituals are performed.

1129.g: ਨਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਨ ਕਰਮ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
1129.t: naa rut na karam thai paeh ||1||
1129.e: But it is not the time for them, and so they are of no use. ||1||

1129.g: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
1129.t: kalajug meh raam naam hai saar ||
1129.e: In Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the most sublime.
As Gurmukh, be lovingly attached to Truth. ||1||Pause||

1129.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1129.t: tan man khoj gharai meh paiaa ||
1129.e: Searching my body and mind, I found Him within the home of my own heart.
The Gurmukh centers his consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||2||

1130.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
1130.t: giaan a(n)jan satigur te hoi ||
1130.e: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is obtained from the True Guru.

1130.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥੩॥
1130.t: raam naam rav rahiaa tih loi ||3||
1130.e: The Lord's Name is pervading the three worlds. ||3||

1130.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਏਕੁ ਹੋਰ ਰੁਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
1130.t: kalijug meh har jeeau ek hor rut na kaiee ||
1130.e: In Kali Yuga, it is the time for the One Dear Lord; it is not the time for anything else.

1130.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਜਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
1130.t: naanak gurmukh hiradhai raam naam leh jamaiee ||4||10||
1130.e: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, let the Lord's Name grow within your heart. ||4||10||

1130.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨
1130.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ghar doojaa
1130.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla, Second House:

1130.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1130.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1130.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1130.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
1130.t: dhubidhaa manmukh rog viaape tirasanaa jaleh adhikaiee ||
1130.e: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted with the disease of duality; they are burnt by the intense fire of desire.

1130.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
1130.t: mar mar ja(n)meh Thaur na paaveh birathaa janam gavaiee ||1||
1130.e: They die and die again, and are reborn; they find no place of rest. They waste their lives uselessly. ||1||

1130.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1130.t: mere preetam kar kirapaa dheh bujhaiee ||
1130.e: O my Beloved, grant Your Grace, and give me understanding.

1130.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1130.t: haumai rogee jagat upaiaa bin sabadhai rog na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1130.e: The world was created in the disease of egotism; without the Word of the Shabad, the disease is not cured. ||1||Pause||

1130.g: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੜਹਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1130.t: si(n)mirat saasatr paReh mun kete bin sabadhai surat na paiee ||
1130.e: There are so many silent sages, who read the Simritees and the Shaastras; without the Shabad, they have no clear awareness.

1130.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥
1130.t: trai gun sabhe rog viaape mamataa surat gavaiee ||2||
1130.e: All those under the influence of the three qualities are afflicted with the disease; through possessiveness, they lose their awareness. ||2||

1130.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
1130.t: eik aape kaadd le prabh aape gur sevaa prabh laae ||
1130.e: O God, you save some, and you enjoin others to serve the Guru.

1130.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੋ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
1130.t: har kaa naam nidhaano paiaa sukh vasiaa man aai ||3||
1130.e: They obtain the treasure of the Name of the Lord; peace comes to abide within their minds. ||3||

1130.g: ਚਉਥੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1130.t: chauthee padhavee gurmukh varateh tin nij ghar vaasaa paiaa ||
1130.e: The Gurmukhs dwell in the fourth state; they obtain a dwelling in the home of their own inner being.

1130.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1130.t: poorai satigur kirapaa keenee vichahu aap gavaiaa ||4||
1130.e: The Perfect True Guru shows His Mercy to them; they eradicate their self-conceit from within. ||4||

1130.g: ਏਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਏਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
1130.t: ekas kee sir kaar ek jin brahamaa bisan rudhr upaiaa ||
1130.e: Everyone must serve the One Lord, who created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

1130.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੧॥
1130.t: naanak nihachal saachaa eko naa oh marai na jaiaa ||5||1||11||
1130.e: O Nanak, the One True Lord is permanent and stable. He does not die, and He is not born. ||5||1||11||

1130.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1130.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1130.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1130.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
1130.t: manmukh dhubidhaa sadhaa hai rogee rogee sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
1130.e: The self-willed manmukh is afflicted with the disease of duality forever; the entire universe is diseased.

1130.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
1130.t: gurmukh boojheh rog gavaaveh gur sabadhee veechaaraa ||1||
1130.e: The Gurmukh understands, and is cured of the disease, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

1130.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥
1130.t: har jeeau satasa(n)gat melai ||
1130.e: O Dear Lord, please let me join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

1130.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1130.t: naanak tis no dhei vaddiaaiee jo raam naam chit lai ||1|| rahaau ||
1130.e: O Nanak, the Lord blesses with glorious greatness, those who focus their consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

1130.g: ਮਮਤਾ ਕਾਲਿ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
1130.t: mamataa kaal sabh rog viaape tin jam kee hai sir kaaraa ||
1130.e: Death takes all those who are afflicted with the disease of possessiveness. They are subject to the Messenger of Death.

1130.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
1130.t: gurmukh praanee jam neR na aavai jin har raakhiaa ur dhaaraa ||2||
1130.e: The Messenger of Death does not even approach that mortal who, as Gurmukh, enshrines the Lord within his heart. ||2||

1130.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
1130.t: jin har kaa naam na gurmukh jaataa se jag meh kaahe aaiaa ||
1130.e: One who does not know the Lord's Name, and who does not become Gurmukh - why did he even come into the world?

1130.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1130.t: gur kee sevaa kadhe na keenee birathaa janam gavaiaa ||3||
1130.e: He never serves the Guru; he wastes his life uselessly. ||3||

1130.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
1130.t: naanak se poore vaddabhaagee satigur sevaa laae ||
1130.e: O Nanak, those whom the True Guru enjoins to His service, have perfect good fortune.

1130.g: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨॥
1130.t: jo ichheh soiee fal paaveh gurbaanee sukh paae ||4||2||12||
1130.e: They obtain the fruits of their desires, and find peace in the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||4||2||12||

1130.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1130.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1130.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1130.g: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
1130.t: dhukh vich ja(n)mai dhukh marai dhukh vich kaar kamai ||
1130.e: In pain he is born, in pain he dies, and in pain he does his deeds.

1130.g: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
1130.t: garabh jonee vich kadhe na nikalai bisaTaa maeh samai ||1||
1130.e: He is never released from the womb of reincarnation; he rots away in manure. ||1||

1130.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
1130.t: dhirag dhirag manmukh janam gavaiaa ||
1130.e: Cursed, cursed is the self-willed manmukh, who wastes his life away.

1130.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1130.t: poore gur kee sev na keenee har kaa naam na bhaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1130.e: He does not serve the Perfect Guru; he does not love the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1130.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਏ ॥
1130.t: gur kaa sabadh sabh rog gavaae jis no har jeeau laae ||
1130.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad cures all diseases; he alone is attached to it, whom the Dear Lord attaches.

1131.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੨॥
1131.t: naame naam milai vaddiaaiee jis no ma(n)n vasaae ||2||
1131.e: Through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained; he alone obtains it, whose mind is filled with the Lord. ||2||

1131.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
1131.t: satigur bheTai taa fal paae sach karanee sukh saar ||
1131.e: Meeting the True Guru, the fruitful rewards are obtained. This true lifestyle brings sublime peace.

1131.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
1131.t: se jan niramal jo har laage har naame dhareh piaar ||3||
1131.e: Those humble beings who are attached to the Lord are immaculate; they enshrine love for the Lord's Name. ||3||

1131.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
1131.t: tin kee ren milai taa(n) masatak laiee jin satigur pooraa dhiaaiaa ||
1131.e: If I obtain the dust of their feet, I apply it to my forehead. They meditate on the Perfect True Guru.

1131.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩॥
1131.t: naanak tin kee ren poorai bhaag paieeaai jinee raam naam chit laiaa ||4||3||13||
1131.e: O Nanak, this dust is obtained only by perfect destiny. They focus their consciousness on the Lord's Name. ||4||3||13||

1131.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1131.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1131.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1131.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
1131.t: sabadh beechaare so jan saachaa jin kai hiradhai saachaa soiee ||
1131.e: That humble being who contemplates the Word of the Shabad is true; the True Lord is within his heart.

1131.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਤਾਂ ਤਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
1131.t: saachee bhagat kareh dhin raatee taa(n) tan dhookh na hoiee ||1||
1131.e: If someone performs true devotional worship day and night, then his body will not feel pain. ||1||

1131.g: ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
1131.t: bhagat bhagat kahai sabh koiee ||
1131.e: Everyone calls him, ""Devotee, devotee.""

1131.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1131.t: bin satigur seve bhagat na paieeaai poorai bhaag milai prabh soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1131.e: But without serving the True Guru, devotional worship is not obtained. Only through perfect destiny does one meet God. ||1||Pause||

1131.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਿਦੂ ਹੋਈ ॥
1131.t: manmukh mool gavaaveh laabh maageh laahaa laabh kidhoo hoiee ||
1131.e: The self-willed manmukhs lose their capital, and still, they demand profits. How can they earn any profit?

1131.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੨॥
1131.t: jamakaal sadhaa hai sir uoopar dhoojai bhai pat khoiee ||2||
1131.e: The Messenger of Death is always hovering above their heads. In the love of duality, they lose their honor. ||2||

1131.g: ਬਹਲੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1131.t: bahale bhekh bhaveh dhin raatee haumai rog na jaiee ||
1131.e: Trying on all sorts of religious robes, they wander around day and night, but the disease of their egotism is not cured.

1131.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
1131.t: paR paR loojheh baadh vakhaaneh mil maiaa surat gavaiee ||3||
1131.e: Reading and studying, they argue and debate; attached to Maya, they lose their awareness. ||3||

1131.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1131.t: satigur seveh param gat paaveh naam milai vaddiaaiee ||
1131.e: Those who serve the True Guru are blessed with the supreme status; through the Naam, they are blessed with glorious greatness.

1131.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੪॥
1131.t: naanak naam jinaa man vasiaa dhar saachai pat paiee ||4||4||14||
1131.e: O Nanak, those whose minds are filled with the Naam, are honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||4||14||

1131.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1131.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1131.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1131.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
1131.t: manmukh aasaa nahee utarai dhoojai bhai khuaae ||
1131.e: The self-willed manmukh cannot escape false hope. In the love of duality, he is ruined.

1131.g: ਉਦਰੁ ਨੈ ਸਾਣੁ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਕਬਹੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਚਾਏ ॥੧॥
1131.t: audhar nai saan na bhareeaai kabahoo tirasanaa agan pachaae ||1||
1131.e: His belly is like a river - it is never filled up. He is consumed by the fire of desire. ||1||

1131.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
1131.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh raam ras raate ||
1131.e: Eternally blissful are those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord.

1131.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1131.t: hiradhai naam dhubidhaa man bhaagee har har a(n)mrit pee tirapataate ||1|| rahaau ||
1131.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, fills their hearts, and duality runs away from their minds. Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied. ||1||Pause||

1131.g: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
1131.t: aape paarabraham sirasaT jin saajee sir sir dha(n)dhai laae ||
1131.e: The Supreme Lord God Himself created the Universe; He links each and every person to their tasks.

1131.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
1131.t: maiaa moh keeaa jin aape aape dhoojai laae ||2||
1131.e: He Himself created love and attachment to Maya; He Himself attaches the mortals to duality. ||2||

1131.g: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
1131.t: tis no kih kaheeaai je dhoojaa hovai sabh tudhai maeh samaae ||
1131.e: If there were any other, then I would speak to him; all will be merged in You.

1131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
1131.t: gurmukh giaan tat beechaaraa jotee jot milaae ||3||
1131.e: The Gurmukh contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom; his light merges into the Light. ||3||

1131.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
1131.t: so prabh saachaa sadh hee saachaa saachaa sabh aakaaraa ||
1131.e: God is True, Forever True, and all His Creation is True.

1131.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੫॥
1131.t: naanak satigur sojhee paiee sach naam nisataaraa ||4||5||15||
1131.e: O Nanak, the True Guru has given me this understanding; the True Name brings emancipation. ||4||5||15||

1131.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1131.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1131.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1131.g: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
1131.t: kal meh pret jin(h)ee raam na pachhaataa satajug param ha(n)s beechaaree ||
1131.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who do not realize the Lord are goblins. In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, the supreme soul-swans contemplated the Lord.

1131.g: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
1131.t: dhuaapur tretai maanas varateh viralai haumai maaree ||1||
1131.e: In the Silver Age of Dwaapur Yuga, and the Brass Age of Traytaa Yuga, mankind prevailed, but only a rare few subdued their egos. ||1||

1131.g: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1131.t: kal meh raam naam vaddiaaiee ||
1131.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, glorious greatness is obtained through the Lord's Name.

1131.g: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1131.t: jug jug gurmukh eko jaataa vin naavai mukat na paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1131.e: In each and every age, the Gurmukhs know the One Lord; without the Name, liberation is not attained. ||1||Pause||

1131.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਖੈ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
1131.t: hiradhai naam lakhai jan saachaa gurmukh ma(n)n vasaiee ||
1131.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is revealed in the heart of the True Lord's humble servant. It dwells in the mind of the Gurmukh.

1131.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
1131.t: aap tare sagale kul taare jinee raam naam liv laiee ||2||
1131.e: Those who are lovingly focused on the Lord's Name save themselves; they save all their ancestors as well. ||2||

1131.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
1131.t: meraa prabh hai gun kaa dhaataa avagan sabadh jalaae ||
1131.e: My Lord God is the Giver of virtue. The Word of the Shabad burns away all faults and demerits.

1132.g: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੩॥
1132.t: jin man vasiaa se jan sohe hiradhai naam vasaae ||3||
1132.e: Those whose minds are filled with the Naam are beautiful; they enshrine the Naam within their hearts. ||3||

1132.g: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
1132.t: ghar dhar mahal satiguroo dhikhaiaa ra(n)g siau raleeaa maanai ||
1132.e: The True Guru has revealed to me the Lord's Home and His Court, and the Mansion of His Presence. I joyfully enjoy His Love.

1132.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬॥
1132.t: jo kichh kahai su bhalaa kar maanai naanak naam vakhaanai ||4||6||16||
1132.e: Whatever He says, I accept as good; Nanak chants the Naam. ||4||6||16||

1132.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1132.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1132.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1132.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
1132.t: manasaa maneh samai lai gur sabadhee veechaar ||
1132.e: The desires of the mind are absorbed in the mind, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1132.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
1132.t: gur poore te sojhee pavai fir marai na vaaro vaar ||1||
1132.e: Understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru, and then the mortal does not die over and over again. ||1||

1132.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
1132.t: man mere raam naam aadhaar ||
1132.e: My mind takes the Support of the Lord's Name.

1132.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1132.t: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa sabh ichh pujaavanahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1132.e: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status; the Lord is the Fulfiller of all desires. ||1||Pause||

1132.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
1132.t: sabh meh eko rav rahiaa gur bin boojh na pai ||
1132.e: The One Lord is permeating and pervading amongst all; without the Guru, this understanding is not obtained.

1132.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
1132.t: gurmukh pragaT hoaa meraa har prabh anadhin har gun gai ||2||
1132.e: My Lord God has been revealed to me, and I have become Gurmukh. Night and day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

1132.g: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
1132.t: sukhadhaataa har ek hai hor thai sukh na paeh ||
1132.e: The One Lord is the Giver of peace; peace is not found anywhere else.

1132.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
1132.t: satigur jinee na seviaa dhaataa se a(n)t ge pachhutaeh ||3||
1132.e: Those who do not serve the Giver, the True Guru, depart regretfully in the end. ||3||

1132.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
1132.t: satigur sev sadhaa sukh paiaa fir dhukh na laagai dhai ||
1132.e: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is obtained, and the mortal does not suffer in pain any longer.

1132.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੭॥
1132.t: naanak har bhagat paraapat hoiee jotee jot samai ||4||7||17||
1132.e: Nanak has been blessed with devotional worship of the Lord; his light has merged into the Light. ||4||7||17||

1132.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1132.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1132.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1132.g: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਭੂਲਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥
1132.t: baajh guroo jagat bauraanaa bhoolaa choTaa khaiee ||
1132.e: Without the Guru, the world is insane; confused and deluded, it is beaten, and it suffers.

1132.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
1132.t: mar mar ja(n)mai sadhaa dhukh paae dhar kee khabar na paiee ||1||
1132.e: It dies and dies again, and is reborn, always in pain, but it is unaware of the Lord's Gate. ||1||

1132.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
1132.t: mere man sadhaa rahahu satigur kee saranaa ||
1132.e: O my mind, remain always in the Protection of the True Guru's Sanctuary.

1132.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1132.t: hiradhai har naam meeThaa sadh laagaa gur sabadhe bhavajal taranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1132.e: Those people, to whose hearts the Lord's Name seems sweet, are carried across the terrifying world-ocean by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

1132.g: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਡੋਲੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
1132.t: bhekh karai bahut chit ddolai a(n)tar kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||
1132.e: The mortal wears various religious robes, but his consciousness is unsteady; deep within, he is filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

1132.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਾ ਭੂਖ ਅਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਭਉਕਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
1132.t: a(n)tar tisaa bhookh at bahutee bhaukat firai dhar baar ||2||
1132.e: Deep within is the great thirst and immense hunger; he wanders from door to door. ||2||

1132.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
1132.t: gur kai sabadh mareh fir jeeveh tin kau mukat dhuaar ||
1132.e: Those who die in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are reborn; they find the door of liberation.

1132.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
1132.t: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadhaa sukh hovai har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||3||
1132.e: With constant peace and tranquility deep within, they enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||3||

1132.g: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1132.t: jiau tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai karanaa kichhoo na jaiee ||
1132.e: As it pleases Him, He inspires us to act. Nothing else can be done.

1132.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੮॥
1132.t: naanak gurmukh sabadh sam(h)aale raam naam vaddiaaiee ||4||8||18||
1132.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and is blessed with the glorious greatness of the Lord's Name. ||4||8||18||

1132.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1132.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1132.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1132.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਦੁਖ ਖਾਇ ॥
1132.t: haumai maiaa moh khuaaiaa dhukh khaTe dhukh khai ||
1132.e: Lost in egotism, Maya and attachment, the mortal earns pain, and eats pain.

1132.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਹਲਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
1132.t: a(n)tar lobh halak dhukh bhaaree bin bibek bharamai ||1||
1132.e: The great disease, the rabid disease of greed, is deep within him; he wanders around indiscriminately. ||1||

1132.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
1132.t: manmukh dhirag jeevan saisaar ||
1132.e: The life of the self-willed manmukh in this world is cursed.

1132.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1132.t: raam naam supanai nahee chetiaa har siau kadhe na laagai piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1132.e: He does not remember the Lord's Name, even in his dreams. He is never in love with the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

1132.g: ਪਸੂਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
1132.t: pasooaa karam karai nahee boojhai kooR kamaavai kooRo hoi ||
1132.e: He acts like a beast, and does not understand anything. Practicing falsehood, he becomes false.

1132.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
1132.t: satigur milai ta ulaTee hovai khoj lahai jan koi ||2||
1132.e: But when the mortal meets the True Guru, his way of looking at the world changes. How rare are those humble beings who seek and find the Lord. ||2||

1132.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
1132.t: har har naam ridhai sadh vasiaa paiaa gunee nidhaan ||
1132.e: That person, whose heart is forever filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, obtains the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

1132.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
1132.t: gur parasaadhee pooraa paiaa chookaa man abhimaan ||3||
1132.e: By Guru's Grace, he finds the Perfect Lord; the egotistical pride of his mind is eradicated. ||3||

1132.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
1132.t: aape karataa kare karaae aape maarag paae ||
1132.e: The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act. He Himself places us on the path.

1133.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੯॥
1133.t: aape gurmukh dhe vaddiaaiee naanak naam samaae ||4||9||19||
1133.e: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness; O Nanak, he merges in the Naam. ||4||9||19||

1133.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1133.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1133.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1133.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
1133.t: meree paTeeaa likhahu har govi(n)dh gopaalaa ||
1133.e: Upon my writing tablet, I write the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World.

1133.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਾਥੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
1133.t: dhoojai bhai faathe jam jaalaa ||
1133.e: In the love of duality, the mortals are caught in the noose of the Messenger of Death.

1133.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
1133.t: satigur kare meree pratipaalaa ||
1133.e: The True Guru nurtures and sustains me.

1133.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
1133.t: har sukhadhaataa merai naalaa ||1||
1133.e: The Lord, the Giver of peace, is always with me. ||1||

1133.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
1133.t: gur upadhes prahilaadh har ucharai ||
1133.e: Following his Guru's instructions, Prahlaad chanted the Lord's Name;

1133.g: ਸਾਸਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਗਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1133.t: saasanaa te baalak gam na karai ||1|| rahaau ||
1133.e: he was a child, but he was not afraid when his teacher yelled at him. ||1||Pause||

1133.g: ਮਾਤਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
1133.t: maataa upadhesai prahilaadh piaare ||
1133.e: Prahlaad's mother gave her beloved son some advice:

1133.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
1133.t: putr raam naam chhoddahu jeeau leh ubaare ||
1133.e: "My son, you must abandon the Lord's Name, and save your life!"

1133.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
1133.t: prahilaadh kahai sunahu meree mai ||
1133.e: Prahlaad said: ""Listen, O my mother;

1133.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
1133.t: raam naam na chhoddaa gur dheeaa bujhai ||2||
1133.e: I shall never give up the Lord's Name. My Guru has taught me this.""||2||

1133.g: ਸੰਡਾ ਮਰਕਾ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
1133.t: sa(n)ddaa marakaa sabh jai pukaare ||
1133.e: Sandaa and Markaa, his teachers, went to his father the king, and complained:

1133.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਗੜਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਚਾਟੜੇ ਵਿਗਾੜੇ ॥
1133.t: prahilaadh aap vigaRiaa sabh chaaTaRe vigaaRe ||
1133.e: "Prahlaad himself has gone astray, and he leads all the other pupils astray."

1133.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
1133.t: dhusaT sabhaa meh ma(n)tr pakaiaa ||
1133.e: In the court of the wicked king, a plan was hatched.

1133.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1133.t: prahalaadh kaa raakhaa hoi raghuraiaa ||3||
1133.e: God is the Savior of Prahlaad. ||3||

1133.g: ਹਾਥਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
1133.t: haath khaRag kar dhaiaa at aha(n)kaar ||
1133.e: With sword in hand, and with great egotistical pride, Prahlaad's father ran up to him.

1133.g: ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਤੁਝੁ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
1133.t: har teraa kahaa tujh le ubaar ||
1133.e: "Where is your Lord, who will save you?"

1133.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੈਆਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਥੰਮੑ ਉਪਾੜਿ ॥
1133.t: khin meh bhaiaan roop nikasiaa tha(n)m(h) upaaR ||
1133.e: In an instant, the Lord appeared in a dreadful form, and shattered the pillar.

1133.g: ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਨਖੀ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
1133.t: haranaakhas nakhee bidhaariaa prahalaadh leeaa ubaar ||4||
1133.e: Harnaakhash was torn apart by His claws, and Prahlaad was saved. ||4||

1133.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
1133.t: sa(n)t janaa ke har jeeau kaaraj savaare ||
1133.e: The Dear Lord completes the tasks of the Saints.

1133.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਇਕੀਹ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
1133.t: prahalaadh jan ke ikeeh kul udhaare ||
1133.e: He saved twenty-one generations of Prahlaad's descendents.

1133.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
1133.t: gur kai sabadh haumai bikh maare ||
1133.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the poison of egotism is neutralized.

1133.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੦॥
1133.t: naanak raam naam sa(n)t nisataare ||5||10||20||
1133.e: O Nanak, through the Name of the Lord, the Saints are emancipated. ||5||10||20||

1133.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1133.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1133.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1133.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੈਤ ਲਾਇ ਦਿਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
1133.t: aape dhait lai dhite sa(n)t janaa kau aape raakhaa soiee ||
1133.e: The Lord Himself makes demons pursue the Saints, and He Himself saves them.

1133.g: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
1133.t: jo teree sadhaa saranaiee tin man dhukh na hoiee ||1||
1133.e: Those who remain forever in Your Sanctuary, O Lord - their minds are never touched by sorrow. ||1||

1133.g: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
1133.t: jug jug bhagataa kee rakhadhaa aaiaa ||
1133.e: In each and every age, the Lord saves the honor of His devotees.

1133.g: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਰਪਣੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1133.t: dhait putr prahalaadh gaitree tarapan kichhoo na jaanai sabadhe mel milaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1133.e: Prahlaad, the demon's son, knew nothing of the Hindu morning prayer, the Gayatri, and nothing about ceremonial water-offerings to his ancestors; but through the Word of the Shabad, he was united in the Lord's Union. ||1||Pause||

1133.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ॥
1133.t: anadhin bhagat kareh dhin raatee dhubidhaa sabadhe khoiee ||
1133.e: Night and day, he performed devotional worship service, day and night, and through the Shabad, his duality was eradicated.

1133.g: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
1133.t: sadhaa niramal hai jo sach raate sach vasiaa man soiee ||2||
1133.e: Those who are imbued with Truth are immaculate and pure; the True Lord abides within their minds. ||2||

1133.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
1133.t: moorakh dhubidhaa paRheh mool na pachhaaneh birathaa janam gavaiaa ||
1133.e: The fools in duality read, but they do not understand anything; they waste their lives uselessly.

1133.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੈਤੁ ਚਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1133.t: sa(n)t janaa kee ni(n)dhaa kareh dhusaT dhait chiRaiaa ||3||
1133.e: The wicked demon slandered the Saint, and stirred up trouble. ||3||

1133.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਡਰੈ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
1133.t: prahalaadh dhubidhaa na paRai har naam na chhoddai ddarai na kisai dhaa ddaraiaa ||
1133.e: Prahlaad did not read in duality, and he did not abandon the Lord's Name; he was not afraid of any fear.

1133.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਾ ਦੈਤੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
1133.t: sa(n)t janaa kaa har jeeau raakhaa dhaitai kaal neRaa aaiaa ||4||
1133.e: The Dear Lord became the Savior of the Saint, and the demonic Death could not even approach him. ||4||

1133.g: ਆਪਣੀ ਪੈਜ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1133.t: aapanee paij aape raakhai bhagataa(n) dhei vaddiaaiee ||
1133.e: The Lord Himself saved his honor, and blessed his devotee with glorious greatness.

1133.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਨਖੀ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ਅੰਧੈ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੧॥੨੧॥
1133.t: naanak haranaakhas nakhee bidhaariaa a(n)dhai dhar kee khabar na paiee ||5||11||21||
1133.e: O Nanak, Harnaakhash was torn apart by the Lord with His claws; the blind demon knew nothing of the Lord's Court. ||5||11||21||

1133.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
1133.t: raag bhairau mahalaa chauthhaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
1133.e: Raag Bhairao, Fourth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

1133.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1133.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1133.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1133.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਗਿ ਲਾਇਣੁ ॥
1133.t: har jan sa(n)t kar kirapaa pag lain ||
1133.e: The Lord, in His Mercy, attaches mortals to the feet of the Saints.

1134.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥
1134.t: gur sabadhee har bhaj surat samain ||1||
1134.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, vibrate and meditate on the Lord; let your awareness be absorbed in Him. ||1||

1134.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
1134.t: mere man har bhaj naam narain ||
1134.e: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord and the Name of the Lord.

1134.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1134.t: har har kirapaa kare sukhadhaataa gurmukh bhavajal har naam tarain ||1|| rahaau ||
1134.e: The Lord, Har, Har, the Giver of Peace, grants His Grace; the Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing of the Lord.
Follow the Guru's Teachings, and you shall obtain the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||2||

1134.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਇਣੁ ॥
1134.t: gur saadhoo a(n)mirat giaan sar nain ||
1134.e: Bathe in the pool of ambrosial nectar, the spiritual wisdom of the Holy Guru.
All sins will be eliminated and eradicated. ||3||
You Yourself are the Creator, the Support of the Universe.

1134.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
1134.t: jan naanak mel teraa dhaas dhasain ||4||1||
1134.e: Please unite servant Nanak with Yourself; he is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||1||
Bhairao, Fourth Mehla:

1134.g: ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਫਲ ਸਾ ਘਰੀ ॥
1134.t: bol har naam safal saa gharee ||
1134.e: Fruitful is that moment when the Lord's Name is spoken.
Following the Guru's Teachings, all pains are taken away. ||1||

1134.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥
1134.t: mere man har bhaj naam naraharee ||
1134.e: O my mind, vibrate the Name of the Lord.

1134.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਭਉ ਤਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1134.t: kar kirapaa melahu gur pooraa satasa(n)gat sa(n)g si(n)dh bhau taree ||1|| rahaau ||
1134.e: O Lord, be merciful, and unite me with the Perfect Guru. Joining with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
Meditate on the Life of the World; remember the Lord in your mind.
Millions upon millions of your sins shall be taken away. ||2||
In the Sat Sangat, apply the dust of the feet of the holy to your face;
this is how to bathe in the sixty-eight sacred shrines, and the Ganges. ||3||

1134.g: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
1134.t: ham moorakh kau har kirapaa karee ||
1134.e: I am a fool; the Lord has shown mercy to me.
The Savior Lord has saved servant Nanak. ||4||2||
Bhairao, Fourth Mehla:
To do good deeds is the best rosary.
Chant on the beads within your heart, and it shall go along with you. ||1||
Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Lord of the forest.

1134.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1134.t: kar kirapaa melahu satasa(n)gat tooT giee maiaa jam jaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
1134.e: Have mercy on me, Lord, and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, so that I may be released from Maya's noose of death. ||1||Pause||
Whoever, as Gurmukh, serves and works hard,
is molded and shaped in the true mint of the Shabad, the Word of God. ||2||

1134.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਦਿਖਾਲੀ ॥
1134.t: har agam agochar gur agam dhikhaalee ||
1134.e: The Guru has revealed to me the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord.

1134.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
1134.t: vich kaiaa nagar ladhaa har bhaalee ||3||
1134.e: Searching within the body-village, I have found the Lord. ||3||
I am just a child; the Lord is my Father, who nurtures and cherishes me.
Please save servant Nanak, Lord; bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||3||
Bhairao, Fourth Mehla:

1134.g: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1134.t: sabh ghaT tere too sabhanaa maeh ||
1134.e: All hearts are Yours, Lord; You are in all.
There is nothing at all except You. ||1||
O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Giver of peace.

1134.g: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਾਪੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1134.t: hau tudh saalaahee too meraa har prabh baap ||1|| rahaau ||
1134.e: I praise You, O Lord God, You are my Father. ||1||Pause||

1134.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
1134.t: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh har prabh soi ||
1134.e: Wherever I look, I see only the Lord God.

1134.g: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
1134.t: sabh terai vas dhoojaa avar na koi ||2||
1134.e: All are under Your control; there is no other at all. ||2||

1134.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1134.t: jis kau tum har raakhiaa bhaavai ||
1134.e: O Lord, when it is Your Will to save someone,

1134.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
1134.t: tis kai neRai koi na jaavai ||3||
1134.e: then nothing can threaten him. ||3||

1134.g: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
1134.t: too jal thal maheeal sabh tai bharapoor ||
1134.e: You are totally pervading and permeating the waters, the lands, the skies and all places.

1134.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
1134.t: jan naanak har jap haajaraa hajoor ||4||4||
1134.e: Servant Nanak meditates on the Ever-present Lord. ||4||4||
Bhairao, Fourth Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1134.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
1134.t: har kaa sa(n)t har kee har moorat jis hiradhai har naam muraar ||
1134.e: The Lord's Saint is the embodiment of the Lord; within his heart is the Name of the Lord.

1134.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
1134.t: masatak bhaag hovai jis likhiaa so gurmat hiradhai har naam sam(h)aar ||1||
1134.e: One who has such destiny inscribed on his forehead, follows the Guru's Teachings, and contemplates the Name of the Lord within his heart. ||1||

1135.g: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1135.t: madhusoodhan japeeaai ur dhaar ||
1135.e: Enshrine Him in your heart, and meditate on the Lord.

1135.g: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1135.t: dhehee nagar tasakar pa(n)ch dhaatoo gur sabadhee har kaadde maar ||1|| rahaau ||
1135.e: The five plundering thieves are in the body-village; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord has beaten them and driven them out. ||1||Pause||

1135.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰਜ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
1135.t: jin kaa har setee man maaniaa tin kaaraj har aap savaar ||
1135.e: Those whose minds are satisfied with the Lord - the Lord Himself resolves their affairs.

1135.g: ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
1135.t: tin chookee muhataajee lokan kee har a(n)geekaar keeaa karataar ||2||
1135.e: Their subservience and their dependence on other people is ended; the Creator Lord is on their side. ||2||

1135.g: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਤਾਂ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
