1135.t: mataa masoorat taa(n) kichh keejai je kichh hovai har baahar ||
1135.e: If something were beyond the realm of the Lord's Power, only then would we have recourse to consult someone else.

1135.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹੋਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
1135.t: jo kichh karai soiee bhal hosee har dhiaavahu anadhin naam muraar ||3||
1135.e: Whatever the Lord does is good. Meditate on the Name of the Lord, night and day. ||3||

1135.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਓਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1135.t: har jo kichh kare su aape aape oh poochh na kisai kare beechaar ||
1135.e: Whatever the Lord does, He does by Himself. He does not ask or consult anyone else.

1135.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
1135.t: naanak so prabh sadhaa dhiaaieeaai jin meliaa satigur kirapaa dhaar ||4||1||5||
1135.e: O Nanak, meditate forever on God; granting His Grace, He unites us with the True Guru. ||4||1||5||

1135.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1135.t: bhairau mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1135.e: Bhairao, Fourth Mehla:

1135.g: ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
1135.t: te saadhoo har melahu suaamee jin japiaa gat hoi hamaaree ||
1135.e: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with the Holy people; meditating on You, I am saved.

1135.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
1135.t: tin kaa dharas dhekh man bigasai khin khin tin kau hau balihaaree ||1||
1135.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, my mind blossoms forth. Each and every moment, I am a sacrifice to them. ||1||

1135.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
1135.t: har hiradhai jap naam muraaree ||
1135.e: Meditate within your heart on the Name of the Lord.

1135.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਜੈ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1135.t: kirapaa kirapaa kar jagat pit suaamee ham dhaasan dhaas keejai panihaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
1135.e: Show Mercy, Mercy to me, O Father of the World, O my Lord and Master; make me the water-carrier of the slave of Your slaves. ||1||Pause||

1135.g: ਤਿਨ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਤਿਨ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
1135.t: tin mat uootam tin pat uootam jin hiradhai vasiaa banavaaree ||
1135.e: Their intellect is sublime and exalted, and so is their honor; the Lord, the Lord of the forest, abides within their hearts.

1135.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
1135.t: tin kee sevaa lai har suaamee tin simarat gat hoi hamaaree ||2||
1135.e: O my Lord and Master, please link me to the service of those who meditate in remembrance on You, and are saved. ||2||

1135.g: ਜਿਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
1135.t: jin aaisaa satigur saadh na paiaa te har dharageh kaadde maaree ||
1135.e: Those who do not find such a Holy True Guru are beaten, and driven out of the Court of the Lord.

1135.g: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਕ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
1135.t: te nar ni(n)dhak sobh na paaveh tin nak kaaTe sirajanahaaree ||3||
1135.e: These slanderous people have no honor or reputation; their noses are cut by the Creator Lord. ||3||

1135.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੀ ॥
1135.t: har aap bulaavai aape bolai har aap nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar niraahaaree ||
1135.e: The Lord Himself speaks, and the Lord Himself inspires all to speak; He is Immaculate and Formless, and needs no sustenance.

1135.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲਸੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
1135.t: har jis too meleh so tudh milasee jan naanak kiaa eh ja(n)t vichaaree ||4||2||6||
1135.e: O Lord, he alone meets You, whom You cause to meet. Says servant Nanak, I am a wretched creature. What can I do? ||4||2||6||

1135.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1135.t: bhairau mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1135.e: Bhairao, Fourth Mehla:

1135.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਨਣੇ ॥
1135.t: satasa(n)gat saiee har teree jit har keerat har sunane ||
1135.e: That is Your True Congregation, Lord, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are heard.

1135.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਹਮ ਸ੍ਰੇਵਹ ਨਿਤ ਚਰਣੇ ॥੧॥
1135.t: jin har naam suniaa man bheenaa tin ham sreveh nit charane ||1||
1135.e: The minds of those who listen to the Lord's Name are drenched with bliss; I worship their feet continually. ||1||

1135.g: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤਰਣੇ ॥
1135.t: jagajeevan har dhiaai tarane ||
1135.e: Meditating on the Lord, the Life of the World, the mortals cross over.

1135.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇਤੁ ਗਨਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1135.t: anek asa(n)kh naam har tere na jaahee jihavaa it ganane ||1|| rahaau ||
1135.e: Your Names are so many, they are countless, O Lord. This tongue of mine cannot even count them. ||1||Pause||

1135.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਲੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣੇ ॥
1135.t: gursikh har bolahu har gaavahu le gurmat har japane ||
1135.e: O Gursikhs, chant the Lord's Name, and sing the Praises of the Lord. Take the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the Lord.

1135.g: ਜੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਘਣੇ ॥੨॥
1135.t: jo upadhes sune gur keraa so jan paavai har sukh ghane ||2||
1135.e: Whoever listens to the Guru's Teachings - that humble being receives countless comforts and pleasures from the Lord. ||2||

1135.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੰਸੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਜਣੇ ॥
1135.t: dha(n)nu su va(n)s dha(n)nu su pitaa dha(n)nu su maataa jin jan jane ||
1135.e: Blessed is the ancestry, blessed is the father, and blessed is that mother who gave birth to this humble servant.

1135.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਣੇ ॥੩॥
1135.t: jin saas giraas dhiaaiaa meraa har har se saachee dharageh har jan bane ||3||
1135.e: Those who meditate on my Lord, Har, Har, with every breath and morsel of food - those humble servants of the Lord look beautiful in the True Court of the Lord. ||3||

1135.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਣੇ ॥
1135.t: har har agam naam har tere vich bhagataa har dharane ||
1135.e: O Lord, Har, Har, Your Names are profound and infinite; Your devotees cherish them deep within.

1135.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਣੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
1135.t: naanak jan paiaa mat gurmat jap har har paar pavane ||4||3||7||
1135.e: Servant Nanak has obained the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, he crosses over to the other side. ||4||3||7||

1136.e: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1136.g: ਸਗਲੀ ਥੀਤਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਰਾਖੀ ॥ ਅਸਟਮ ਥੀਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਨਮਾ ਸੀ ॥੧॥
1136.t: sagalee theet paas ddaar raakhee || asaTam theet govi(n)dh janamaa see ||1||
1136.e: Setting aside all other days, it is said that the Lord was born on the eighth lunar day. ||1||
Deluded and confused by doubt, the mortal practices falsehood.

1136.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1136.t: janam maran te rahat naarain ||1|| rahaau ||
1136.e: The Lord is beyond birth and death. ||1||Pause||
You prepare sweet treats and feed them to your stone god.

1136.g: ਓਹੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਰੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਢੋਰ ॥੨॥
1136.t: oh janam na marai re saakat ddor ||2||
1136.e: God is not born, and He does not die, you foolish, faithless cynic! ||2||
You sing lullabyes to your stone god - this is the source of all your mistakes.

1136.g: ਸੋ ਮੁਖੁ ਜਲਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਹਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜੋਨੀ ॥੩॥
1136.t: so mukh jalau jit kaheh Thaakur jonee ||3||
1136.e: Let that mouth be burnt, which says that our Lord and Master is subject to birth. ||3||

1136.g: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1136.t: janam na marai na aavai na jai ||
1136.e: He is not born, and He does not die; He does not come and go in reincarnation.
The God of Nanak is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||4||1||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Standing up, I am at peace; sitting down, I am at peace.

1136.g: ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਂ ਐਸੇ ਬੁਝੀਆ ॥੧॥
1136.t: bhau nahee laagai jaa(n) aaise bujheeaa ||1||
1136.e: I feel no fear, because this is what I understand. ||1||
The One Lord, my Lord and Master, is my Protector.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts. ||1||Pause||
I sleep without worry, and I awake without worry.
You, O God, are pervading everywhere. ||2||

1136.g: ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1136.t: ghar sukh vasiaa baahar sukh paiaa ||
1136.e: I dwell in peace in my home, and I am at peace outside.
Says Nanak, the Guru has implanted His Mantra within me. ||3||2||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1136.g: ਵਰਤ ਨ ਰਹਉ ਨ ਮਹ ਰਮਦਾਨਾ ॥
1136.t: varat na rahau na meh ramadhaanaa ||
1136.e: I do not keep fasts, nor do I observe the month of Ramadaan.
I serve only the One, who will protect me in the end. ||1||
He is my One Lord, the same Lord who the Hindus call "Gussayee" and the Muslims call "Allah".
He adminsters justice to both Hindus and Muslims. ||1||Pause||

1136.g: ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਉ ਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
1136.t: haj kaabai jaau na teerath poojaa ||
1136.e: I do not make pilgrimages to Mecca, nor do I worship at Hindu sacred shrines.
I serve the One Lord, and not any other. ||2||
I do not perform Hindu worship services, nor do I offer the Muslim prayers.
I have taken the One Formless Lord into my heart; I humbly worship Him there. ||3||
I am not a Hindu, nor am I a Muslim.
My body and breath of life belong to Allah - to Raam - the God of both. ||4||
Says Kabeer, this is what I say:

1136.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੫॥੩॥
1136.t: gur peer mil khudh khasam pachhaanaa ||5||3||
1136.e: meeting with the Guru, my Spiritual Teacher, I realize God, my Lord and Master. ||5||3||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
I easily tied up the deer - the ten sensory organs.

1136.g: ਪਾਂਚ ਮਿਰਗ ਬੇਧੇ ਸਿਵ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
1136.t: paa(n)ch mirag bedhe siv kee baanee ||1||
1136.e: I shot five of the desires with the Word of the Lord's Bani. ||1||
I go out hunting with the Saints,

1136.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪਕਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਹਥੀਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1136.t: mirag pakare bin ghor hatheeaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1136.e: and we capture the deer without horses or weapons. ||1||Pause||
My mind used to run around outside hunting.
But now, I have found the game within the home of my body-village. ||2||
I caught the deer and brought them home.

1136.g: ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਲੇ ਗਏ ਬਾਂਢੇ ਬਾਟਿ ॥੩॥
1136.t: chukh chukh le ge baa(n)dde baaT ||3||
1136.e: Dividing them up, I shared them, bit by bit. ||3||
God has given this gift.
Nanak's home is filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||4||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Even though he may be fed with hundreds of longings and yearnings,

1136.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
1136.t: saakat har har cheet na aaiaa ||1||
1136.e: still the faithless cynic does not remember the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
Take in the teachings of the humble Saints.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||
Stones may be kept under water for a long time.
Even so, they do not absorb the water; they remain hard and dry. ||2||

1137.e: The six Shaastras may be read to a fool,
but it is like the wind blowing in the ten directions. ||3||

1137.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਣ ਖਲਹਾਨੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਗਾਹਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1137.t: bin kan khalahaan jaise gaahan paiaa ||
1137.e: It is like threshing a crop without any corn - nothing is gained.

1137.g: ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਨ ਬਰਾਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1137.t: tiau saakat te ko na baraasaiaa ||4||
1137.e: In the same way, no benefit comes from the faithless cynic. ||4||

1137.g: ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
1137.t: tit hee laagaa jit ko laiaa ||
1137.e: As the Lord attaches them, so are all attached.
Says Nanak, God has formed such a form. ||5||5||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
He created the soul, the breath of life and the body.
He created all beings, and knows their pains. ||1||
The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, is the Helper of the soul.

1137.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਦ ਛਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1137.t: halat palat jaa kee sadh chhaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1137.e: Here and herafter, He always provides shade. ||1||Pause||
Worship and adoration of God is the pure way of life.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the love of duality vanishes. ||2||
Friends, well-wishers and wealth will not support you.
Blessed, blessed is my Lord. ||3||
Nanak utters the Ambrosial Bani of the Lord.
Except the One Lord, he does not know any other at all. ||4||6||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord is in front of me, and the Lord is behind me.
My Beloved Lord, the Source of Nectar, is in the middle as well. ||1||
God is my Shaastra and my favorable omen.

1137.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭਉਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1137.t: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh gireh bhaun ||1|| rahaau ||
1137.e: In His Home and Mansion, I find peace, poise and bliss. ||1||Pause||
Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with my tongue, and hearing it with my ears, I live.

1137.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਮਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਵੇ ॥੨॥
1137.t: prabh simar simar amar thir theeve ||2||
1137.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, I have become eternal, permanent and stable. ||2||
The pains of countless lifetimes have been erased.
The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, vibrates in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
Granting His Grace, God has blended me with Himself.
Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God. ||4||7||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
It brings millions of desires to fulfillment.
On the Path of Death, It will go with you and help you. ||1||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe, is the holy water of the Ganges.

1137.g: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੀਵਤ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1137.t: jo simarai tis kee gat hovai peevat bahuR na jon bhramaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1137.e: Whoever meditates on it, is saved; drinking it in, the mortal does not wander in reincarnation again. ||1||Pause||
It is my worship, meditation, austerity and cleansing bath.
Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, I have become free of desire. ||2||
It is my domain and empire, wealth, mansion and court.
Meditating in remembrance on the Naam brings perfect conduct. ||3||
Slave Nanak has deliberated, and has come to this conclusion:

1137.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਭ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੮॥
1137.t: bin har naam mithiaa sabh chhaar ||4||8||
1137.e: Without the Lord's Name, everything is false and worthless, like ashes. ||4||8||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1137.g: ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
1137.t: lep na laago til kaa mool ||
1137.e: The poison had absolutely no harmful effect.

1137.g: ਦੁਸਟੁ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਮੂਆ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸੂਲ ॥੧॥
1137.t: dhusaT braahaman mooaa hoi kai sool ||1||
1137.e: But the wicked Brahmin died in pain. ||1||
The Supreme Lord God Himself has saved His humble servant.
The sinner died through the Power of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
The humble servant of the Lord and Master meditates on Him.
He Himself has destroyed the ignorant sinner. ||2||

1137.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
1137.t: prabh maat pitaa apane dhaas kaa rakhavaalaa ||
1137.e: God is the Mother, the Father and the Protector of His slave.

1137.g: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਮਾਥਾ ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
1137.t: ni(n)dhak kaa maathaa ieehaa(n) uoohaa kaalaa ||3||
1137.e: The face of the slanderer, here and hereafter, is blackened. ||3||

1137.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
1137.t: jan naanak kee paramesar sunee aradhaas ||
1137.e: The Transcendent Lord has heard the prayer of servant Nanak.
The filthy sinner lost hope and died. ||4||9||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1137.g: ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਖੂਬੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
1137.t: khoob khoob khoob khoob khoob tero naam ||
1137.e: Excellent, excellent, excellent, excellent, excellent is Your Name.

1137.g: ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਦੁਨੀ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1137.t: jhooTh jhooTh jhooTh jhooTh dhunee gumaan ||1|| rahaau ||
1137.e: False, false, false, false is pride in the world. ||1||Pause||
The glorious vision of Your slaves, O Infinite Lord, is wonderful and beauteous.

1138.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world is just ashes. ||1||

1138.g: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਦਮ ਸਲਾਹ ॥
1138.t: acharaj teree kudharat tere kadham salaeh ||
1138.e: Your Creative Power is marvellous, and Your Lotus Feet are admirable.
Your Praise is priceless, O True King. ||2||
God is the Support of the unsupported.
Meditate day and night on the Cherisher of the meek and humble. ||3||
God has been merciful to Nanak.

1138.g: ਅਲਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦਿਲ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
1138.t: alahu na visarai dhil jeea paraan ||4||10||
1138.e: May I never forget God; He is my heart, my soul, my breath of life. ||4||10||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
As Gurmukh, obtain the true wealth.

1138.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੧॥
1138.t: prabh kaa bhaanaa sat kar sahahu ||1||
1138.e: Accept the Will of God as True. ||1||
Live, live, live forever.
Rise early each day, and drink in the Nectar of the Lord.

1138.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1138.t: har har har har rasanaa kahahu ||1|| rahaau ||
1138.e: With your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the One Name alone shall save you.
Nanak speaks the wisdom of God. ||2||11||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Serving the True Guru, all fruits and rewards are obtained.
The filth of so many lifetimes is washed away. ||1||
Your Name, God, is the Purifier of sinners.

1138.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਮ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1138.t: poorab karam likhe gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
1138.e: Because of the karma of my past deeds, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am saved.
I am blessed with honor in God's Court. ||2||
Serving at God's Feet, all comforts are obtained.

1138.g: ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
1138.t: dhoor baachheh sabh sur nar dhevaa ||3||
1138.e: All the angels and demi-gods long for the dust of the feet of such beings. ||3||
Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam.

1138.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
1138.t: har jap jap udhariaa sagal jahaan ||4||12||
1138.e: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the whole world is saved. ||4||12||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
God hugs His slave close in His Embrace.
He throws the slanderer into the fire. ||1||
The Lord saves His servants from the sinners.

1138.g: ਪਾਪੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਚਿਆ ਆਪ ਕਮਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1138.t: paapee kee gat katahoo naahee paapee pachiaa aap kamain ||1|| rahaau ||
1138.e: No one can save the sinner. The sinner is destroyed by his own actions. ||1||Pause||
The Lord's slave is in love with the Dear Lord.
The slanderer loves something else. ||2||
The Supreme Lord God has revealed His Innate Nature.
The evil-doer obtains the fruits of his own actions. ||3||
God does not come or go; He is All-pervading and permeating.
Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||4||13||

1138.t: raag bhairau mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar doojaa
1138.e: Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1138.g: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਨ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
1138.t: sreedhar mohan sagal upaavan nira(n)kaar sukhadhaataa ||
1138.e: The Fascinating Lord, the Creator of all, the Formless Lord, is the Giver of Peace.

1138.g: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
1138.t: aaisaa prabh chhodd kareh an sevaa kavan bikhiaa ras maataa ||1||
1138.e: You have abandoned this Lord, and you serve another. Why are you intoxicated with the pleasures of corruption? ||1||

1138.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਾਜੁ ॥
1138.t: re man mere too govidh bhaaj ||
1138.e: O my mind, meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

1138.g: ਅਵਰ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਲ ਮੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਬਿਗਰਸਿ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1138.t: avar upaav sagal mai dhekhe jo chitaveeaai tit bigaras kaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
1138.e: I have seen all other sorts of efforts; whatever you can think of, will only bring failure. ||1||Pause||

1138.g: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
1138.t: Thaakur chhodd dhaasee kau simareh manmukh a(n)dh agiaanaa ||
1138.e: The blind, ignorant, self-willed manmukhs forsake their Lord and Master, and dwell on His slave Maya.

1138.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਪਸੂ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
1138.t: har kee bhagat kareh tin ni(n)dheh nigure pasoo samaanaa ||2||
1138.e: They slander those who worship their Lord; they are like beasts, without a Guru. ||2||

1138.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਹਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
1138.t: jeeau pi(n)dd tan dhan sabh prabh kaa saakat kahate meraa ||
1138.e: Soul, life, body and wealth all belong to God, but the faithless cynics claim that they own them.

1139.g: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਮੈਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
1139.t: aha(n)budh dhuramat hai mailee bin gur bhavajal feraa ||3||
1139.e: They are proud and arrogant, evil-minded and filthy; without the Guru, they are reincarnated into the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

1139.g: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1139.t: hom jag jap tap sabh sa(n)jam taT teerath nahee paiaa ||
1139.e: Through burnt offerings, charitable feasts, ritualistic chants, penance, all sorts of austere self-discipline and pilgrimages to sacred shrines and rivers, they do not find God.

1139.g: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
1139.t: miTiaa aap pe saranaiee gurmukh naanak jagat taraiaa ||4||1||14||
1139.e: Self-conceit is only erased when one seeks the Lord's Sanctuary and becomes Gurmukh; O Nanak, he crosses over the world-ocean. ||4||1||14||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1139.g: ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਉਦਾਸਾਏ ॥
1139.t: ban meh pekhio tiran meh pekhio gireh pekhio udhaasaae ||
1139.e: I have seen Him in the woods, and I have seen Him in the fields. I have seen Him in the household, and in renunciation.

1139.g: ਦੰਡਧਾਰ ਜਟਧਾਰੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤੀਰਥਾਏ ॥੧॥
1139.t: dha(n)ddadhaar jaTadhaarai pekhio varat nem teerathaae ||1||
1139.e: I have seen Him as a Yogi carrying His staff, as a Yogi with matted hair, fasting, making vows, and visiting sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||
I have seen Him in the Society of the Saints, and within my own mind.

1139.g: ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1139.t: uoobh piaal sarab meh pooran ras ma(n)gal gun gaae ||1|| rahaau ||
1139.e: In the sky, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in everything, He is pervading and permeating. With love and joy, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

1139.g: ਜੋਗ ਭੇਖ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਜਤਿ ਜੰਗਮ ਕਾਪੜਾਏ ॥
1139.t: jog bhekh sa(n)niaasai pekhio jat ja(n)gam kaapaRaae ||
1139.e: I have seen Him among the Yogis, the Sannyaasees, the celibates, the wandering hermits and the wearers of patched coats.

1139.g: ਤਪੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
1139.t: tapee tapeesur mun meh pekhio naT naaTik nirataae ||2||
1139.e: I have seen Him among the men of severe self-discipline, the silent sages, the actors, dramas and dances. ||2||

1139.g: ਚਹੁ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਖਟ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦਸ ਅਸਟੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾਏ ॥
1139.t: chahu meh pekhio khaT meh pekhio dhas asaTee si(n)mritaae ||
1139.e: I have seen Him in the four Vedas, I have seen Him in the six Shaastras, in the eighteen Puraanas and the Simritees as well.

1139.g: ਸਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਨਹਿ ਤਉ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਉ ਦੁਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
1139.t: sabh mil eko ek vakhaaneh tau kis te kahau dhuraae ||3||
1139.e: All together, they declare that there is only the One Lord. So tell me, from whom is He hidden? ||3||

1139.g: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਹ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮਾਏ ॥
1139.t: ageh ageh bea(n)t suaamee neh keem keem keemaae ||
1139.e: Unfathomable and Inaccessible, He is our Infinite Lord and Master; His Value is beyond valuation.

1139.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੫॥
1139.t: jan naanak tin kai bal bal jaieeaai jeh ghaT paragaTeeaae ||4||2||15||
1139.e: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, within whose heart He is revealed. ||4||2||15||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1139.g: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
1139.t: nikaT bujhai so buraa kiau karai ||
1139.e: How can anyone do evil, if he realizes that the Lord is near?
One who gathers corruption, constantly feels fear.

1139.g: ਹੈ ਨਿਕਟੇ ਅਰੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1139.t: hai nikaTe ar bhedh na paiaa ||
1139.e: He is near, but this mystery is not understood.
Without the True Guru, all are enticed by Maya. ||1||
Everyone says that He is near, near at hand.

1139.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1139.t: gurmukh bhedh viralaa ko lahai ||1|| rahaau ||
1139.e: But rare is that person, who, as Gurmukh, understands this mystery. ||1||Pause||

1139.g: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
1139.t: nikaT na dhekhai par gireh jai ||
1139.e: The mortal does not see the Lord near at hand; instead, he goes to the homes of others.
He steals their wealth and lives in falsehood.

1139.g: ਪਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
1139.t: piee Thagauree har sa(n)g na jaaniaa ||
1139.e: Under the influence of the drug of illusion, he does not know that the Lord is with him.
Without the Guru, he is confused and deluded by doubt. ||2||
Not understanding that the Lord is near, he tells lies.
In love and attachment to Maya, the fool is plundered.
That which he seeks is within his own self, but he looks for it outside.
Without the Guru, he is confused and deluded by doubt. ||3||
One whose good karma is recorded on his forehead
serves the True Guru; thus the hard and heavy shutters of his mind are opened wide.
Within his own being and beyond, he sees the Lord near at hand.

1139.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬॥
1139.t: jan naanak aavai na jaavai koi ||4||3||16||
1139.e: O servant Nanak, he does not come and go in reincarnation. ||4||3||16||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1139.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
1139.t: jis too raakheh tis kaun maarai ||
1139.e: Who can kill that person whom You protect, O Lord?

1139.g: ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
1139.t: sabh tujh hee a(n)tar sagal sa(n)saarai ||
1139.e: All beings, and the entire universe, is within You.
The mortal thinks up millions of plans,

1139.g: ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਕਰੈ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
1139.t: so hovai j karai choj viddaanee ||1||
1139.e: but that alone happens, which the Lord of wondrous plays does. ||1||
Save me, save me, O Lord; shower me with Your Mercy.
I seek Your Sanctuary, and Your Court. ||1||Pause||
Whoever serves the Fearless Lord, the Giver of Peace,

1139.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਏਕੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥
1139.t: tin bhau dhoor keeaa ek paraataa ||
1139.e: is rid of all his fears; he knows the One Lord.

1139.g: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
1139.t: jo too kareh soiee fun hoi ||
1139.e: Whatever You do, that alone comes to pass in the end.
There is no other who can kill or protect us. ||2||
What do you think, with your human understanding?
The All-knowing Lord is the Searcher of Hearts.
The One and only Lord is my Support and Protection.
The Creator Lord knows everything. ||3||
That person who is blessed by the Creator's Glance of Grace

1140.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
1140.t: tis jan ke sabh kaaj savaar ||
1140.e: all his affairs are resolved.
The One Lord is his Protector.

1140.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੜਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭॥
1140.t: jan naanak apaR na saakai koi ||4||4||17||
1140.e: O servant Nanak, no one can equal him. ||4||4||17||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
We should feel sad, if God were beyond us.
We should feel sad, if we forget the Lord.
We should feel sad, if we are in love with duality.
But why should we feel sad? The Lord is pervading everywhere. ||1||
In love and attachment to Maya, the mortals are sad, and are consumed by sadness.

1140.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਖਪਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1140.t: bin naavai bhram bhram bhram khapiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1140.e: Without the Name, they wander and wander and wander, and waste away. ||1||Pause||
We should feel sad, if there were another Creator Lord.

1140.g: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਅਨਿਆਇ ਕੋ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
1140.t: tau kaReeaai je aniaai ko marataa ||
1140.e: We should feel sad, if someone dies by injustice.

1140.g: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1140.t: tau kaReeaai je kichh jaanai naahee ||
1140.e: We should feel sad, if something were not known to the Lord.
But why should we feel sad? The Lord is totally permeating everywhere. ||2||

1140.g: ਤਉ ਕੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ ॥
1140.t: tau kaReeaai je kichh hoi dhin(g)aanai ||
1140.e: We should feel sad, if God were a tyrant.
We should feel sad, if He made us suffer by mistake.

1140.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ॥
1140.t: gur kahiaa jo hoi sabh prabh te ||
1140.e: The Guru says that whatever happens is all by God's Will.

1140.g: ਤਬ ਕਾੜਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਮ ਸੋਤੇ ॥੩॥
1140.t: tab kaaRaa chhodd achi(n)t ham sote ||3||
1140.e: So I have abandoned sadness, and I now sleep without anxiety. ||3||

1140.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
1140.t: prabh toohai Thaakur sabh ko teraa ||
1140.e: O God, You alone are my Lord and Master; all belong to You.
According to Your Will, You pass judgement.
There is no other at all; the One Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.
Please save Nanak's honor; I have come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||5||18||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Without music, how is one to dance?
Without a voice, how is one to sing?
Without strings, how is a guitar to be played?
Without the Naam, all affairs are useless. ||1||
Without the Naam - tell me: who has ever been saved?

1140.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1140.t: bin satigur kaise paar pariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1140.e: Without the True Guru, how can anyone cross over to the other side? ||1||Pause||
Without a tongue, how can anyone speak?
Without ears, how can anyone hear?
Without eyes, how can anyone see?

1140.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਰੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
1140.t: naam binaa nar kahee na lekhai ||2||
1140.e: Without the Naam, the mortal is of no account at all. ||2||
Without learning, how can one be a Pandit - a religious scholar?
Without power, what is the glory of an empire?
Without understanding, how can the mind become steady?
Without the Naam, the whole world is insane. ||3||
Without detachment, how can one be a detached hermit?

1140.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
1140.t: bin hau tiaag kahaa kouoo tiaagee ||
1140.e: Without renouncing egotism, how can anyone be a renunciate?

1140.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਹਾ ਮਨ ਚੂਰੇ ॥
1140.t: bin bas pa(n)ch kahaa man choore ||
1140.e: Without overcoming the five thieves, how can the mind be subdued?

1140.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
1140.t: naam binaa sadh sadh hee jhoore ||4||
1140.e: Without the Naam, the mortal regrets and repents forever and ever. ||4||
Without the Guru's Teachings, how can anyone obtain spiritual wisdom?
Without seeing - tell me: how can anyone visualize in meditation?
Without the Fear of God, all speech in useless.
Says Nanak, this is the wisdom of the Lord's Court. ||5||6||19||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Mankind is afflicted with the disease of egotism.
The disease of sexual desire overwhelms the elephant.
Because of the disease of vision, the moth is burnt to death.
Because of the disease of the sound of the bell, the deer is lured to its death. ||1||

1140.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸੋ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
1140.t: jo jo dheesai so so rogee ||
1140.e: Whoever I see is diseased.

1140.g: ਰੋਗ ਰਹਿਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1140.t: rog rahit meraa satigur jogee ||1|| rahaau ||
1140.e: Only my True Guru, the True Yogi, is free of disease. ||1||Pause||
Because of the disease of taste, the fish is caught.
Because of the disease of smell, the bumble bee is destroyed.
The whole world is caught in the disease of attachment.
In the disease of the three qualities, corruption is multiplied. ||2||
In disease the mortals die, and in disease they are born.
In disease they wander in reincarnation again and again.

1141.g: ਰੋਗ ਬੰਧ ਰਹਨੁ ਰਤੀ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1141.t: rog ba(n)dh rahan ratee na paavai ||
1141.e: Entangled in disease, they cannot stay still, even for an instant.

1141.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
1141.t: bin satigur rog kateh na jaavai ||3||
1141.e: Without the True Guru, the disease is never cured. ||3||
When the Supreme Lord God grants His Mercy,
He grabs hold of the mortal's arm, and pulls him up and out of the disease.
Reaching the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mortal's bonds are broken.
Says Nanak, the Guru cures him of the disease. ||4||7||20||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
When He comes to mind, then I am in supreme bliss.

1141.g: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜ ॥
1141.t: cheet aavai taa(n) sabh dhukh bha(n)j ||
1141.e: When He comes to mind, then all my pains are shattered.
When He comes to mind, my hopes are fulfilled.

1141.g: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਝੂਰੀ ॥੧॥
1141.t: cheet aavai taa(n) kabeh na jhooree ||1||
1141.e: When He comes to mind, I never feel sadness. ||1||
Deep within my being, my Sovereign Lord King has revealed Himself to me.

1141.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1141.t: gur poorai dheeo ra(n)g lai ||1|| rahaau ||
1141.e: The Perfect Guru has inspired me to love Him. ||1||Pause||

1141.g: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
1141.t: cheet aavai taa(n) sarab ko raajaa ||
1141.e: When He comes to mind, I am the king of all.
When He comes to mind, all my affairs are completed.
When He comes to mind, I am dyed in the deep crimson of His Love.
When He comes to mind, I am ecstatic forever. ||2||
When He comes to mind, I am wealthy forever.
When He comes to mind, I am free of doubt forever.

1141.g: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
1141.t: cheet aavai taa(n) sabh ra(n)g maane ||
1141.e: When He comes to mind, then I enjoy all pleasures.
When He comes to mind, I am rid of fear. ||3||

1141.g: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1141.t: cheet aavai taa(n) sahaj ghar paiaa ||
1141.e: When He comes to mind, I find the home of peace and poise.
When He comes to mind, I am absorbed in the Primal Void of God.
When He comes to mind, I continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises.
Nanak's mind is pleased and satisfied with the Lord God. ||4||8||21||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
My Father is Eternal, forever alive.
My brothers live forever as well.
My friends are permanent and imperishable.
My family abides in the home of the self within. ||1||

1141.g: ਹਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਹਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
1141.t: ham sukh paiaa taa(n) sabheh suhele ||
1141.e: I have found peace, and so all are at peace.

1141.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1141.t: gur poorai pitaa sa(n)g mele ||1|| rahaau ||
1141.e: The Perfect Guru has united me with my Father. ||1||Pause||
My mansions are the highest of all.
My countries are infinite and uncountable.
My kingdom is eternally stable.
My wealth is inexhaustible and permanent. ||2||
My glorious reputation resounds throughout the ages.
My fame has spread in all places and interspaces.
My praises echo in each and every house.
My devotional worship is known to all people. ||3||
My Father has revealed Himself within me.
The Father and son have joined together in partnership.
Says Nanak, when my Father is pleased,
then the Father and son are joined together in love, and become one. ||4||9||22||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The True Guru, the Primal Being, is free of revenge and hate; He is God, the Great Giver.
I am a sinner; You are my Forgiver.

1141.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ ॥
1141.t: jis paapee kau milai na ddoiee ||
1141.e: That sinner, who finds no protection anywhere
- if he comes seeking Your Sanctuary, then he becomes immaculate and pure. ||1||
Pleasing the True Guru, I have found peace.

1141.g: ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1141.t: sabh fal paae guroo dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
1141.e: Meditating on the Guru, I have obtained all fruits and rewards. ||1||Pause||
I humbly bow to the Supreme Lord God, the True Guru.

1141.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
1141.t: man tan teraa sabh teraa dhes ||
1141.e: My mind and body are Yours; all the world is Yours.
When the veil of illusion is removed, then I come to see You.
You are my Lord and Master; You are the King of all. ||2||
When it pleases Him, even dry wood becomes green.

1141.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਥਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਰਿਆ ॥
1141.t: tis bhaanaa taa(n) thal sir sariaa ||
1141.e: When it pleases Him, rivers flow across the desert sands.

1141.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
1141.t: tis bhaanaa taa(n) sabh fal paae ||
1141.e: When it pleases Him, all fruits and rewards are obtained.
Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, my anxiety is dispelled. ||3||

1142.e: I am unworthy and ungrateful, but He has been merciful to me.

1142.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
1142.t: man tan seetal man a(n)mrit vooThaa ||
1142.e: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed; the Ambrosial Nectar rains down in my mind.
The Supreme Lord God, the Guru, has become kind and compassionate to me.
Slave Nanak beholds the Lord, enraptured. ||4||10||23||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
My True Guru is totally independent.
My True Guru is adorned with Truth.
My True Guru is the Giver of all.
My True Guru is the Primal Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||1||
There is no deity equal to the Guru.

1142.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਸੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1142.t: jis masatak bhaagu su laagaa sev ||1|| rahaau ||
1142.e: Whoever has good destiny inscribed on his forehead, applies himself to seva - selfless service. ||1||Pause||
My True Guru is the Sustainer and Cherisher of all.
My True Guru kills and revives.

1142.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥੨॥
1142.t: satigur mere kee vaddiaaiee || pragaT bhiee hai sabhanee thaiee ||2||
1142.e: The glorious greatness of my True Guru has become manifest everywhere. ||2||
My True Guru is the power of the powerless.
My True Guru is my home and court.

1142.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
1142.t: satigur kai hau sadh bal jaiaa ||
1142.e: I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru.
He has shown me the path. ||3||

1142.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
1142.t: jin gur seviaa tis bhau na biaapai ||
1142.e: One who serves the Guru is not afflicted with fear.

1142.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
1142.t: jin gur seviaa tis dhukh na sa(n)taapai ||
1142.e: One who serves the Guru does not suffer in pain.
Nanak has studied the Simritees and the Vedas.
There is no difference between the Supreme Lord God and the Guru. ||4||11||24||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Repeating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal is exalted and glorified.

1142.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਪਾਪੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਗਇਆ ॥
1142.t: naam lait paap tan te giaa ||
1142.e: Repeating the Naam, sin is banished from the body.
Repeating the Naam, all festivals are celebrated.
Repeating the Naam, one is cleansed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines. ||1||
My sacred shrine of pilgrimage is the Name of the Lord.
The Guru has instructed me in the true essence of spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
Repeating the Naam, the mortal's pains are taken away.
Repeating the Naam, the most ignorant people become spiritual teachers.
Repeating the Naam, the Divine Light blazes forth.
Repeating the Naam, one's bonds are broken. ||2||

1142.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
1142.t: naam lait jam neR na aavai ||
1142.e: Repeating the Naam, the Messenger of Death does not draw near.
Repeating the Naam, one finds peace in the Court of the Lord.
Repeating the Naam, God gives His Approval.
The Naam is my true wealth. ||3||
The Guru has instructed me in these sublime teachings.
The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises and the Naam are the Support of the mind.
Nanak is saved through the atonement of the Naam.
Other actions are just to please and appease the people. ||4||12||25||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
I bow in humble worship, tens of thousands of times.

1142.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
1142.t: eih man dheejai taa kau vaar ||
1142.e: I offer this mind as a sacrifice.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, sufferings are erased.
Bliss wells up, and no disease is contracted. ||1||
Such is the diamond, the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1142.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1142.t: jaas japat pooran sabh kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1142.e: Chanting it, all works are perfectly completed. ||1||Pause||

1142.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਹੈ ॥
1142.t: jaa kee dhirasaT dhukh dderaa ddahai ||
1142.e: Beholding Him, the house of pain is demolished.
The mind seizes the cooling, soothing, Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

1142.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ॥
1142.t: anik bhagat jaa ke charan poojaaree ||
1142.e: Millions of devotees worship His Feet.
He is the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires. ||2||
In an instant, He fills the empty to over-flowing.
In an instant, He transforms the dry into green.

1142.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
1142.t: khin meh nithaave kau dheeno thaan ||
1142.e: In an instant, He gives the homeless a home.

1142.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
1142.t: khin meh nimaane kau dheeno maan ||3||
1142.e: In an instant, He bestows honor on the dishonored. ||3||

1143.e: The One Lord is totally pervading and permeating all.
He alone meditates on the Lord, whose True Guru is Perfect.
Such a person has the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises for his Support.
Says Nanak, the Lord Himself is merciful to him. ||4||13||26||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
I was discarded and abandoned, but He has embellished me.
He has blessed me with beauty and His Love; through His Name, I am exalted.
All my pains and sorrows have been eradicated.
The Guru has become my Mother and Father. ||1||
O my friends and companions, my household is in bliss.

1143.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1143.t: kar kirapaa bheTe moh ka(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
1143.e: Granting His Grace, my Husband Lord has met me. ||1||Pause||
The fire of desire has been extinguished, and all my desires have been fulfilled.
The darkness has been dispelled, and the Divine Light blazes forth.
The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, is wondrous and amazing!
Perfect is the Grace of the Perfect Guru. ||2||
That person, unto whom the Lord reveals Himself
by the Blessed Vision of his Darshan, I am forever enraptured.

1143.g: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
1143.t: sarab gunaa taa kai bahut nidhaan ||
1143.e: He obtains all virtues and so many treasures.
The True Guru blesses him with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
That person who meets with his Lord and Master

1143.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
1143.t: man tan seetal har har japanaa ||
1143.e: his mind and body are cooled and soothed, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

1143.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ॥
1143.t: kahu naanak jo jan prabh bhaae ||
1143.e: Says Nanak, such a humble being is pleasing to God;

1143.t: taa kee ren biralaa ko paae ||4||14||27||
1143.e: only a rare few are blessed with the dust of his feet. ||4||14||27||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The mortal does not hesitate to think about sin.
He is not ashamed to spend time with prostitutes.
He works all day long,

1143.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ਬਜਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥
1143.t: har simaran kee velaa bajar sir parai ||1||
1143.e: but when it is time to remember the Lord, then a heavy stone falls on his head. ||1||
Attached to Maya, the world is deluded and confused.

1143.g: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1143.t: aap bhulaiaa bhulaavanahaarai raach rahiaa birathaa biauhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1143.e: The Deluder Himself has deluded the mortal, and now he is engrossed in worthless worldly affairs. ||1||Pause||
Gazing on Maya's illusion, its pleasures pass away.
He loves the shell, and ruins his life.
Bound to blind worldly affairs, his mind wavers and wanders.
The Creator Lord does not come into his mind. ||2||

1143.g: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1143.t: karat karat iv hee dhukh paiaa ||
1143.e: Working and working like this, he only obtains pain,
and his affairs of Maya are never completed.
His mind is saturated with sexual desire, anger and greed.

1143.g: ਤੜਫਿ ਮੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
1143.t: taRaf mooaa jiau jal bin meenaa ||3||
1143.e: Wiggling like a fish out of water, he dies. ||3||

1143.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
1143.t: jis ke raakhe hoi har aap ||
1143.e: One who has the Lord Himself as his Protector,

1143.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
1143.t: har har naam sadhaa jap jaap ||
1143.e: chants and meditates forever on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
O Nanak, he has found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||15||28||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
He alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord shows Mercy.
He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.
With the True Word of the Shabad in his heart and mind,
the sins of countless incarnations vanish. ||1||
The Lord's Name is the Support of the soul.

1143.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ ਤਾਰਿ ਲਏ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1143.t: gur parasaadh japahu nit bhaiee taar le saagar sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
1143.e: By Guru's Grace, chant the Name continually, O Siblings of Destiny; It shall carry you across the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

1143.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
1143.t: jin kau likhiaa har eh nidhaan ||
1143.e: Those who have this treasure of the Lord's Name written in their destiny,
those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord.
Singing His Glorious Praises with peace, poise and bliss,
even the homeless obtain a home hereafter. ||2||
Throughout the ages, this has been the essence of reality.
Meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and contemplate the Truth.

1144.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
1144.t: jis laR lai le so laagai ||
1144.e: He alone is attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, whom the Lord Himself attaches.
Asleep for countless incarnations, he now awakens. ||3||
Your devotees belong to You, and You belong to Your devotees.
You Yourself inspire them to chant Your Praises.
All beings and creatures are in Your Hands.

1144.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੯॥
1144.t: naanak ke prabh sadh hee saath ||4||16||29||
1144.e: Nanak's God is always with him. ||4||16||29||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Inner-knower of my heart.
The Naam is so useful to me.
The Lord's Name permeates each and every hair of mine.
The Perfect True Guru has given me this gift. ||1||
The Jewel of the Naam is my treasure.
It is inaccessible, priceless, infinite and incomparable. ||1||Pause||
The Naam is my unmoving, unchanging Lord and Master.

1144.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
1144.t: naam kee mahimaa sabh meh banee ||
1144.e: The glory of the Naam spreads over the whole world.
The Naam is my perfect master of wealth.
The Naam is my independence. ||2||
The Naam is my food and love.
The Naam is the objective of my mind.
By the Grace of the Saints, I never forget the Naam.
Repeating the Naam, the Unstruck Sound-current of the Naad resounds. ||3||

1144.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
1144.t: prabh kirapaa te naam nau nidh paiee ||
1144.e: By God's Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures of the Naam.

1144.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
1144.t: gur kirapaa te naam siau ban aaiee ||
1144.e: By Guru's Grace, I am tuned in to the Naam.
They alone are wealthy and supreme,
O Nanak, who have the treasure of the Naam. ||4||17||30||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1144.g: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
1144.t: too meraa pitaa toohai meraa maataa ||
1144.e: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.
You are my Soul, my Breath of Life, the Giver of Peace.

1144.g: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
1144.t: too meraa Thaakur hau dhaas teraa ||
1144.e: You are my Lord and Master; I am Your slave.

1144.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
1144.t: tujh bin avar nahee ko meraa ||1||
1144.e: Without You, I have no one at all. ||1||
Please bless me with Your Mercy, God, and give me this gift,

1144.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1144.t: tum(h)ree usatat karau dhin raat ||1|| rahaau ||
1144.e: that I may sing Your Praises, day and night. ||1||Pause||
I am Your musical instrument, and You are the Musician.

1144.g: ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
1144.t: ham tere bhikhaaree dhaan dheh dhaataaraa ||
1144.e: I am Your beggar; please bless me with Your charity, O Great Giver.
By Your Grace, I enjoy love and pleasures.
You are deep within each and every heart. ||2||
By Your Grace, I chant the Name.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

1144.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
1144.t: tum(h)ree dhiaa te hoi dharadh binaas ||
1144.e: In Your Mercy, You take away our pains.
By Your Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||3||
I am a sacrifice to the Divine Guru.

1144.g: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
1144.t: safal dharasan jaa kee niramal sev ||
1144.e: The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His service is immaculate and pure.
Be Merciful to me, O my Lord God and Master,
that Nanak may continually sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||18||31||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1144.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
1144.t: sabh te uooch jaa kaa dharabaar ||
1144.e: His Regal Court is the highest of all.
I humbly bow to Him, forever and ever.

1144.g: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨ ॥
1144.t: uooche te uoochaa jaa kaa thaan ||
1144.e: His place is the highest of the high.
Millions of sins are erased by the Name of the Lord. ||1||
In His Sanctuary, we find eternal peace.

1144.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1144.t: kar kirapaa jaa kau melai soi ||1|| rahaau ||
1144.e: He Mercifully unites us with Himself. ||1||Pause||

1144.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
1144.t: jaa ke karatab lakhe na jaeh ||
1144.e: His wondrous actions cannot even be described.

1144.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1144.t: jaa kaa bharavaasaa sabh ghaT maeh ||
1144.e: All hearts rest their faith and hope in Him.
He is manifest in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The devotees lovingly worship and adore Him night and day. ||2||
He gives, but His treasures are never exhausted.
In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.

1144.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
1144.t: jaa kaa hukam na meTai koi ||
1144.e: No one can erase the Hukam of His Command.
The True Lord is above the heads of kings. ||3||

1144.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
1144.t: jis kee oT tisai kee aasaa ||
1144.e: He is my Anchor and Support; I place my hopes in Him.

1145.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
1145.t: dhukh sukh hamaraa tis hee paasaa ||
1145.e: I place my pain and pleasure before Him.

1145.g: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪੜਦਾ ॥
1145.t: raakh leeno sabh jan kaa paRadhaa ||
1145.e: He covers the faults of His humble servant.
Nanak sings His Praises. ||4||19||32||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The whiner whines every day.

1145.g: ਬਲਨ ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
1145.t: balan baratan kau sanaba(n)dh chit aaiaa ||
1145.e: His attachment to his household and entanglements cloud his mind.
If someone becomes detached through understanding,

1145.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
1145.t: janam maran fir sog na hoi ||1||
1145.e: he will not have to suffer in birth and death again. ||1||
All of his conflicts are extensions of his corruption.
How rare is that person who takes the Naam as his Support. ||1||Pause||
The three-phased Maya infects all.
Whoever clings to it suffers pain and sorrow.
There is no peace without meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
By great good fortune, the treasure of the Naam is received. ||2||
One who loves the actor in his mind,
later regrets it when the actor takes off his costume.
The shade from a cloud is transitory,
like the worldly paraphernalia of attachment and corruption. ||3||
If someone is blessed with the singular substance,
then all of his tasks are accomplished to perfection.
One who obtains the Naam, by Guru's Grace
- O Nanak, his coming into the world is certified and approved. ||4||20||33||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Slandering the Saints, the mortal wanders in reincarnation.
Slandering the Saints, he is diseased.
Slandering the Saints, he suffers in pain.
The slanderer is punished by the Messenger of Death. ||1||
Those who argue and fight with the Saints

1145.g: ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1145.t: tin ni(n)dhak naahee kichh saadh ||1|| rahaau ||
1145.e: - those slanderers find no happiness at all. ||1||Pause||
Slandering the devotees, the wall of the mortal's body is shattered.
Slandering the devotees, he suffers in hell.

1145.g: ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਗਲੈ ॥
1145.t: bhagat kee ni(n)dhaa garabh meh galai ||
1145.e: Slandering the devotees, he rots in the womb.

1145.g: ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਟਲੈ ॥੨॥
1145.t: bhagat kee ni(n)dhaa raaj te Talai ||2||
1145.e: Slandering the devotees, he loses his realm and power. ||2||
The slanderer finds no salvation at all.
He eats only that which he himself has planted.
He is worse than a thief, a lecher, or a gambler.
The slanderer places an unbearable burden upon his head. ||3||
The devotees of the Supreme Lord God are beyond hate and vengeance.
Whoever worships their feet is emancipated.
The Primal Lord God has deluded and confused the slanderer.
O Nanak, the record of one's past actions cannot be erased. ||4||21||34||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is for me the Vedas and the Sound-current of the Naad.
Through the Naam, my tasks are perfectly accomplished.
The Naam is my worship of deities.
The Naam is my service to the Guru. ||1||
The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me.

1145.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1145.t: sabh te uootam har har kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1145.e: The highest task of all is the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
The Naam is my cleansing bath and purification.
The Naam is my perfect donation of charity.
Those who repeat the Naam are totally purified.
Those who chant the Naam are my friends and Siblings of Destiny. ||2||
The Naam is my auspicious omen and good fortune.
The Naam is the sublime food which satisfies me.
The Naam is my good conduct.
The Naam is my immaculate occupation. ||3||

1145.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
1145.t: jaa kai man vasiaa prabh ek ||
1145.e: All those humble beings whose minds are filled with the One God

1145.g: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
1145.t: sagal janaa kee har har Tek ||
1145.e: have the Support of the Lord, Har, Har.

1145.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
1145.t: man tan naanak har gun gaau ||
1145.e: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with your mind and body.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord bestows His Name. ||4||22||35||

1146.e: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
You bless the poor with wealth, O Lord.
Countless sins are taken away, and the mind becomes immaculate and pure.
All the mind's desires are fulfilled, and one's tasks are perfectly accomplished.
You bestow Your Name upon Your devotee. ||1||
Service to the Lord, our Sovereign King, is fruitful and rewarding.

1146.g: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1146.t: karan karaavanahaar suaamee taa te birathaa koi na jai ||1|| rahaau ||
1146.e: Our Lord and Master is the Creator, the Cause of causes; no one is turned away from His Door empty-handed. ||1||Pause||
God eradicates the disease from the diseased person.
God takes away the sorrows of the suffering.
And those who have no place at all - You seat them upon the place.
You link Your slave to devotional worship. ||2||
God bestows honor on the dishonored.
He makes the foolish and ignorant become clever and wise.
The fear of all fear disappears.

1146.g: ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੩॥
1146.t: jan apane kai har man basai ||3||
1146.e: The Lord dwells within the mind of His humble servant. ||3||
The Supreme Lord God is the Treasure of Peace.
The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the essence of reality.
Granting His Grace, He enjoins the mortals to serve the Saints.
O Nanak, such a person merges in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||23||36||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1146.g: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
1146.t: sa(n)t ma(n)ddal meh har man vasai ||
1146.e: In the Realm of the Saints, the Lord dwells in the mind.

1146.g: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
1146.t: sa(n)t ma(n)ddal meh dhurat sabh nasai ||
1146.e: In the Realm of the Saints, all sins run away.
In the Realm of the Saints, one's lifestyle is immaculate.
In the Society of the Saints, one comes to love the One Lord. ||1||
That alone is called the Realm of the Saints,
where only the Glorious Praises of the Supreme Lord God are sung. ||1||Pause||

1146.g: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
1146.t: sa(n)t ma(n)ddal meh janam maran rahai ||
1146.e: In the Realm of the Saints, birth and death are ended.

1146.g: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
1146.t: sa(n)t ma(n)ddal meh jam kichhoo na kahai ||
1146.e: In the Realm of the Saints, the Messenger of Death cannot touch the mortal.
In the Society of the Saints, one's speech becomes immaculate
In the realm of the saints, the Lord's Name is chanted. ||2||
The Realm of the Saints is the eternal, ever-stable place.
In the Realm of the Saints, sins are destroyed.
In the Realm of the Saints, the immaculate sermon is spoken.
In the Society of the Saints, the pain of egotism runs away. ||3||
The Realm of the Saints cannot be destroyed.
In the Realm of the Saints, is the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.
The Realm of the Saints is the resting place of our Lord and Master.
O Nanak, He is woven into the fabric of His devotees, through and through. ||4||24||37||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Why worry about disease, when the Lord Himself protects us?

1146.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
1146.t: tis jan hoi na dhookh sa(n)taap ||
1146.e: That person whom the Lord protects, does not suffer pain and sorrow.
That person, upon whom God showers His Mercy
- Death hovering above him is turned away. ||1||
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is forever our Help and Support.

1146.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1146.t: jis cheet aavai tis sadhaa sukh hovai nikaT na aavai taa kai jaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1146.e: When He comes to mind, the mortal finds lasting peace, and the Messenger of Death cannot even approach him. ||1||Pause||

1146.g: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਨ ਸੋ ਤਬ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
1146.t: jab ih na so tab kineh upaiaa ||
1146.e: When this being did not exist, who created him then?
What has been produced from the source?
He Himself kills, and He Himself rejuvenates.
He cherishes His devotees forever. ||2||

1146.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
1146.t: sabh kichh jaanahu tis kai haath ||
1146.e: Know that everything is in His Hands.
My God is the Master of the masterless.

1146.g: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
1146.t: dhukh bha(n)jan taa kaa hai naau ||
1146.e: His Name is the Destroyer of pain.

1146.g: ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੩॥
1146.t: sukh paaveh tis ke gun gaau ||3||
1146.e: Singing His Glorious Praises, you shall find peace. ||3||
O my Lord and Master, please listen to the prayer of Your Saint.
I place my soul, my breath of life and wealth before You.

1146.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
1146.t: eih jag teraa sabh tujheh dhiaae ||
1146.e: All this world is Yours; it meditates on You.

1147.e: Please shower Nanak with Your Mercy and bless him with peace. ||4||25||38||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
With Your Support, I survive in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
With Your Support, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
With Your Support, death cannot even touch me.
With Your Support, my entanglements vanish. ||1||
In this world and the next, I have Your Support.

1147.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1147.t: sabh meh raviaa saahib ek ||1|| rahaau ||
1147.e: The One Lord, our Lord and Master, is all-pervading. ||1||Pause||
With Your Support, I celebrate blissfully.
With Your Support, I chant the Guru's Mantra.
With Your Support, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
The Perfect Lord, our Protector and Savior, is the Ocean of Peace. ||2||
With Your Support, I have no fear.
The True Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
With Your Support, my mind is filled with Your Power.
Here and there, You are my Court of Appeal. ||3||
I take Your Support, and place my faith in You.
All meditate on God, the Treasure of Virtue.

1147.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
1147.t: jap jap anadh kareh tere dhaasaa ||
1147.e: Chanting and meditating on You, Your slaves celebrate in bliss.
Nanak meditates in remembrance on the True Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||4||26||39||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
First, I gave up slandering others.

1147.g: ਉਤਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
1147.t: autar giee sabh man kee chi(n)dhaa ||
1147.e: All the anxiety of my mind was dispelled.
Greed and attachment were totally banished.
I see God ever-present, close at hand; I have become a great devotee. ||1||
Such a renunciate is very rare.

1147.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1147.t: har har naam japai jan soi ||1|| rahaau ||
1147.e: Such a humble servant chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
I have forsaken my egotistical intellect.
The love of sexual desire and anger has vanished.
I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
In the Company of the Holy, I am emancipated. ||2||
Enemy and friend are all the same to me.
The Perfect Lord God is permeating all.

1147.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1147.t: prabh kee aagiaa maan sukh paiaa ||
1147.e: Accepting the Will of God, I have found peace.
The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. ||3||
That person, whom the Lord, in His Mercy, saves
that devotee chants and meditates on the Naam.

1147.g: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥
1147.t: man pragaas gur te mat liee ||
1147.e: That person, whose mind is illumined, and who obtains understanding through the Guru

1147.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੪੦॥
1147.t: kahu naanak taa kee pooree piee ||4||27||40||
1147.e: - says Nanak, he is totally fulfilled. ||4||27||40||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
There is no peace in earning lots of money.
There is no peace in watching dances and plays.
There is no peace in conquering lots of countries.

1147.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
1147.t: sarab sukhaa har har gun gaae ||1||
1147.e: All peace comes from singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
You shall obtain peace, poise and bliss,

1147.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1147.t: saadhasa(n)gat paieeaai vaddabhaagee gurmukh har har naam kahahu ||1|| rahaau ||
1147.e: when you find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, by great good fortune. As Gurmukh, utter the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
Mother, father, children and spouse - all place the mortal in bondage.
Religious rituals and actions done in ego place the mortal in bondage.
If the Lord, the Shatterer of bonds, abides in the mind,

1147.g: ਤਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
1147.t: tau sukh paavai nij ghar basai ||2||
1147.e: then peace is obtained, dwelling in the home of the self deep within. ||2||
Everyone is a beggar; God is the Great Giver.
The Treasure of Virtue is the Infinite, Endless Lord.

1147.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
1147.t: jis no karam kare prabh apanaa ||
1147.e: That person, unto whom God grants His Mercy

1147.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਜਨਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
1147.t: har har naam tinai jan japanaa ||3||
1147.e: - that humble being chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
I offer my prayer to my Guru.
O Primal Lord God, Treasure of Virtue, please bless me with Your Grace.
Says Nanak, I have come to Your Sanctuary.
If it pleases You, please protect me, O Lord of the World. ||4||28||41||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Meeting with the Guru, I have forsaken the love of duality.

1148.e: As Gurmukh, I chant the Name of the Lord.
My anxiety is gone, and I am in love with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
I was asleep for countless lifetimes, but I have now awakened. ||1||
Granting His Grace, He has linked me to His service.

1148.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1148.t: saadhoo sa(n)g sarab sukh paae ||1|| rahaau ||
1148.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all pleasures are found. ||1||Pause||
The Word of the Guru's Shabad has eradicated disease and evil.
My mind has absorbed the medicine of the Naam.
Meeting with the Guru, my mind is in bliss.
All treasures are in the Name of the Lord God. ||2||

1148.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
1148.t: janam maran kee miTee jam traas ||
1148.e: My fear of birth and death and the Messenger of Death has been dispelled.
In the Saadh Sangat, the inverted lotus of my heart has blossomed forth.
Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I have found eternal, abiding peace.
All my tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||3||
This human body, so difficult to obtain, is approved by the Lord.

1148.g: ਸਫਲ ਹੋਈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
1148.t: safal hoiee jap har har naam ||
1148.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, it has become fruitful.
Says Nanak, God has blessed me with His Mercy.
With every breath and morsel of food, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||29||42||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1148.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
1148.t: sabh te uoochaa jaa kaa naau ||
1148.e: His Name is the Highest of all.

1148.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
1148.t: sadhaa sadhaa taa ke gun gaau ||
1148.e: Sing His Glorious Praises, forever and ever.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, all pain is dispelled.
All pleasures come to dwell in the mind. ||1||
O my mind, meditate in remembrance on the True Lord.

1148.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1148.t: halat palat tumaree gat hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
1148.e: In this world and the next, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||
The Immaculate Lord God is the Creator of all.
He gives sustenance to all beings and creatures.
He forgives millions of sins and mistakes in an instant.
Through loving devotional worship, one is emancipated forever. ||2||
True wealth and true glorious greatness,

1148.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
1148.t: gur poore te nihachal mat paiee ||
1148.e: and eternal, unchanging wisdom, are obtained from the Perfect Guru.
When the Protector, the Savior Lord, bestows His Mercy,
all spiritual darkness is dispelled. ||3||
I focus my meditation on the Supreme Lord God.
The Lord of Nirvaanaa is totally pervading and permeating all.
Eradicating doubt and fear, I have met the Lord of the World.
The Guru has become merciful to Nanak. ||4||30||43||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Meditating in remembrance on Him, the mind is illumined.
Suffering is eradicated, and one comes to dwell in peace and poise.
They alone receive it, unto whom God gives it.
They are blessed to serve the Perfect Guru. ||1||
All peace and comfort are in Your Name, God.

1148.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1148.t: aaTh pahar mere man gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
1148.e: Twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||
You shall receive the fruits of your desires,
when the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.
Meditating on the Lord, your comings and goings cease.

1148.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
1148.t: bhagat bhai prabh kee liv lai ||2||
1148.e: Through loving devotional worship, lovingly focus your attention on God. ||2||
Sexual desire, anger and egotism are dispelled.
Love and attachment to Maya are broken.

1148.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
1148.t: prabh kee Tek rahai dhin raat ||
1148.e: Lean on God's Support, day and night.
The Supreme Lord God has given this gift. ||3||
Our Lord and Master is the Creator, the Cause of causes.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts.
Bless me with Your Grace, Lord, and link me to Your service.
Slave Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||31||44||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1148.g: ਲਾਜ ਮਰੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
1148.t: laaj marai jo naam na levai ||
1148.e: One who does not repeat the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall die of shame.
Without the Name, how can he ever sleep in peace?

1148.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਚਾਹੈ ॥
1148.t: har simaran chhaadd param gat chaahai ||
1148.e: The mortal abandons meditative remembrance of the Lord, and then wishes for the state of supreme salvation;

1149.e: but without roots, how can there be any branches? ||1||
O my mind, meditate on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

1149.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1149.t: janam janam kee mail utaarai ba(n)dhan kaaT har sa(n)g milai ||1|| rahaau ||
1149.e: The filth of countless incarnations shall be washed away. Breaking your bonds, you shall be united with the Lord. ||1||Pause||
How can a stone be purified by bathing at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage?
The filth of egotism clings to the mind.
Millions of rituals and actions taken are the root of entanglements.

1149.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਪੂਲੁ ॥੨॥
1149.t: har ke bhajan bin birathaa pool ||2||
1149.e: Without meditating and vibrating on the Lord, the mortal gathers only worthless bundles of straw. ||2||
Without eating, hunger is not satisfied.
When the disease is cured, then the pain goes away.
The mortal is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment.

1149.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੩॥
1149.t: jin prabh keenaa so prabh nahee jaapiaa ||3||
1149.e: He does not meditate on God, that God who created him. ||3||

1149.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਧੰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
1149.t: dhan dhan saadh dha(n)n har naau ||
1149.e: Blessed, blessed is the Holy Saint, and blessed is the Name of the Lord.
Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Kirtan, the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Blessed is the devotee of the Lord, and blessed is the Creator Lord.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Primal, the Infinite. ||4||32||45||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
When the Guru was totally pleased, my fear was taken away.
I enshrine the Name of the Immaculate Lord within my mind.
He is Merciful to the meek, forever Compassionate.
All my entanglements are finished. ||1||
I have found peace, poise, and myriads of pleasures.

1149.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਭਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1149.t: saadhasa(n)g miTe bhai bharamaa a(n)mrit har har rasan bhane ||1|| rahaau ||
1149.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, fear and doubt are dispelled. My tongue chants the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
I have fallen in love with the Lord's Lotus Feet.
In an instant, the terrible demons are destroyed.

1149.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
1149.t: aaTh pahar har har jap jaap ||
1149.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
The Guru is Himself the Savior Lord, the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
He Himself cherishes His servant forever.
He watches over every breath of His humble devotee.
Tell me, what is the nature of human beings?

1149.g: ਜਮ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੩॥
1149.t: jam te raakhai dhe kar haath ||3||
1149.e: The Lord extends His Hand, and saves them from the Messenger of Death. ||3||
Immaculate is the Glory, and Immaculate is the way of life,
of those who remember the Supreme Lord God in their minds.
The Guru, in His Mercy, has granted this Gift.
Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||33||46||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
My Guru is the All-powerful Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.
He is the Soul, the Breath of Life, the Giver of Peace, always near.
He is the Destroyer of fear, the Eternal, Unchanging, Sovereign Lord King.
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all fear is dispelled. ||1||
Wherever I look, is the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

1149.g: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1149.t: bal bal jaiee satigur charanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1149.e: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
My tasks are perfectly accomplished, meeting the Divine Guru.
He is the Giver of all rewards. Serving Him, I am immaculate.
He reaches out with His Hand to His slaves.
The Name of the Lord abides in their hearts. ||2||
They are forever in bliss, and do not suffer at all.
No pain, sorrow or disease afflicts them.
Everything is Yours, O Creator Lord.
The Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Inaccessible and Infinite. ||3||
His Glorious Grandeur is immaculate, and the Bani of His Word is wonderful!
The Perfect Supreme Lord God is pleasing to my mind.
He is permeating the waters, the lands and the skies.

1149.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੭॥
1149.t: naanak sabh kichh prabh te hoi ||4||34||47||
1149.e: O Nanak, everything comes from God. ||4||34||47||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1149.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਰਣੇ ॥
1149.t: man tan raataa raam ra(n)g charane ||
1149.e: My mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Lord's Feet.

1150.e: All the desires of my mind have been perfectly fulfilled.
Twenty-four hours a day, I sing of the Lord God.
The True Guru has imparted this perfect wisdom. ||1||
Very fortunate are those who love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1150.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1150.t: tis kai sa(n)g tarai sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
1150.e: Associating with them, we cross over the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
They are spiritual teachers, who meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.
Wealthy are those who have a discriminating intellect.
Noble are those who remember their Lord and Master in meditation.
Honorable are those who understand their own selves. ||2||
By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status.
Day and night I meditate on the Glories of God.
My bonds are broken, and my hopes are fulfilled.

1150.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
1150.t: har ke charan ridh maeh nivaasaa ||3||
1150.e: The Feet of the Lord now abide in my heart. ||3||

1150.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
1150.t: kahu naanak jaa ke pooran karamaa ||
1150.e: Says Nanak, one whose karma is perfect

1150.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
1150.t: so jan aaiaa prabh kee saranaa ||
1150.e: that humble being enters the Sanctuary of God.
He himself is pure, and he sanctifies all.
His tongue chants the Name of the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||4||35||48||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1150.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
1150.t: naam lait kichh bighan na laagai ||
1150.e: Repeating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no obstacles block the way.
Listening to the Naam, the Messenger of Death runs far away.
Repeating the Naam, all pains vanish.
Chanting the Naam, the Lord's Lotus Feet dwell within. ||1||

1150.g: ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
1150.t: nirabighan bhagat bhaj har har naau ||
1150.e: Meditating, vibrating the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is unobstructed devotional worship.

1150.g: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1150.t: rasak rasak har ke gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
1150.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with loving affection and energy. ||1||Pause||

1150.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
1150.t: har simarat kichh chaakh na johai ||
1150.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the Eye of Death cannot see you.

1150.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੈਤ ਦੇਉ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥
1150.t: har simarat dhait dheau na pohai ||
1150.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, demons and ghosts shall not touch you.

1150.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਬਧੈ ॥
1150.t: har simarat moh maan na badhai ||
1150.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, attachment and pride shall not bind you.

1150.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਰੁਧੈ ॥੨॥
1150.t: har simarat garabh jon na rudhai ||2||
1150.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall not be consigned to the womb of reincarnation. ||2||
Any time is a good time to meditate in remembrance on the Lord.
Among the masses, only a few meditate in remembrance on the Lord.
Social class or no social class, anyone may meditate on the Lord.

1150.g: ਜੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
1150.t: jo jaapai tis kee gat hoi ||3||
1150.e: Whoever meditates on Him is emancipated. ||3||
Chant the Name of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1150.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
1150.t: har ke naam kaa pooran ra(n)g ||
1150.e: Perfect is the Love of the Lord's Name.
O God, shower Your Mercy on Nanak,
that he may think of you with each and every breath. ||4||36||49||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
He Himself is the Shaastras, and He Himself is the Vedas.
He knows the secrets of each and every heart.

1150.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ॥
1150.t: jot saroop jaa kee sabh vath ||
1150.e: He is the Embodiment of Light; all beings belong to Him.
The Creator, the Cause of causes, the Perfect All-powerful Lord. ||1||

1150.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
1150.t: prabh kee oT gahahu man mere ||
1150.e: Grab hold of the Support of God, O my mind.

1150.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1150.t: charan kamal gurmukh aaraadhahu dhusaman dhookh na aavai nere ||1|| rahaau ||
1150.e: As Gurmukh, worship and adore His Lotus Feet; enemies and pains shall not even approach you. ||1||Pause||
He Himself is the Essence of the forests and fields, and all the three worlds.
The universe is strung on His Thread.
He is the Uniter of Shiva and Shakti - mind and matter.
He Himself is in the detachment of Nirvaanaa, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. ||2||

1150.g: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
1150.t: jat kat pekhau tat tat soi ||
1150.e: Wherever I look, there He is.
Without Him, there is no one at all.
In the Love of the Naam, the world-ocean is crossed.
Nanak sings His Glorious Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

1150.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
1150.t: mukat bhugat jugat vas jaa kai ||
1150.e: Liberation, the ways and means of enjoyment and union are under His Control.

1150.g: ਊਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
1150.t: uoonaa naahee kichh jan taa kai ||
1150.e: His humble servant lacks nothing.
That person, with whom the Lord, in His Mercy, is pleased
- O slave Nanak, that humble servant is blessed. ||4||37||50||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The minds of the Lord's devotee are filled with bliss.
They become stable and permanent, and all their anxiety is gone.

1151.g: ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1151.t: bhai bhram binas ge khin maeh ||
1151.e: Their fears and doubts are dispelled in an instant.
The Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in their minds. ||1||
The Lord is forever the Help and Support of the Saints.

1151.g: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1151.t: ghar baahar naale paramesar rav rahiaa pooran sabh Thai ||1|| rahaau ||
1151.e: Inside the home of the heart, and outside as well, the Transcendent Lord is always with us, permeating and pervading all places. ||1||Pause||
The Lord of the World is my wealth, property, youth and ways and means.
He continually cherishes and brings peace to my soul and breath of life.

1151.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
1151.t: apane dhaas kau dhe raakhai haath ||
1151.e: He reaches out with His Hand and saves His slave.

1151.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥ ॥੨॥
1151.t: nimakh na chhoddai sadh hee saath ||2||
1151.e: He does not abandon us, even for an instant; He is always with us. ||2||

1151.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
1151.t: har saa preetam avar na koi ||
1151.e: There is no other Beloved like the Lord.
The True Lord takes care of all.
The Lord is our Mother, Father, Son and Relation.
Since the beginning of time, and throughout the ages, His devotees sing His Glorious Praises. ||3||

1151.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
1151.t: tis kee dhar prabh kaa man jor ||
1151.e: My mind is filled with the Support and the Power of the Lord.
Without the Lord, there is no other at all.
Nanak's mind is encouraged by this hope,
that God will accomplish my objectives in life. ||4||38||51||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

1151.g: ਭੈ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਪੜਿਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
1151.t: bhai kau bhau paRiaa simarat har naam ||
1151.e: Fear itself becomes afraid, when the mortal remembers the Lord's Name in meditation.

1151.g: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1151.t: sagal biaadh miTee tirahu gun kee dhaas ke hoe pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1151.e: All the diseases of the three gunas - the three qualities - are cured, and tasks of the Lord's slaves are perfectly accomplished. ||1||Pause||

1151.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਾਮ ॥
1151.t: har ke lok sadhaa gun gaaveh tin kau miliaa pooran dhaam ||
1151.e: The people of the Lord always sing His Glorious Praises; they attain His Perfect Mansion.

1151.g: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
1151.t: jan kaa dharas baa(n)chhai dhin raatee hoi puneet dharam rai jaam ||1||
1151.e: Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma and the Messenger of Death yearn, day and night, to be sanctified by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

1151.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
1151.t: kaam karodh lobh madh ni(n)dhaa saadhasa(n)g miTiaa abhimaan ||
1151.e: Sexual desire, anger, intoxication, egotism, slander and egotistical pride are eradicted in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1151.g: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਹਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੫੨॥
1151.t: aaise sa(n)t bheTeh vaddabhaagee naanak tin kai sadh kurabaan ||2||39||52||
1151.e: By great good fortune, such Saints are met. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||2||39||52||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
One who harbors the five thieves, becomes the embodiment of these five.
He gets up each day and tells lies.
He applies ceremonial religious marks to his body, but practices hypocrisy.

1151.g: ਝੁਰਿ ਝੁਰਿ ਪਚੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਡ ॥੧॥
1151.t: jhur jhur pachai jaise tria ra(n)dd ||1||
1151.e: He wastes away in sadness and pain, like a lonely widow. ||1||

1151.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭ ਝੂਠੁ ॥
1151.t: har ke naam binaa sabh jhooTh ||
1151.e: Without the Name of the Lord, everything is false.

1151.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਠੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1151.t: bin gur poore mukat na paieeaai saachee dharageh saakat mooTh ||1|| rahaau ||
