1151.e: Without the Perfect Guru, liberation is not obtained. In the Court of the True Lord, the faithless cynic is plundered. ||1||Pause||
One who does not know the Lord's Creative Power is polluted.

1151.g: ਲੀਪਿਐ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
1151.t: leepiaai thai na such har maanai ||
1151.e: Ritualistically plastering one's kitchen square does not make it pure in the Eyes of the Lord.
If a person is polluted within, he may wash himself everyday on the outside,
but in the Court of the True Lord, he forfeits his honor. ||2||
He works for the sake of Maya,
but he never places his feet on the right path.

1151.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਣੈ ॥
1151.t: jin keeaa tis cheet na aanai ||
1151.e: He never even remembers the One who created him.
He speaks falsehood, only falsehood, with his mouth. ||3||
That person, unto whom the Creator Lord shows Mercy,
deals with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1151.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
1151.t: har naam bhagat siau laagaa ra(n)g ||
1151.e: One who lovingly worships the Lord's Name,

1151.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੫੩॥
1151.t: kahu naanak tis jan nahee bha(n)g ||4||40||53||
1151.e: says Nanak - no obstacles ever block his way. ||4||40||53||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The entire universe curses the slanderer.
False are the dealings of the slanderer.
The slanderer's lifestyle is filthy and polluted.
The Lord is the Saving Grace and the Protector of His slave. ||1||
The slanderer dies with the rest of the slanderers.

1151.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕੜਕਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1151.t: paarabraham paramesar jan raakhe ni(n)dhak kai sir kaRakio kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
1151.e: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, protects and saves His humble servant. Death roars and thunders over the head of the slanderer. ||1||Pause||

1152.g: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
1152.t: ni(n)dhak kaa kahiaa koi na maanai ||
1152.e: No one belives what the slanderer says.
The slanderer tells lies, and later regrets and repents.
He wrings his hands, and hits his head against the ground.
The Lord does not forgive the slanderer. ||2||

1152.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
1152.t: har kaa dhaas kichh buraa na maagai ||
1152.e: The Lord's slave does not wish anyone ill.
The slanderer suffers, as if stabbed by a spear.
Like a crane, he spreads his feathers, to look like a swan.

1152.g: ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਕਢਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
1152.t: mukh te boliaa taa(n) kaddiaa beechaar ||3||
1152.e: When he speaks with his mouth, then he is exposed and driven out. ||3||
The Creator is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

1152.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1152.t: har jan karai su nihachal hoi ||
1152.e: That person, whom the Lord makes His Own, becomes stable and steady.
The Lord's slave is true in the Court of the Lord.
Servant Nanak speaks, after contemplating the essence of reality. ||4||41||54||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer.

1152.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
1152.t: jeeau pi(n)dd dhan tis kee raas ||
1152.e: My soul, body and wealth are His property.
He is the Creator, my Lord and Master.
Millions of times, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
The dust of the feet of the Holy brings purity.

1152.g: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1152.t: man ke bikaar miTeh prabh simarat janam janam kee mail haree ||1|| rahaau ||
1152.e: Remembering God in meditation, the mind's corruption is eradicated, and the filth of countless incarnations is washed away. ||1||Pause||

1152.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
1152.t: jaa kai gireh meh sagal nidhaan ||
1152.e: All treasures are in His household.
Serving Him, the mortal attains honor.
He is the Fulfiller of the mind's desires.
He is the Support of the soul and the breath of life of His devotees. ||2||
His Light shines in each and every heart.
Chanting and meditating on God, the Treasure of Virtue, His devotees live.

1152.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
1152.t: jaa kee sev na birathee jai ||
1152.e: Service to Him does not go in vain.
Deep within your mind and body, meditate on the One Lord. ||3||
Following the Guru's Teachings, compassion and contentment are found.
This Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the immaculate object.
Please grant Your Grace, O Lord, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.
Nanak meditates continually on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||4||42||55||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The True Guru has listened to my prayer.
All my affairs have been resolved.
Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on God.
The Perfect Guru has dispelled all my fears. ||1||
The All-powerful Divine Guru is the Greatest of all.

1152.g: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1152.t: sabh sukh paiee tis kee sev || rahaau ||
1152.e: Serving Him, I obtain all comforts. ||Pause||

1152.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1152.t: jaa kaa keeaa sabh kichh hoi ||
1152.e: Everything is done by Him.

1152.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
1152.t: tis kaa amar na meTai koi ||
1152.e: No one can erase His Eternal Decree.
The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is incomparably beautiful.

1152.g: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੨॥
1152.t: safal moorat gur tis kaa roop ||2||
1152.e: The Guru is the Image of Fulfillment, the Embodiment of the Lord. ||2||

1152.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
1152.t: jaa kai a(n)tar basai har naam ||
1152.e: The Name of the Lord abides deep within him.

1152.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪੇਖੈ ਸੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
1152.t: jo jo pekhai su braham giaan ||
1152.e: Wherever he looks, he sees the Wisdom of God.

1152.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸੁਏ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
1152.t: bees bisue jaa kai man paragaas ||
1152.e: His mind is totally enlightened and illuminated.

1152.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
1152.t: tis jan kai paarabraham kaa nivaas ||3||
1152.e: Within that person, the Supreme Lord God abides. ||3||

1152.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
1152.t: tis gur kau sadh karee namasakaar ||
1152.e: I humbly bow to that Guru forever.

1152.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਜਾਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
1152.t: tis gur kau sadh jaau balihaar ||
1152.e: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru.

1152.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
1152.t: satigur ke charan dhoi dhoi peevaa ||
1152.e: I wash the feet of the Guru, and drink in this water.

1152.g: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੬॥
1152.t: gur naanak jap jap sadh jeevaa ||4||43||56||
1152.e: Chanting and meditating forever on Guru Nanak, I live. ||4||43||56||

1153.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੩
1153.t: raag bhairau mahalaa panjavaa paRataal ghar teejaa
1153.e: Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehla, Partaal, Third House:

1153.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1153.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1153.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1153.g: ਪਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਨੀ ॥
1153.t: paratipaal prabh kirapaal kavan gun ganee ||
1153.e: God is the Compassionate Cherisher. Who can count His Glorious Virtues?

1153.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਬਹੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1153.t: anik ra(n)g bahu tara(n)g sarab ko dhanee ||1|| rahaau ||
1153.e: Countless colors, and countless waves of joy; He is the Master of all. ||1||Pause||

1153.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਾਪ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ॥
1153.t: anik giaan anik dhiaan anik jaap jaap taap ||
1153.e: Endless spiritual wisdom, endless meditations, endless chants, intense meditations and austere self-disciplines.

1153.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨਿਤ ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਰ ਮੁਨੀ ॥੧॥
1153.t: anik gunit dhunit lalit anik dhaar munee ||1||
1153.e: Countless virtues, musical notes and playful sports; countless silent sages enshrine Him in their hearts. ||1||

1153.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਜ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਅਨਿਕ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖ ਅਨਿਕ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਜਸ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
1153.t: anik naadh anik baaj nimakh nimakh anik savaiaadh anik dhokh anik rog miTeh jas sunee ||
1153.e: Countless melodies, countless instruments, countless tastes, each and every instant. Countless mistakes and countless diseases are removed by hearing His Praise.

1153.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੇਵ ਤਟਹ ਖਟਹ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਗਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਜਾਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਨ ਸਗਲ ਫਲ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੭॥੮॥੨੧॥੭॥੫੭॥੯੩॥
1153.t: naanak sev apaar dhev taTeh khaTeh barat poojaa gavan bhavan jaatr karan sagal fal punee ||2||1||57||8||21||7||57||93||
1153.e: O Nanak, serving the Infinite, Divine Lord, one earns all the rewards and merits of performing the six rituals, fasts, worship services, pilgrimages to sacred rivers, and journeys to sacred shrines. ||2||1||57||8||21||7||57||93||

1153.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨
1153.t: bhairau asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa
1153.e: Bhairao, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla, Second House:

1153.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1153.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1153.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1153.g: ਆਤਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1153.t: aatam meh raam raam meh aatam cheenas gur beechaaraa ||
1153.e: The Lord is in the soul, and the soul is in the Lord. This is realized through the Guru's Teachings.

1153.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਉ ਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
1153.t: a(n)mirat baanee sabadh pachhaanee dhukh kaaTai hau maaraa ||1||
1153.e: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani is realized through the Word of the Shabad. Sorrow is dispelled, and egotism is eliminated. ||1||

1153.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਬੁਰੇ ॥
1153.t: naanak haumai rog bure ||
1153.e: O Nanak, the disease of egotism is so very deadly.

1153.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਹ ਏਕਾ ਬੇਦਨ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧੁਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1153.t: jeh dhekhaa(n) teh ekaa bedhan aape bakhasai sabadh dhure ||1|| rahaau ||
1153.e: Wherever I look, I see the pain of the same disease. The Primal Lord Himself bestows the Shabad of His Word. ||1||Pause||

1153.g: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸੂਲਾਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1153.t: aape parakhe parakhanahaarai bahur soolaak na hoiee ||
1153.e: When the Appraiser Himself appraises the mortal, then he is not tested again.

1153.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਭਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
1153.t: jin kau nadhar bhiee gur mele prabh bhaanaa sach soiee ||2||
1153.e: Those who are blessed with His Grace meet with the Guru. They alone are true, who are pleasing to God. ||2||

1153.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭੋਗੀ ॥
1153.t: paun paanee baisa(n)tar rogee rogee dharat sabhogee ||
1153.e: Air, water and fire are diseased; the world with its enjoyments is diseased.

1153.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਹ ਸਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥੩॥
1153.t: maat pitaa maiaa dheh s rogee rogee kuTa(n)b sa(n)jogee ||3||
1153.e: Mother, father, Maya and the body are diseased; those united with their relatives are diseased. ||3||

1153.g: ਰੋਗੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਸਰੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
1153.t: rogee brahamaa bisan sarudhraa rogee sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
1153.e: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are diseased; the whole world is diseased.

1153.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
1153.t: har padh cheen bhe se mukate gur kaa sabadh veechaaraa ||4||
1153.e: Those who remember the Lord's Feet and contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are liberated. ||4||

1153.g: ਰੋਗੀ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਨਦੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੇ ॥
1153.t: rogee saat samu(n)dh sanadheeaa kha(n)dd pataal s rog bhare ||
1153.e: The seven seas are diseased, along with the rivers; the continents and the nether regions of the underworlds are full of disease.

1153.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਸਰਬੀ ਥਾਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੫॥
1153.t: har ke lok s saach suhele sarabee thaiee nadhar kare ||5||
1153.e: The people of the Lord dwell in Truth and peace; He blesses them with His Grace everywhere. ||5||

1153.g: ਰੋਗੀ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਾ ਹਠੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
1153.t: rogee khaT dharasan bhekhadhaaree naanaa haThee anekaa ||
1153.e: The six Shaastras are diseased, as are the many who follow the different religious orders.

1153.g: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਹ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਨਹ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਇਕ ਏਕਾ ॥੬॥
1153.t: bedh kateb kareh keh bapure neh boojheh ik ekaa ||6||
1153.e: What can the poor Vedas and Bibles do? People do not understand the One and Only Lord. ||6||

1153.g: ਮਿਠ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ਸੁ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1153.t: miTh ras khai su rog bhareejai ka(n)dh mool sukh naahee ||
1153.e: Eating sweet treats, the mortal is filled with disease; he finds no peace at all.

1153.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
1153.t: naam visaar chaleh an maarag a(n)t kaal pachhutaahee ||7||
1153.e: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they walk on other paths, and at the very last moment, they regret and repent. ||7||

1153.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪੜਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
1153.t: teerath bharamai rog na chhooTas paRiaa baadh bibaadh bhiaa ||
1153.e: Wandering around at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the mortal is not cured of his disease. Reading scripture, he gets involved in useless arguments.

1153.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਵਡੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੮॥
1153.t: dhubidhaa rogu su adhik vadderaa maiaa kaa muhataaj bhiaa ||8||
1153.e: The disease of duality is so very deadly; it causes dependence on Maya. ||8||

1153.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
1153.t: gurmukh saachaa sabadh salaahai man saachaa tis rog giaa ||
1153.e: One who becomes Gurmukh and praises the True Shabad with the True Lord in his mind is cured of his disease.

1153.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥੧॥
1153.t: naanak har jan anadhin niramal jin kau karam neesaan piaa ||9||1||
1153.e: O Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is immaculate, night and day; he bears the insignia of the Lord's Grace. ||9||1||

1154.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Creator has staged His Wondrous Play.
I listen to the Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, and the Bani of His Word.
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded and confused, while the Gurmukhs understand.
The Creator creates the Cause that causes. ||1||

1154.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
1154.t: gur kaa sabadh merai a(n)tar dhiaan ||
1154.e: Deep within my being, I meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1154.g: ਹਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1154.t: hau kabahu na chhoddau har kaa naam ||1|| rahaau ||
1154.e: I shall never forsake the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Prahlaad's father sent him to school, to learn to read.
He took his writing tablet and went to the teacher.
He said, ""I shall not read anything except the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1154.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
1154.t: meree paTeeaa likh dheh gobi(n)dh muraar ||2||
1154.e: Write the Lord's Name on my tablet.""||2||
Prahlaad's mother said to her son,
"I advise you not to read anything except what you are taught."

1154.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1154.t: nirabhau dhaataa har jeeau merai naal ||
1154.e: He answered, ""The Great Giver, my Fearless Lord God is always with me.

1154.g: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਉ ਤਉ ਕੁਲਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
1154.t: je har chhoddau tau kul laagai gaal ||3||
1154.e: If I were to forsake the Lord, then my family would be disgraced.""||3||
"Prahlaad has corrupted all the other students.

1154.g: ਹਮਾਰਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
1154.t: hamaaraa kahiaa na sunai aapane kaaraj savaare ||
1154.e: He does not listen to what I say, and he does his own thing.
He instigated devotional worship in the townspeople.""

1154.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੪॥
1154.t: dhusaT sabhaa kaa kichh na vasaiee ||4||
1154.e: The gathering of the wicked people could not do anything against him. ||4||
Sanda and Marka, his teachers, made the complaint.
All the demons kept trying in vain.

1154.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
1154.t: bhagat janaa kee pat raakhai soiee ||
1154.e: The Lord protected His humble devotee, and preserved his honor.
What can be done by mere created beings? ||5||
Because of his past karma, the demon ruled over his kingdom.

1154.g: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
1154.t: har na boojhai tin aap bhulaiaa ||
1154.e: He did not realize the Lord; the Lord Himself confused him.
He started an argument with his son Prahlaad.

1154.g: ਅੰਧਾ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੬॥
1154.t: a(n)dhaa na boojhai kaal neRai aaiaa ||6||
1154.e: The blind one did not understand that his death was approaching. ||6||

1154.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਕੋਠੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬਾਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
1154.t: prahalaadh koThe vich raakhiaa baar dheeaa taalaa ||
1154.e: Prahlaad was placed in a cell, and the door was locked.

1154.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਡਰਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
1154.t: nirabhau baalak mool na ddariee merai a(n)tar gur gopaalaa ||
1154.e: The fearless child was not afraid at all. He said, ""Within my being, is the Guru, the Lord of the World.""

1154.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਰੀਕੀ ਕਰੈ ਅਨਹੋਦਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ ॥
1154.t: keetaa hovai sareekee karai anahodhaa naau dharaiaa ||
1154.e: The created being tried to compete with his Creator, but he assumed this name in vain.

1154.g: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋੁ ਆਇ ਪਹੁਤਾ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
1154.t: jo dhur likhiaa suo aai pahutaa jan siau vaadh rachaiaa ||7||
1154.e: That which was predestined for him has come to pass; he started an argument with the Lord's humble servant. ||7||
The father raised the club to strike down Prahlaad, saying,
"Where is your God, the Lord of the Universe, now?"
He replied, ""The Life of the World, the Great Giver, is my Help and Support in the end.
Wherever I look, I see Him permeating and prevailing.""||8||
Tearing down the pillars, the Lord Himself appeared.
The egotistical demon was killed and destroyed.
The minds of the devotees were filled with bliss, and congratulations poured in.
He blessed His servant with glorious greatness. ||9||
He created birth, death and attachment.
The Creator has ordained coming and going in reincarnation.

1154.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
1154.t: prahalaadh kai kaaraj har aap dhikhaiaa ||
1154.e: For the sake of Prahlaad, the Lord Himself appeared.
The word of the devotee came true. ||10||

1154.g: ਦੇਵ ਕੁਲੀ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
1154.t: dhev kulee lakhimee kau kareh jaikaar ||
1154.e: The gods proclaimed the victory of Lakshmi, and said,
"O mother, make this form of the Man-lion disappear!"

1154.g: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਭਉ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
1154.t: lakhimee bhau karai na saakai jai ||
1154.e: Lakshmi was afraid, and did not approach.

1155.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਆਇ ॥੧੧॥
1155.t: prahalaadh jan charanee laagaa aai ||11||
1155.e: The humble servant Prahlaad came and fell at the Lord's Feet. ||11||

1155.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
1155.t: satigur naam nidhaan dhiraRaiaa ||
1155.e: The True Guru implanted the treasure of the Naam within.

1155.g: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਝੂਠੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1155.t: raaj maal jhooThee sabh maiaa ||
1155.e: Power, property and all Maya is false.

1155.g: ਲੋਭੀ ਨਰ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
1155.t: lobhee nar rahe lapaTai ||
1155.e: But still, the greedy people continue clinging to them.

1155.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
1155.t: har ke naam bin dharageh milai sajai ||12||
1155.e: Without the Name of the Lord, the mortals are punished in His Court. ||12||

1155.g: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
1155.t: kahai naanak sabh ko kare karaiaa ||
1155.e: Says Nanak, everyone acts as the Lord makes them act.

1155.g: ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
1155.t: se paravaan jinee har siau chit laiaa ||
1155.e: They alone are approved and accepted, who focus their consciousness on the Lord.

1155.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
1155.t: bhagataa kaa a(n)geekaar karadhaa aaiaa ||
1155.e: He has made His devotees His Own.

1155.g: ਕਰਤੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥੧॥੨॥
1155.t: karatai apanaa roop dhikhaiaa ||13||1||2||
1155.e: The Creator has appeared in His Own Form. ||13||1||2||

1155.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1155.t: bhairau mahalaa teejaa ||
1155.e: Bhairao, Third Mehla:

1155.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1155.t: gur sevaa te a(n)mirat fal paiaa haumai tirasan bujhaiee ||
1155.e: Serving the Guru, I obtain the Ambrosial Fruit; my egotism and desire have been quenched.

1155.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
1155.t: har kaa naam hiradhai man vasiaa manasaa maneh samaiee ||1||
1155.e: The Name of the Lord dwells within my heart and mind, and the desires of my mind are quieted. ||1||

1155.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
1155.t: har jeeau kirapaa karahu mere piaare ||
1155.e: O Dear Lord, my Beloved, please bless me with Your Mercy.

1155.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਦੀਨ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1155.t: anadhin har gun dheen jan maa(n)gai gur kai sabadh udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
1155.e: Night and day, Your humble servant begs for Your Glorious Praises; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is saved. ||1||Pause||

1155.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਰਤੀ ਅੰਚ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
1155.t: sa(n)t janaa kau jam joh na saakai ratee a(n)ch dhookh na laiee ||
1155.e: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch the humble Saints; it does not cause them even an iota of suffering or pain.

1155.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
1155.t: aap tareh sagale kul taareh jo teree saranaiee ||2||
1155.e: Those who enter Your Sanctuary, Lord, save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well. ||2||

1155.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1155.t: bhagataa kee paij rakheh too aape eh teree vaddiaaiee ||
1155.e: You Yourself save the honor of Your devotees; this is Your Glory, O Lord.

1155.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰਤੀ ਨ ਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
1155.t: janam janam ke kilavikh dhukh kaaTeh dhubidhaa ratee na raiee ||3||
1155.e: You cleanse them of the sins and the pains of countless incarnations; You love them without even an iota of duality. ||3||

1155.g: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1155.t: ham mooR mugadh kichh boojheh naahee too aape dheh bujhaiee ||
1155.e: I am foolish and ignorant, and understand nothing. You Yourself bless me with understanding.

1155.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
1155.t: jo tudh bhaavai soiee karasee avar na karanaa jaiee ||4||
1155.e: You do whatever You please; nothing else can be done at all. ||4||

1155.g: ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਭੂੰਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
1155.t: jagat upai tudh dha(n)dhai laiaa bhoo(n)ddee kaar kamaiee ||
1155.e: Creating the world, You have linked all to their tasks - even the evil deeds which men do.

1155.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
1155.t: janam padhaarath jooaai haariaa sabadhai surat na paiee ||5||
1155.e: They lose this precious human life in the gamble, and do not understand the Word of the Shabad. ||5||

1155.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
1155.t: manmukh mareh tin kichhoo na soojhai dhuramat agiaan a(n)dhaaraa ||
1155.e: The self-willed manmukhs die, understanding nothing; they are enveloped by the darkness of evil-mindedness and ignorance.

1155.g: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
1155.t: bhavajal paar na paaveh kab hee ddoob mue bin gur sir bhaaraa ||6||
1155.e: They do not cross over the terrible world-ocean; without the Guru, they drown and die. ||6||

1155.g: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
1155.t: saachai sabadh rate jan saache har prabh aap milaae ||
1155.e: True are those humble beings who are imbued with the True Shabad; the Lord God unites them with Himself.

1155.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
1155.t: gur kee baanee sabadh pachhaatee saach rahe liv laae ||7||
1155.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, they come to understand the Shabad. They remain lovingly focused on the True Lord. ||7||

1155.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
1155.t: too(n) aap niramal tere jan hai niramal gur kai sabadh veechaare ||
1155.e: You Yourself are Immaculate and Pure, and pure are Your humble servants who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1155.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
1155.t: naanak tin kai sadh balihaarai raam naam ur dhaare ||8||2||3||
1155.e: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those, who enshrine the Lord's Name within their hearts. ||8||2||3||

1155.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨
1155.t: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa ghar doojaa
1155.e: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

1155.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1155.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1155.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1155.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
1155.t: jis naam ridhai soiee vadd raajaa ||
1155.e: He alone is a great king, who keeps the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within his heart.

1155.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
1155.t: jis naam ridhai tis poore kaajaa ||
1155.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart - his tasks are perfectly accomplished.

1155.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਧਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
1155.t: jis naam ridhai tin koT dhan paae ||
1155.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, obtains millions of treasures.

1155.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
1155.t: naam binaa janam birathaa jaae ||1||
1155.e: Without the Naam, life is useless. ||1||

1155.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
1155.t: tis saalaahee jis har dhan raas ||
1155.e: I praise that person, who has the capital of the Lord's Wealth.

1155.g: ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1155.t: so vaddabhaagee jis gur masatak haath ||1|| rahaau ||
1155.e: He is very fortunate, on whose forehead the Guru has placed His Hand. ||1||Pause||

1155.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋਟ ਕਈ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
1155.t: jis naam ridhai tis koT kiee sainaa ||
1155.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, has many millions of armies on his side.

1155.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੈਨਾ ॥
1155.t: jis naam ridhai tis sahaj sukhainaa ||
1155.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, enjoys peace and poise.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai so seetal hooaa ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart becomes cool and calm.
Without the Naam, both life and death are cursed. ||2||

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai so jeevan mukataa ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai tis sabh hee jugataa ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart knows all ways and means.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai tin nau nidh paiee ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart obtains the nine treasures.
Without the Naam, the mortal wanders, coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||
One who keeps the Naam in his heart is carefree and independent.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai tis sadh hee laahaa ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart always earns a profit.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai tis vadd paravaaraa ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart has a large family.
Without the Naam, the mortal is just an ignorant, self-willed manmukh. ||4||

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai tis nihachal aasan ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart has a permanent position.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਨੁ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai tis takhat nivaasan ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is seated on the throne.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai so saachaa saahu ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the true king.
Without the Naam, no one has any honor or respect. ||5||

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai so sabh meh jaataa ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is famous everywhere.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai so purakh bidhaataa ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the Embodiment of the Creator Lord.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai so sabh te uoochaa ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the highest of all.
Without the Naam, the mortal wanders in reincarnation. ||6||

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਪਹਾਰਾ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai tis pragaT pahaaraa ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart sees the Lord manifested in His Creation.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai tis miTiaa a(n)dhaaraa ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart - his darkness is dispelled.

1156.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
1156.t: jis naam ridhai so purakh paravaan ||
1156.e: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is approved and accepted.
Without the Naam, the mortal continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||7||

1156.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
1156.t: tin naam paiaa jis bhio kirapaal ||
1156.e: He alone receives the Naam, who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord of the World is understood.
Coming and going in reincarnation ends, and peace is found.
Says Nanak, my essence has merged in the Essence of the Lord. ||8||1||4||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
He created millions of incarnations of Vishnu.
He created millions of universes as places to practice righteousness.
He created and destroyed millions of Shivas.
He employed millions of Brahmas to create the worlds. ||1||
Such is my Lord and Master, the Lord of the Universe.

1156.g: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1156.t: baran na saakau gun bisathaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
1156.e: I cannot even describe His Many Virtues. ||1||Pause||
Millions of Mayas are His maid-servants.
Millions of souls are His beds.
Millions of universes are the limbs of His Being.
Millions of devotees abide with the Lord. ||2||
Millions of kings with their crowns and canopies bow before Him.
Millions of Indras stand at His Door.

1156.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1156.t: koT baiku(n)Th jaa kee dhirasaTee maeh ||
1156.e: Millions of heavenly paradises are within the scope of His Vision.

1156.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
1156.t: koT naam jaa kee keemat naeh ||3||
1156.e: Millions of His Names cannot even be appraised. ||3||

1156.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਰੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਦ ॥
1156.t: koT pooreeat hai jaa kai naadh ||
1156.e: Millions of celestial sounds resound for Him.
His Wondrous Plays are enacted on millions of stages.
Millions of Shaktis and Shivas are obedient to Him.
He gives sustenance and support to millions of beings. ||4||

1156.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਝਾਰ ॥
1156.t: koT teerath jaa ke charan majhaar ||
1156.e: In His Feet are millions of sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Millions chant His Sacred and Beautiful Name.
Millions of worshippers worship Him.
Millions of expanses are His; there is no other at all. ||5||

1156.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸ ॥
1156.t: koT mahimaa jaa kee niramal ha(n)s ||
1156.e: Millions of swan-souls sing His Immaculate Praises.

1156.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਸ ॥
1156.t: koT usatat jaa kee karat brahama(n)s ||
1156.e: Millions of Brahma's sons sing His Praises.
He creates and destroys millions, in an instant.

1156.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਣੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
1156.t: koT gunaa tere gane na jaeh ||6||
1156.e: Millions are Your Virtues, Lord - they cannot even be counted. ||6||
Millions of spiritual teachers teach His spiritual wisdom.
Millions of meditators focus on His meditation.
Millions of austere penitents practice austerities.

1157.e: Millions of silent sages dwell in silence. ||7||

1157.g: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
1157.t: avigat naath agochar suaamee || poor rahiaa ghaT a(n)tarajaamee ||
1157.e: Our Eternal, Imperishable, Incomprehensible Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is permeating all hearts.
Wherever I look, I see Your Dwelling, O Lord.
The Guru has blessed Nanak with enlightenment. ||8||2||5||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The True Guru has blessed me with this gift.
He has given me the Priceless Jewel of the Lord's Name.
Now, I intuitively enjoy endless pleasures and wondrous play.
God has spontaneously met with Nanak. ||1||
Says Nanak, True is the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise.

1157.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਚੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1157.t: bahur bahur tis sa(n)g man raachee ||1|| rahaau ||
1157.e: Again and again, my mind remains immersed in it. ||1||Pause||
Spontaneously, I feed on the Love of God.
Spontaneously, I take God's Name.
Spontaneously, I am saved by the Word of the Shabad.
Spontaneously, my treasures are filled to overflowing. ||2||
Spontaneously, my works are perfectly accomplished.
Spontaneously, I am rid of sorrow.
Spontaneously, my enemies have become friends.

1157.g: ਅਚਿੰਤੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
1157.t: achi(n)to hee ih man vas keetaa ||3||
1157.e: Spontaneously, I have brought my mind under control. ||3||
Spontaneously, God has comforted me.
Spontaneously, my hopes have been fulfilled.
Spontaneously, I have totally realized the essence of reality.

1157.g: ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
1157.t: achi(n)t ham kau gur dheeno ma(n)t ||4||
1157.e: Spontaneously, I have been blessed with the Guru's Mantra. ||4||
Spontaneously, I am rid of hatred.
Spontaneously, my darkness has been dispelled.
Spontaneously, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise seems so sweet to my mind.

1157.g: ਅਚਿੰਤੋ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੫॥
1157.t: achi(n)to hee prabh ghaT ghaT ddeeThaa ||5||
1157.e: Spontaneously, I behold God in each and every heart. ||5||
Spontaneously, all my doubts have been dispelled.
Spontaneously, peace and celestial harmony fill my mind.
Spontaneously, the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current resounds within me.
Spontaneously, the Lord of the Universe has revealed Himself to me. ||6||
Spontaneously, my mind has been pleased and appeased.
I have spontaneously realized the Eternal, Unchanging Lord.
Spontaneously, all wisdom and knowledge has welled up within me.

1157.g: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਚਰੀ ਹਥਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥੭॥
1157.t: achi(n)t charee hath har har Tekaa ||7||
1157.e: Spontaneously, the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, has come into my hands. ||7||
Spontaneously, God has recorded my pre-ordained destiny.
Spontaneously, the One Lord and Master God has met me.
Spontaneously, all my cares and worries have been taken away.
Nanak, Nanak, Nanak, has merged into the Image of God. ||8||3||6||

1157.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਘਰੁ ੧
1157.t: bhairau baanee bhagataa kee || kabeer jeeau ghar pehilaa
1157.e: Bhairao, The Word Of The Devotees, Kabeer Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1157.g: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
1157.t: eih dhan mere har ko naau ||
1157.e: The Name of the Lord - this alone is my wealth.

1157.g: ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਬਾਧਉ ਬੇਚਿ ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1157.t: gaa(n)Th na baadhau bech na khaau ||1|| rahaau ||
1157.e: I do not tie it up to hide it, nor do I sell it to make my living. ||1||Pause||

1157.g: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਰੀ ॥
1157.t: naau mere khetee naau mere baaree ||
1157.e: The Name is my crop, and the Name is my field.
As Your humble servant, I perform devotional worship to You; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

1157.g: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂੰਜੀ ॥
1157.t: naau mere maiaa naau mere poo(n)jee ||
1157.e: The Name is Maya and wealth for me; the Name is my capital.
I do not forsake You; I do not know any other at all. ||2||

1157.g: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
1157.t: naau mere ba(n)dhip naau mere bhaiee ||
1157.e: The Name is my family, the Name is my brother.

1157.g: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
1157.t: naau mere sa(n)g a(n)t hoi sakhaiee ||3||
1157.e: The Name is my companion, who will help me in the end. ||3||
One whom the Lord keeps detached from Maya

1157.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
1157.t: keh kabeer hau taa ko dhaas ||4||1||
1157.e: - says Kabeer, I am his slave. ||4||1||
Naked we come, and naked we go.
No one, not even the kings and queens, shall remain. ||1||

1158.e: The Sovereign Lord is the nine treasures for me.

1158.g: ਸੰਪੈ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1158.t: sa(n)pai het kalat dhan terai ||1|| rahaau ||
1158.e: The possessions and the spouse to which the mortal is lovingly attached, are Your wealth, O Lord. ||1||Pause||
They do not come with the mortal, and they do not go with him.
What good does it do him, if he has elephants tied up at his doorway? ||2||
The fortress of Sri Lanka was made out of gold,
but what could the foolish Raawan take with him when he left? ||3||
Says Kabeer, think of doing some good deeds.
In the end, the gambler shall depart empty-handed. ||4||2||
Brahma is polluted, and Indra is polluted.
The sun is polluted, and the moon is polluted. ||1||
This world is polluted with pollution.

1158.g: ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1158.t: eik har niramal jaa kaa a(n)t na paar ||1|| rahaau ||
1158.e: Only the One Lord is Immaculate; He has no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||
The rulers of kingdoms are polluted.
Nights and days, and the days of the month are polluted. ||2||
The pearl is polluted, the diamond is polluted.
Wind, fire and water are polluted. ||3||
Shiva, Shankara and Mahaysh are polluted.
The Siddhas, seekers and strivers, and those who wear religious robes, are polluted. ||4||
The Yogis and wandering hermits with their matted hair are polluted.
The body, along with the swan-soul, is polluted. ||5||

1158.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨ ॥੬॥੩॥
1158.t: keh kabeer te jan paravaan || niramal te jo raameh jaan ||6||3||
1158.e: Says Kabeer, those humble beings are approved and pure, who know the Lord. ||6||3||

1158.g: ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਕਾ ਕਿਬਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
1158.t: man kar makaa kibalaa kar dhehee ||
1158.e: Let your mind be Mecca, and your body the temple of worship.
Let the Supreme Guru be the One who speaks. ||1||
O Mullah, utter the call to prayer.
The one mosque has ten doors. ||1||Pause||
So slaughter your evil nature, doubt and cruelty;
consume the five demons and you shall be blessed with contentment. ||2||
Hindus and Muslims have the same One Lord and Master.

1158.g: ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਸੇਖ ॥੩॥
1158.t: keh karai mulaa(n) keh karai sekh ||3||
1158.e: What can the Mullah do, and what can the Shaykh do? ||3||
Says Kabeer, I have gone insane.
Slaughtering, slaughtering my mind, I have merged into the Celestial Lord. ||4||4||

1158.g: ਗੰਗਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਲਿਤਾ ਬਿਗਰੀ ॥ ਸੋ ਸਲਿਤਾ ਗੰਗਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬਰੀ ॥੧॥
1158.t: ga(n)gaa kai sa(n)g salitaa bigaree || so salitaa ga(n)gaa hoi nibaree ||1||
1158.e: When the stream flows into the Ganges, then it becomes the Ganges. ||1||
Just so, Kabeer has changed.

1158.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਭਇਓ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1158.t: saach bhio an kateh na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1158.e: He has become the Embodiment of Truth, and he does not go anywhere else. ||1||Pause||
Associating with the sandalwood tree, the tree nearby is changed;
that tree begins to smell just like the sandalwood tree. ||2||
Coming into contact with the philosophers' stone, copper is transformed;
that copper is transformed into gold. ||3||
In the Society of the Saints, Kabeer is transformed;
that Kabeer is transformed into the Lord. ||4||5||
Some apply ceremonial marks to their foreheads, hold malas in their hands, and wear religious robes.
Some people think that the Lord is a play-thing. ||1||

1158.g: ਜਉ ਹਉ ਬਉਰਾ ਤਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
1158.t: jau hau bauraa tau raam toraa ||
1158.e: If I am insane, then I am Yours, O Lord.

1158.g: ਲੋਗੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਕਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1158.t: log maram keh jaanai moraa ||1|| rahaau ||
1158.e: How can people know my secret? ||1||Pause||

1158.g: ਤੋਰਉ ਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਪੂਜਉ ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
1158.t: torau na paatee poojau na dhevaa ||
1158.e: I do not pick leaves as offerings, and I do not worship idols.
Without devotional worship of the Lord, service is useless. ||2||
I worship the True Guru; forever and ever, I surrender to Him.
By such service, I find peace in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
People say that Kabeer has gone insane.
Only the Lord realizes the secret of Kabeer. ||4||6||
Turning away from the world, I have forgotten both my social class and ancestry.
My weaving now is in the most profound celestial stillness. ||1||
I have no quarrel with anyone.

1159.e: I have abandoned both the Pandits, the Hindu religious scholars, and the Mullahs, the Muslim priests. ||1||Pause||
I weave and weave, and wear what I weave.

1159.g: ਜਹ ਨਹੀ ਆਪੁ ਤਹਾ ਹੋਇ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
1159.t: jeh nahee aap tahaa hoi gaavau ||2||
1159.e: Where egotism does not exist, there I sing God's Praises. ||2||
Whatever the Pandits and Mullahs have written,

1159.g: ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਮ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
1159.t: chhaadd chale ham kachhoo na leeaa ||3||
1159.e: I reject; I do not accept any of it. ||3||
My heart is pure, and so I have seen the Lord within.
Searching, searching within the self, Kabeer has met the Lord. ||4||7||
No one respects the poor man.

1159.g: ਲਾਖ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਓਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਧਰੇਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1159.t: laakh jatan karai oh chit na dharei ||1|| rahaau ||
1159.e: He may make thousands of efforts, but no one pays any attention to him. ||1||Pause||
When the poor man goes to the rich man,
and sits right in front of him, the rich man turns his back on him. ||1||
But when the rich man goes to the poor man,
the poor man welcomes him with respect. ||2||
The poor man and the rich man are both brothers.

1159.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਨ ਮੇਟੀ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
1159.t: prabh kee kalaa na meTee jaiee ||3||
1159.e: God's pre-ordained plan cannot be erased. ||3||
Says Kabeer, he alone is poor,

1159.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
1159.t: jaa ke hiradhai naam na hoiee ||4||8||
1159.e: who does not have the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his heart. ||4||8||
Serving the Guru, devotional worship is practiced.
Then, this human body is obtained.
Even the gods long for this human body.

1159.g: ਸੋ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
1159.t: so dhehee bhaj har kee sev ||1||
1159.e: So vibrate that human body, and think of serving the Lord. ||1||
Vibrate, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, and never forget Him.

1159.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਏਹੀ ਲਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1159.t: maanas janam kaa ehee laahu ||1|| rahaau ||
1159.e: This is the blessed opportunity of this human incarnation. ||1||Pause||

1159.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਰਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
1159.t: jab lag jaraa rog nahee aaiaa ||
1159.e: As long as the disease of old age has not come to the body,

1159.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੀ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
1159.t: jab lag kaal grasee nahee kaiaa ||
1159.e: and as long as death has not come and seized the body,

1159.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਈ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
1159.t: jab lag bikal bhiee nahee baanee ||
1159.e: and as long as your voice has not lost its power,
O mortal being, vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World. ||2||

1159.g: ਅਬ ਨ ਭਜਸਿ ਭਜਸਿ ਕਬ ਭਾਈ ॥
1159.t: ab na bhajas bhajas kab bhaiee ||
1159.e: If you do not vibrate and meditate on Him now, when will you, O Sibing of Destiny?
When the end comes, you will not be able to vibrate and meditate on Him.

1159.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਅਬ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
1159.t: jo kichh kareh soiee ab saar ||
1159.e: Whatever you have to do - now is the best time to do it.
Otherwise, you shall regret and repent afterwards, and you shall not be carried across to the other side. ||3||
He alone is a servant, whom the Lord enjoins to His service.
He alone attains the Immaculate Divine Lord.

1159.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਖੁਲੑੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
1159.t: gur mil taa ke khul(h)e kapaaT ||
1159.e: Meeting with the Guru, his doors are opened wide,
and he does not have to journey again on the path of reincarnation. ||4||

1159.g: ਇਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਰ ॥
1159.t: eihee teraa aausar ieh teree baar ||
1159.e: This is your chance, and this is your time.
Look deep into your own heart, and reflect on this.
Says Kabeer, you can win or lose.
In so many ways, I have proclaimed this out loud. ||5||1||9||

1159.g: ਸਿਵ ਕੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਬਸੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
1159.t: siv kee puree basai budh saar ||
1159.e: In the City of God, sublime understanding prevails.

1159.g: ਤਹ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ॥
1159.t: teh tum(h) mil kai karahu bichaar ||
1159.e: There, you shall meet with the Lord, and reflect on Him.
Thus, you shall understand this world and the next.

1159.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
1159.t: kaun karam meraa kar kar marai ||1||
1159.e: What is the use of claiming that you own everything, if you only die in the end? ||1||
I focus my meditation on my inner self, deep within.

1159.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1159.t: raajaa raam naam moraa braham giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
1159.e: The Name of the Sovereign Lord is my spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
In the first chakra, the root chakra, I have grasped the reins and tied them.
I have firmly placed the moon above the sun.
The sun blazes forth at the western gate.
Through the central channel of the Shushmanaa, it rises up above my head. ||2||
There is a stone at that western gate,
and above that stone, is another window.
Above that window is the Tenth Gate.

1159.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੦॥
1159.t: keh kabeer taa kaa a(n)t na paar ||3||2||10||
1159.e: Says Kabeer, it has no end or limitation. ||3||2||10||

1159.g: ਸੋ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਜੋ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਰੈ ॥
1159.t: so mulaa(n) jo man siau larai ||
1159.e: He alone is a Mullah, who struggles with his mind,
and through the Guru's Teachings, fights with death.
He crushes the pride of the Messenger of Death.
Unto that Mullah, I ever offer greetings of respect. ||1||

1160.e: God is present, right here at hand; why do you say that He is far away?
Tie up your disturbing passions, and find the Beauteous Lord. ||1||Pause||
He alone is a Qazi, who contemplates the human body,
and through the fire of the body, is illumined by God.
He does not lose his semen, even in his dreams;

1160.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਜੀ ਕਉ ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
1160.t: tis kaajee kau jaraa na maranaa ||2||
1160.e: for such a Qazi, there is no old age or death. ||2||

1160.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾਨੁ ਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਰ ਤਾਨੈ ॥
1160.t: so surataanu ju dhui sar taanai ||
1160.e: He alone is a sultan and a king, who shoots the two arrows,
gathers in his outgoing mind,
and assembles his army in the realm of the mind's sky, the Tenth Gate.
The canopy of royalty waves over such a sultan. ||3||
The Yogi cries out, ""Gorakh, Gorakh"".
The Hindu utters the Name of Raam.
The Muslim has only One God.
The Lord and Master of Kabeer is all-pervading. ||4||3||11||
Fifth Mehla:
Those who call a stone their god
their service is useless.
Those who fall at the feet of a stone god
- their work is wasted in vain. ||1||
My Lord and Master speaks forever.

1160.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1160.t: sarab jeeaa kau prabh dhaan dhetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1160.e: God gives His gifts to all living beings. ||1||Pause||
The Divine Lord is within the self, but the spiritually blind one does not know this.
Deluded by doubt, he is caught in the noose.

1160.g: ਨ ਪਾਥਰੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
1160.t: n paathar bolai naa kichh dhei ||
1160.e: The stone does not speak; it does not give anything to anyone.
Such religious rituals are useless; such service is fruitless. ||2||
If a corpse is anointed with sandalwood oil,

1160.g: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1160.t: aus te kahahu kavan fal paavai ||
1160.e: what good does it do?

1160.g: ਜੇ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਰੁਲਾਈ ॥
1160.t: je mritak kau bisaTaa maeh rulaiee ||
1160.e: If a corpse is rolled in manure,

1160.g: ਤਾਂ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
1160.t: taa(n) mritak kaa kiaa ghaT jaiee ||3||
1160.e: what does it lose from this? ||3||
Says Kabeer, I proclaim this out loud
behold, and understand, you ignorant, faithless cynic.
The love of duality has ruined countless homes.
The Lord's devotees are forever in bliss. ||4||4||12||

1160.g: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਮੀਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੇਧੇ ॥
1160.t: jal meh meen maiaa ke bedhe ||
1160.e: The fish in the water is attached to Maya.
The moth fluttering around the lamp is pierced through by Maya.
The sexual desire of Maya afflicts the elephant.
The snakes and bumble bees are destroyed through Maya. ||1||
Such are the enticements of Maya, O Siblings of Destiny.
As many living beings are there are, have been deceived. ||1||Pause||
The birds and the deer are imbued with Maya.
Sugar is a deadly trap for the flies.
Horses and camels are absorbed in Maya.
The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of miraculous spiritual powers, play in Maya. ||2||
The six celibates are slaves of Maya.
So are the nine masters of Yoga, and the sun and the moon.
The austere disciplinarians and the Rishis are asleep in Maya.

1160.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਅਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਾ ॥੩॥
1160.t: maiaa meh kaal ar pa(n)ch dhootaa ||3||
1160.e: Death and the five demons are in Maya. ||3||
Dogs and jackals are imbued with Maya.
Monkeys, leopards and lions,
cats, sheep, foxes,
trees and roots are planted in Maya. ||4||
Even the gods are drenched with Maya,
as are the oceans, the sky and the earth.

1160.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਦਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1160.t: keh kabeer jis udhar tis maiaa ||
1160.e: Says Kabeer, whoever has a belly to fill, is under the spell of Maya.
The mortal is emancipated only when he meets the Holy Saint. ||5||5||13||
As long as he cries out, Mine! Mine!,

1160.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਰੈ ॥
1160.t: tab lag kaaj ek nahee sarai ||
1160.e: none of his tasks is accomplished.
When such possessiveness is erased and removed,

1161.e: then God comes and resolves his affairs. ||1||
Contemplate such spiritual wisdom, O mortal man.

1161.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1161.t: har kee na simarahu dhukh bha(n)janaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1161.e: Why not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the Destroyer of pain? ||1||Pause||

1161.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਰਹੈ ਬਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1161.t: jab lag si(n)gh rahai ban maeh ||
1161.e: As long as the tiger lives in the forest,

1161.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਨੁ ਫੂਲੈ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1161.t: tab lag ban foolai hee naeh ||
1161.e: the forest does not flower.

1161.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਆਰੁ ਸਿੰਘ ਕਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
1161.t: jab hee siaar si(n)gh kau khai ||
1161.e: But when the jackal eats the tiger,
then the entire forest flowers. ||2||
The victorious are drowned, while the defeated swim across.
By Guru's Grace, one crosses over and is saved.
Slave Kabeer speaks and teaches:
remain lovingly absorbed, attuned to the Lord alone. ||3||6||14||

1161.g: ਸਤਰਿ ਸੈਇ ਸਲਾਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
1161.t: satar sai salaar hai jaa ke ||
1161.e: He has 7,000 commanders,
and hundreds of thousands of prophets;
He is said to have 88,000,000 shaykhs,

1161.g: ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
1161.t: chhapan koT jaa ke khel khaasee ||1||
1161.e: and 56,000,000 attendants. ||1||
I am meek and poor - what chance do I have of being heard there?

1161.g: ਮਜਲਸਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1161.t: majalas dhoor mahal ko paavai ||1|| rahaau ||
1161.e: His Court is so far away; only a rare few attain the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||
He has 33,000,000 play-houses.
His beings wander insanely through 8.4 million incarnations.

1161.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦਮ ਕਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
1161.t: baabaa aadham kau kichh nadhar dhikhaiee ||
1161.e: Even to Adam, only a glimpse of grace was shown.
who then lived in paradise for a long time. ||2||

1161.g: ਦਿਲ ਖਲਹਲੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜਰਦ ਰੂ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
1161.t: dhil khalahal jaa kai jaradh roo baanee ||
1161.e: Pale are the faces of those whose hearts are disturbed.
They have forsaken their Bible, and practice Satanic evil.
One who blames the world, and is angry with people,
shall receive the fruits of his own actions. ||3||
You are the Great Giver, O Lord; I am forever a beggar at Your Door.
If I were to deny You, then I would be a wretched sinner.
Slave Kabeer has entered Your Shelter.
Keep me near You, O Merciful Lord God - that is heaven for me. ||4||7||15||

1161.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਚਲਨ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਊਹਾਂ ॥
1161.t: sabh koiee chalan kahat hai uoohaa(n) ||
1161.e: Everyone speaks of going there,

1161.g: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਉ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1161.t: naa jaanau baiku(n)Th hai kahaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
1161.e: but I do not even know where heaven is. ||1||Pause||

1161.g: ਆਪ ਆਪ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
1161.t: aap aap kaa maram na jaanaa(n) ||
1161.e: One who does not even know the mystery of his own self,
speaks of heaven, but it is only talk. ||1||

1161.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
1161.t: jab lag man baiku(n)Th kee aas ||
1161.e: As long as the mortal hopes for heaven,
he will not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||2||
Heaven is not a fort with moats and ramparts, and walls plastered with mud;
I do not know what heaven's gate is like. ||3||
Says Kabeer, now what more can I say?
The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is heaven itself. ||4||8||16||
How can the beautiful fortress be conquered, O Siblings of Destiny?

1161.g: ਦੋਵਰ ਕੋਟ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਵਰ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1161.t: dhovar koT ar tevar khaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1161.e: It has double walls and triple moats. ||1||Pause||

1161.g: ਪਾਂਚ ਪਚੀਸ ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਆਡੀ ਪਰਬਲ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1161.t: paa(n)ch pachees moh madh matasar aaddee parabal maiaa ||
1161.e: It is defended by the five elements, the twenty-five categories, attachment, pride, jealousy and the awesomely powerful Maya.

1161.g: ਜਨ ਗਰੀਬ ਕੋ ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1161.t: jan gareeb ko jor na pahuchai kahaa karau raghuraiaa ||1||
1161.e: The poor mortal being does not have the strength to conquer it; what should I do now, O Lord? ||1||

1161.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਿਵਾਰੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
1161.t: kaam kivaaree dhukh sukh dharavaanee paap pu(n)n dharavaajaa ||
1161.e: Sexual desire is the window, pain and pleasure are the gate-keepers, virtue and sin are the gates.

1161.g: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਡ ਦੁੰਦਰ ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਵਾਸੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੨॥
1161.t: karodh pradhaan mahaa badd dhu(n)dhar teh man maavaasee raajaa ||2||
1161.e: Anger is the great supreme commander, full of argument and strife, and the mind is the rebel king there. ||2||

1161.g: ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਸਨਾਹ ਟੋਪੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੋ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕਮਾਨ ਚਢਾਈ ॥
1161.t: savaiaadh sanaeh Top mamataa ko kubudh kamaan chaddaiee ||
1161.e: Their armor is the pleasure of tastes and flavors, their helmets are worldly attachments; they take aim with their bows of corrupt intellect.

1161.g: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਤੀਰ ਰਹੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਇਉ ਗਢੁ ਲੀਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
1161.t: tisanaa teer rahe ghaT bheetar iau gadd leeo na jaiee ||3||
1161.e: The greed that fills their hearts is the arrow; with these things, their fortress is impregnable. ||3||

1161.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਲੀਤਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹਵਾਈ ਗੋਲਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
1161.t: prem paleetaa surat havaiee golaa giaan chalaiaa ||
1161.e: But I have made divine love the fuse, and deep meditation the bomb; I have launched the rocket of spiritual wisdom.

1161.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਰਜਾਲੀ ਏਕਹਿ ਚੋਟ ਸਿਝਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1161.t: braham agan sahaje parajaalee ekeh choT sijhaiaa ||4||
1161.e: The fire of God is lit by intuition, and with one shot, the fortress is taken. ||4||

1161.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਲੈ ਲਰਨੇ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੋਰੇ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
1161.t: sat sa(n)tokh lai larane laagaa tore dhui dharavaajaa ||
1161.e: Taking truth and contentment with me, I begin the battle and storm both the gates.

1161.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਕਰਿਓ ਗਢ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੫॥
1161.t: saadhasa(n)gat ar gur kee kirapaa te pakario gadd ko raajaa ||5||
1161.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and by Guru's Grace, I have captured the king of the fortress. ||5||

1162.g: ਭਗਵਤ ਭੀਰਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਕਟੀ ਕਾਲ ਭੈ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
1162.t: bhagavat bheer sakat simaran kee kaTee kaal bhai faasee ||
1162.e: With the army of God's devotees, and Shakti, the power of meditation, I have snapped the noose of the fear of death.

1162.g: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਮੀਰੁ ਚੜਿੑਓ ਗੜੑ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਲੀਓ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੬॥੯॥੧੭॥
1162.t: dhaas kameer chaRi(h)o gaR(h) uoopar raaj leeo abinaasee ||6||9||17||
1162.e: Slave Kabeer has climbed to the top of the fortress; I have obtained the eternal, imperishable domain. ||6||9||17||
The mother Ganges is deep and profound.
Tied up in chains, they took Kabeer there. ||1||

1162.g: ਮਨੁ ਨ ਡਿਗੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਾਇ ॥
1162.t: man na ddigai tan kaahe kau ddarai ||
1162.e: My mind was not shaken; why should my body be afraid?

1162.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1162.t: charan kamal chit rahio samai || rahaau ||
1162.e: My consciousness remained immersed in the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1162.g: ਗੰਗਾ ਕੀ ਲਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਟੁਟੀ ਜੰਜੀਰ ॥
1162.t: ga(n)gaa kee lahar meree TuTee ja(n)jeer ||
1162.e: The waves of the Ganges broke the chains,
and Kabeer was seated on a deer skin. ||2||

1162.g: ਕਹਿ ਕੰਬੀਰ ਕੋਊ ਸੰਗ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
1162.t: keh ka(n)beer kouoo sa(n)g na saath ||
1162.e: Says Kabeer, I have no friend or companion.
On the water, and on the land, the Lord is my Protector. ||3||10||18||

1162.t: bhairau kabeer jeeau asaTapadhee ghar doojaa
1162.e: Bhairao, Kabeer Jee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
God constructed a fortress, inaccessible and unreachable, in which He dwells.
There, His Divine Light radiates forth.
Lightning blazes, and bliss prevails there,
where the Eternally Young Lord God abides. ||1||

1162.g: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
1162.t: eih jeeau raam naam liv laagai ||
1162.e: This soul is lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name.

1162.g: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1162.t: jaraa maran chhooTai bhram bhaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
1162.e: It is saved from old age and death, and its doubt runs away. ||1||Pause||

1162.g: ਅਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
1162.t: abaran baran siau man hee preet ||
1162.e: Those who believe in high and low social classes,
only sing songs and chants of egotism.
The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, resounds in that place,
where the Supreme Lord God abides. ||2||
He creates planets, solar systems and galaxies;
He destroys the three worlds, the three gods and the three qualities.
The Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord God dwells in the heart.

1162.g: ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਧਰਨੀਧਰ ਮੰਤ ॥੩॥
1162.t: paar na paavai ko dharaneedhar ma(n)t ||3||
1162.e: No one can find the limits or the secrets of the Lord of the World. ||3||
The Lord shines forth in the plantain flower and the sunshine.
He dwells in the pollen of the lotus flower.
The Lord's secret is within the twelve petals of the heart-lotus.
The Supreme Lord, the Lord of Lakshmi dwells there. ||4||
He is like the sky, stretching across the lower, upper and middle realms.
In the profoundly silent celestial realm, He radiates forth.
Neither the sun nor the moon are there,
but the Primal Immaculate Lord celebrates there. ||5||
Know that He is in the universe, and in the body as well.
Take your cleansing bath in the Mansarovar Lake.

1162.g: ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਪ ॥
1162.t: soha(n) so jaa kau hai jaap ||
1162.e: Chant ""Sohang"" - ""He is me.""

1162.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਪੁੰਨ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਪ ॥੬॥
1162.t: jaa kau lipat na hoi pu(n)n ar paap ||6||
1162.e: He is not affected by either virtue or vice. ||6||
He is not affected by either high or low social class, sunshine or shade.

1162.g: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
1162.t: avar na paieeaai gur kee saam ||
1162.e: He is in the Guru's Sanctuary, and nowhere else.

1162.g: ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1162.t: Taaree na Tarai aavai na jai ||
1162.e: He is not diverted by diversions, comings or goings.
Remain intuitively absorbed in the celestial void. ||7||
One who knows the Lord in the mind
whatever he says, comes to pass.
One who firmly implants the Lord's Divine Light, and His Mantra within the mind
- says Kabeer, such a mortal crosses over to the other side. ||8||1||
Millions of suns shine for Him,
millions of Shivas and Kailash mountains.

1162.g: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਰਦਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
1162.t: dhuragaa koT jaa kai maradhan karai ||
1162.e: Millions of Durga goddesses massage His Feet.
Millions of Brahmas chant the Vedas for Him. ||1||
When I beg, I beg only from the Lord.

1162.g: ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1162.t: aan dhev siau naahee kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1162.e: I have nothing to do with any other deities. ||1||Pause||
Millions of moons twinkle in the sky.

1163.e: Three hundred thirty million gods eat the Lord's offerings.
The nine stars, a million times over, stand at His Door.
Millions of Righteous Judges of Dharma are His gate-keepers. ||2||
Millions of winds blow around Him in the four directions.
Millions of serpents prepare His bed.
Millions of oceans are His water-carriers.
The eighteen million loads of vegetation are His Hair. ||3||
Millions of treasurers fill His Treasury.
Millions of Lakshmis adorn themselves for Him.
Many millions of vices and virtues look up to Him.

1163.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ॥੪॥
1163.t: ei(n)dhr koT jaa ke sevaa kareh ||4||
1163.e: Millions of Indras serve Him. ||4||
Fifty-six million clouds are His.
In each and every village, His infinite fame has spread.
Wild demons with dishevelled hair move about.
The Lord plays in countless ways. ||5||
Millions of charitable feasts are held in His Court,
and millions of celestial singers celebrate His victory.
Millions of sciences all sing His Praises.

1163.g: ਤਊ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥੬॥
1163.t: tuoo paarabraham kaa a(n)t na lahai ||6||
1163.e: Even so, the limits of the Supreme Lord God cannot be found. ||6||

1163.g: ਬਾਵਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੋਮਾਵਲੀ ॥ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੈਨਾ ਜਹ ਤੇ ਛਲੀ ॥
1163.t: baavan koT jaa kai romaavalee || raavan sainaa jeh te chhalee ||
1163.e: Rama, with millions of monkeys, conquered Raawan's army.
Billions of Puraanas greatly praise Him;
He humbled the pride of Duyodhan. ||7||

1163.g: ਕੰਦ੍ਰਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
1163.t: ka(n)dhrap koT jaa kai lavai na dhareh ||
1163.e: Millions of gods of love cannot compete with Him.
He steals the hearts of mortal beings.
Says Kabeer, please hear me, O Lord of the World.
I beg for the blessing of fearless dignity. ||8||2||18||20||

1163.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧
1163.t: bhairau baanee naamadheau jeeau kee ghar pehilaa
1163.e: Bhairao, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
O my tongue, I will cut you into a hundred pieces,
if you do not chant the Name of the Lord. ||1||

1163.g: ਰੰਗੀ ਲੇ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
1163.t: ra(n)gee le jihabaa har kai nai ||
1163.e: O my tongue, be imbued with the Lord's Name.

1163.g: ਸੁਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1163.t: sura(n)g ra(n)geele har har dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
1163.e: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and imbue yourself with this most excellent color. ||1||Pause||
O my tongue, other occupations are false.

1163.g: ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
1163.t: nirabaan padh ik har ko naam ||2||
1163.e: The state of Nirvaanaa comes only through the Lord's Name. ||2||
The performance of countless millions of other devotions
is not equal to even one devotion to the Name of the Lord. ||3||
Prays Naam Dayv, this is my occupation.
O Lord, Your Forms are endless. ||4||1||
One who stays away from others' wealth and others' spouses
- the Lord abides near that person. ||1||
Those who do not meditate and vibrate on the Lord

1163.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਨ ਕਰਉ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1163.t: tin kaa mai na karau dharasanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1163.e: - I do not even want to see them. ||1||Pause||
Those whose inner beings are not in harmony with the Lord,
are nothing more than beasts. ||2||
Prays Naam Dayv, a man without a nose
does not look handsome, even if he has the thirty-two beauty marks. ||3||2||

1163.g: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਟੋਰੈ ਗਡਵੈ ਪਾਨੀ ॥ ਕਪਲ ਗਾਇ ਨਾਮੈ ਦੁਹਿ ਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
1163.t: dhoodh kaTorai gaddavai paanee || kapal gai naamai dhuh aanee ||1||
1163.e: Naam Dayv milked the brown cow, and brought a cup of milk and a jug of water to his family god. ||1||
"Please drink this milk, O my Sovereign Lord God.
Drink this milk and my mind will be happy.

1163.g: ਨਾਹੀ ਤ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1163.t: naahee ta ghar ko baap risai ||1|| rahaau ||
1163.e: Otherwise, my father will be angry with me.""||1||Pause||
Taking the golden cup, Naam Dayv filled it with the ambrosial milk,
and placed it before the Lord. ||2||

1163.g: ਏਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਬਸੈ ॥ ਨਾਮੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਰਾਇਨੁ ਹਸੈ ॥੩॥
1163.t: ek bhagat mere hiradhe basai || naame dhekh narain hasai ||3||
1163.e: The Lord looked upon Naam Dayv and smiled. ""This one devotee abides within my heart.""||3||
The Lord drank the milk, and the devotee returned home.

1164.e: Thus did Naam Dayv come to receive the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||3||
I am crazy - the Lord is my Husband.

1164.g: ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਉ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
1164.t: rach rach taa kau karau si(n)gaar ||1||
1164.e: I decorate and adorn myself for Him. ||1||

1164.g: ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
1164.t: bhale ni(n)dhau bhale ni(n)dhau bhale ni(n)dhau log ||
1164.e: Slander me well, slander me well, slander me well, O people.

1164.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1164.t: tan man raam piaare jog ||1|| rahaau ||
1164.e: My body and mind are united with my Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

1164.g: ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
1164.t: baadh bibaadh kaahoo siau na keejai ||
1164.e: Do not engage in any arguments or debates with anyone.
With your tongue, savor the Lord's sublime essence. ||2||

1164.g: ਅਬ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨਿ ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
1164.t: ab jeea jaan aaisee ban aaiee ||
1164.e: Now, I know within my soul, that such an arrangement has been made;
I will meet with my Lord by the beat of the drum. ||3||
Anyone can praise or slander me.
Naam Dayv has met the Lord. ||4||4||

1164.g: ਕਬਹੂ ਖੀਰਿ ਖਾਡ ਘੀਉ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1164.t: kabahoo kheer khaadd gheeau na bhaavai ||
1164.e: Sometimes, people do not appreciate milk, sugar and ghee.
Sometimes, they have to beg for bread from door to door.
Sometimes, they have to pick out the grain from the chaff. ||1||

1164.g: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
1164.t: jiau raam raakhai tiau raheeaai re bhaiee ||
1164.e: As the Lord keeps us, so do we live, O Siblings of Destiny.

1164.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1164.t: har kee mahimaa kichh kathan na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1164.e: The Lord's Glory cannot even be described. ||1||Pause||
Sometimes, people prance around on horses.
Sometimes, they do not even have shoes for their feet. ||2||
Sometimes, people sleep on cozy beds with white sheets.
Sometimes, they do not even have straw to put down on the ground. ||3||
Naam Dayv prays, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, can save us.

1164.g: ਜਿਹ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
1164.t: jeh gur milai teh paar utaarai ||4||5||
1164.e: One who meets the Guru, is carried across to the other side. ||4||5||
Laughing and playing, I came to Your Temple, O Lord.
While Naam Dayv was worshipping, he was grabbed and driven out. ||1||
I am of a low social class, O Lord;

1164.g: ਛੀਪੇ ਕੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1164.t: chheepe ke janam kaahe kau aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1164.e: why was I born into a family of fabric dyers? ||1||Pause||
I picked up my blanket and went back,
to sit behind the temple. ||2||

1164.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
1164.t: jiau jiau naamaa har gun ucharai ||
1164.e: As Naam Dayv uttered the Glorious Praises of the Lord,
the temple turned around to face the Lord's humble devotee. ||3||6||
Bhairao, Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
As the hungry person loves food,
and the thirsty person is obsessed with water,
and as the fool is attached to his family
- just so, the Lord is very dear to Naam Dayv. ||1||
Naam Dayv is in love with the Lord.
He has naturally and intuitively become detached from the world. ||1||Pause||
Like the woman who falls in love with another man,
and the greedy man who loves only wealth,
and the sexually promiscuous man who loves women and sex,
just so, Naam Dayv is in love with the Lord. ||2||
But that alone is real love, which the Lord Himself inspires;
by Guru's Grace, duality is eradicated.
Such love never breaks; through it, the mortal remains merged in the Lord.
Naam Dayv has focused his consciousness on the True Name. ||3||
Like the love between the child and its mother,
so is my mind imbued with the Lord.
Prays Naam Dayv, I am in love with the Lord.
The Lord of the Universe abides within my consciousness. ||4||1||7||
The blind fool abandons the wife of his own home,

1165.e: and has an affair with another woman.
He is like the parrot, who is pleased to see the simbal tree;
but in the end, he dies, stuck to it. ||1||
The home of the sinner is on fire.

1165.g: ਜਲਤ ਰਹੈ ਮਿਟਵੈ ਕਬ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1165.t: jalat rahai miTavai kab naeh ||1|| rahaau ||
1165.e: It keeps burning, and the fire cannot be extinguished. ||1||Pause||

1165.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
1165.t: har kee bhagat na dhekhai jai ||
1165.e: He does not go to see where the Lord is being worshipped.
He abandons the Lord's Path, and takes the wrong path.
He forgets the Primal Lord God, and is caught in the cycle of reincarnation.
He throws away the Ambrosial Nectar, and gathers poison to eat. ||2||
He is like the prostitute, who comes to dance,
wearing beautiful clothes, decorated and adorned.
She dances to the beat, exciting the breath of those who watch her.

1165.g: ਵਾ ਕੇ ਗਲੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਫਾਸ ॥੩॥
1165.t: vaa ke gale jam kaa hai faas ||3||
1165.e: But the noose of the Messenger of Death is around her neck. ||3||
One who has good karma recorded on his forehead,

1165.g: ਸੋ ਭਜਿ ਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
1165.t: so bhaj par hai gur kee saranaa ||
1165.e: hurries to enter the Guru's Sanctuary.
Says Naam Dayv, consider this:
O Saints, this is the way to cross over to the other side. ||4||2||8||
Sanda and Marka went and complained to Harnaakhash,

1165.g: ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਹੀ ਪਚਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
1165.t: paRai nahee ham hee pach haare ||
1165.e: "Your son does not read his lessons. We are tired of trying to teach him.

1165.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਰ ਤਾਲ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਚਟੀਆ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
1165.t: raam kahai kar taal bajaavai chaTeeaa sabhai bigaare ||1||
1165.e: He chants the Lord's Name, clapping his hands to keep the beat; he has spoiled all the other students. ||1||
He chants the Lord's Name,

1165.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1165.t: hiradhai har jee ko simaran dharai ||1|| rahaau ||
1165.e: and he has enshrined meditative remembrance of the Lord within his heart.""||1||Pause||

1165.g: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਜੇ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਪਟਰਾਨੀ ॥
1165.t: basudhaa bas keenee sabh raaje binatee karai paTaraanee ||
1165.e: "Your father the king has conquered the whole world", said his mother the queen.

1165.g: ਪੂਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਤਉ ਅਉਰੈ ਠਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
1165.t: poot prahilaadh kahiaa nahee maanai tin tau aaurai Thaanee ||2||
1165.e: "O Prahlad my son, you do not obey him, so he has decided to deal with you in another way."||2||

1165.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਤਰ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਸਹ ਅਉਧ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
1165.t: dhusaT sabhaa mil ma(n)tar upaiaa karaseh aaudh ghaneree ||
1165.e: The council of villians met and resolved to send Prahlaad into the life hereafter.

1165.g: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਜਲੁ ਜੁਆਲਾ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
1165.t: gir tar jal juaalaa bhai raakhio raajaa raam maiaa feree ||3||
1165.e: Prahlaad was thrown off a mountain, into the water, and into a fire, but the Sovereign Lord God saved him, by changing the laws of nature. ||3||

1165.g: ਕਾਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਭੈ ਕੋਪਿਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਤਾਉ ਜੁ ਤੁਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
1165.t: kaadd khaRag kaal bhai kopio moh bataau ju tuh raakhai ||
1165.e: Harnaakhash thundered with rage and threatened to kill Prahlaad. ""Tell me, who can save you?""

1165.g: ਪੀਤ ਪੀਤਾਂਬਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ਥੰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੪॥
1165.t: peet peetaa(n)bar tirabhavan dhanee tha(n)bh maeh har bhaakhai ||4||
1165.e: Prahlaad answered, ""The Lord, the Master of the three worlds, is contained even in this pillar to which I am tied.""||4||

1165.g: ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਖਹ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਕੀਏ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
1165.t: haranaakhas jin nakheh bidhaario sur nar ke'ee sanaathaa ||
1165.e: The Lord who tore Harnaakhash apart with His nails proclaimed Himself the Lord of gods and men.

1165.g: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਮ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੫॥੩॥੯॥
1165.t: keh naamadheau ham narahar dhiaaveh raam abhai padh dhaataa ||5||3||9||
1165.e: Says Naam Dayv, I meditate on the Lord, the Man-lion, the Giver of fearless dignity. ||5||3||9||
The Sultan said, ""Listen, Naam Dayv:
let me see the actions of your Lord.""||1||
The Sultan arrested Naam Dayv,
and said, ""Let me see your Beloved Lord.""||1||Pause||
"Bring this dead cow back to life.
Otherwise, I shall cut off your head here and now.""||2||
Naam Dayv answered, ""O king, how can this happen?
No one can bring the dead back to life. ||3||
I cannot do anything by my own actions.

1165.g: ਕਰਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
1165.t: kar hai raam hoi hai soi ||4||
1165.e: Whatever the Lord does, that alone happens.""||4||
The arrogant king was enraged at this reply.
He incited an elephant to attack. ||5||
Naam Dayv's mother began to cry,

1165.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਭਜਹਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੬॥
1165.t: chhodd raam kee na bhajeh khudhai ||6||
1165.e: and she said, ""Why don't you abandon your Lord Raam, and worship his Lord Allah?""||6||

1165.g: ਨ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੂੰਗੜਾ ਨ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
1165.t: n hau teraa poo(n)gaRaa na too meree mai ||
1165.e: Naam Dayv answered, ""I am not your son, and you are not my mother.

1165.g: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜੈ ਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੭॥
1165.t: pi(n)dd paRai tau har gun gai ||7||
1165.e: Even if my body dies, I will still sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.""||7||
The elephant attacked him with his trunk,
but Naam Dayv was saved, protected by the Lord. ||8||
The king said, ""The Qazis and the Mullahs bow down to me,
but this Hindu has trampled my honor.""||9||
The people pleaded with the king, ""Hear our prayer, O king.

1166.e: Here, take Naam Dayvs weight in gold, and release him.""||10||
The king replied, ""If I take the gold, then I will be consigned to hell,
by forsaking my faith and gathering worldly wealth.""||11||
With his feet in chains, Naam Dayv kept the beat with his hands,
singing the Praises of the Lord. ||12||
"Even if the Ganges and the Jamunaa rivers flow backwards,
I will still continue singing the Praises of the Lord.""||13||
Three hours passed,
and even then, the Lord of the three worlds had not come. ||14||
Playing on the instrument of the feathered wings,
the Lord of the Universe came, mounted on the eagle garura. ||15||
He cherished His devotee,
and the Lord came, mounted on the eagle garura. ||16||
The Lord said to him, ""If you wish, I shall turn the earth sideways.

1166.g: ਕਹਹਿ ਤ ਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਧਰਉ ॥੧੭॥
1166.t: kaheh ta le kar uoopar dharau ||17||
1166.e: If you wish, I shall turn it upside down. ||17||

1166.g: ਕਹਹਿ ਤ ਮੁਈ ਗਊ ਦੇਉ ਜੀਆਇ ॥
1166.t: kaheh ta muiee guoo dheau jeeaai ||
1166.e: If you wish, I shall bring the dead cow back to life.
Everyone will see and be convinced.""||18||
Naam Dayv prayed, and milked the cow.
He brought the calf to the cow, and milked her. ||19||
When the pitcher was filled with milk,
Naam Dayv took it and placed it before the king. ||20||
The king went into his palace,
and his heart was troubled. ||21||
Through the Qazis and the Mullahs, the king offered his prayer,
"Forgive me, please, O Hindu; I am just a cow before you."||22||
Naam Dayv said, ""Listen, O king:
have I done this miracle? ||23||
The purpose of this miracle is
that you, O king, should walk on the path of truth and humility.""||24||
Naam Dayv became famous everywhere for this.

1166.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਸਭ ਨਾਮੇ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨੫॥
1166.t: mil hi(n)dhoo sabh naame peh jaeh ||25||
1166.e: The Hindus all went together to Naam Dayv. ||25||

1166.g: ਜਉ ਅਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਗਾਇ ॥
1166.t: jau ab kee baar na jeevai gai ||
1166.e: If the cow had not been revived,
people would have lost faith in Naam Dayv. ||26||
The fame of Naam Dayv spread throughout the world.
The humble devotees were saved and carried across with him. ||27||
All sorts of troubles and pains afflicted the slanderer.
There is no difference between Naam Dayv and the Lord. ||28||1||10||
Second House:
By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one meets the Lord.
By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one is carried across to the other side.
By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one swims across to heaven.
By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

1166.g: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
1166.t: sat sat sat sat sat gurdhev ||
1166.e: True, True, True True, True is the Divine Guru.

1166.g: ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਆਨ ਸਭ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1166.t: jhooTh jhooTh jhooTh jhooTh aan sabh sev ||1|| rahaau ||
1166.e: False, false, false, false is all other service. ||1||Pause||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is implanted within.

1166.g: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
1166.t: jau gurdheau na dheh dhis dhaavai ||
1166.e: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one does not wander in the ten directions.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the five demons are kept far away.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one does not die regretting. ||2||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one is blessed with the Ambrosial Bani of the Word.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one speaks the Unspoken Speech.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's body becomes like ambrosial nectar.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one utters and chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one sees the three worlds.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one understands the state of supreme dignity.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's head is in the Akaashic ethers.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one is always congratulated everywhere. ||4||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one remains detached forever.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one forsakes the slander of others.

1167.e: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one looks upon good and bad as the same.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one has good destiny written on his forehead. ||5||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the wall of the body is not eroded.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the temple turns itself towards the mortal.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's home is constructed.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's bed is lifted up out of the water. ||6||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's body is stamped with the sacred mark of Vishnu.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one has performed the twelve devotional services.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, all poison is transformed into fruit. ||7||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, skepticism is shattered.

1167.g: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
1167.t: jau gurdheau ta jam te chhooTai ||
1167.e: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one escapes from the Messenger of Death.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

1167.g: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ॥੮॥
1167.t: jau gurdheau ta janam na marai ||8||
1167.e: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one is not subject to the cycle of reincarnation. ||8||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one understands the rituals of the eighteen Puraanas.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, it is as if one has made an offering of the eighten loads of vegetation.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one needs no other place of rest.
Naam Dayv has entered the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||9||1||2||11||

1167.g: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨
1167.t: bhairau baanee ravidhaas jeeau kee ghar doojaa
1167.e: Bhairao, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Without seeing something, the yearning for it does not arise.
Whatever is seen, shall pass away.
Whoever chants and praises the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
is the true Yogi, free of desire. ||1||
When someone utters the Name of the Lord with love,

1167.g: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1167.t: paaras parasai dhubidhaa na hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1167.e: it is as if he has touched the philosopher's stone; his sense of duality is eradicated. ||1||Pause||

1167.g: ਸੋ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
1167.t: so mun man kee dhubidhaa khai ||
1167.e: He alone is a silent sage, who destroys the duality of his mind.
Keeping the doors of his body closed, he merges in the Lord of the three worlds.

1167.g: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ॥
1167.t: man kaa subhaau sabh koiee karai ||
1167.e: Everyone acts according to the inclinations of the mind.
Attuned to the Creator Lord, one remains free of fear. ||2||
Plants blossom forth to produce fruit.
When the fruit is produced, the flowers wither away.
For the sake of spiritual wisdom, people act and practice rituals.
When spiritual wisdom wells up, then actions are left behind. ||3||
For the sake of ghee, wise people churn milk.
Those who are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive - are forever in the state of Nirvaanaa.
Says Ravi Daas, O you unfortunate people,

1167.g: ਰਿਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਅਭਾਗ ॥੪॥੧॥
1167.t: ridhai raam kee na japas abhaag ||4||1||
1167.e: why not meditate on the Lord with love in your heart? ||4||1||
Naam Dayv:
Come, O Lord of beautiful hair,
wearing the robes of a Sufi Saint. ||Pause||

1167.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਉਸੈ ਸਪਤ ਪਯਾਲਾ ॥
1167.t: jin aakaas kuleh sir keenee kausai sapat payaalaa ||
1167.e: Your cap is the realm of the Akaashic ethers; the seven nether worlds are Your sandals.

1167.g: ਚਮਰ ਪੋਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਨੇ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
1167.t: chamar pos kaa ma(n)dhar teraa ieh bidh bane gupaalaa ||1||
1167.e: The body covered with skin is Your temple; You are so beautiful, O Lord of the World. ||1||

1167.g: ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਾ ਪੇਹਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਲਹ ਸਹਸ ਇਜਾਰਾ ॥
