1167.t: chhapan koT kaa pehan teraa soleh sahas ijaaraa ||
1167.e: The fifty-six million clouds are Your gowns, the 16,000 milkmaids are your skirts.

1167.g: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮੁਦਗਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਹਨਕ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
1167.t: bhaar aThaareh mudhagar teraa sahanak sabh sa(n)saaraa ||2||
1167.e: The eighteen loads of vegetation is Your stick, and all the world is Your plate. ||2||

1167.g: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਜਿਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾਨਾ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ॥
1167.t: dhehee mahajidh man maulaanaa sahaj nivaaj gujaarai ||
1167.e: The human body is the mosque, and the mind is the priest, who peacefully leads the prayer.

1167.g: ਬੀਬੀ ਕਉਲਾ ਸਉ ਕਾਇਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
1167.t: beebee kaulaa sau kain teraa nira(n)kaar aakaarai ||3||
1167.e: You are married to Maya, O Formless Lord, and so You have taken form. ||3||

1167.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਾਲ ਛਿਨਾਏ ਕਿਹ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
1167.t: bhagat karat mere taal chhinaae keh peh karau pukaaraa ||
1167.e: Performing devotional worship services to You, my cymbals were taken away; unto whom should I complain?

1167.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਫਿਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦੇਸਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
1167.t: naame kaa suaamee a(n)tarajaamee fire sagal bedhesavaa ||4||1||
1167.e: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, wanders everywhere; He has no specific home. ||4||1||

1168.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ
1168.t: raag basa(n)t mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe dhutuke
1168.e: Raag Basant, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay, Dho-Thukay:

1168.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1168.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
1168.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

1168.g: ਮਾਹਾ ਮਾਹ ਮੁਮਾਰਖੀ ਚੜਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ॥
1168.t: maahaa maeh mumaarakhee chaRiaa sadhaa basa(n)t ||
1168.e: Among the months, blessed is this month, when spring always comes.

1168.g: ਪਰਫੜੁ ਚਿਤ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥
1168.t: parafaR chit samaal soi sadhaa sadhaa gobi(n)dh ||1||
1168.e: Blossom forth, O my consciousness, contemplating the Lord of the Universe, forever and ever. ||1||
O ignorant one, forget your egotistical intellect.

1168.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਲੈ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1168.t: haumai maar beechaar man gun vich gun lai saar ||1|| rahaau ||
1168.e: Subdue your ego, and contemplate Him in your mind; gather in the virtues of the Sublime, Virtuous Lord. ||1||Pause||

1168.g: ਕਰਮ ਪੇਡੁ ਸਾਖਾ ਹਰੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
1168.t: karam pedd saakhaa haree dharam ful fal giaan ||
1168.e: Karma is the tree, the Lord's Name the branches, Dharmic faith the flowers, and spiritual wisdom the fruit.

1168.g: ਪਤ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਛਾਵ ਘਣੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
1168.t: pat paraapat chhaav ghanee chookaa man abhimaan ||2||
1168.e: Realization of the Lord are the leaves, and eradication of the pride of the mind is the shade. ||2||

1168.g: ਅਖੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੰਨੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
1168.t: akhee kudharat ka(n)nee baanee mukh aakhan sach naam ||
1168.e: Whoever sees the Lord's Creative Power with his eyes, and hears the Guru's Bani with his ears, and utters the True Name with his mouth,

1168.g: ਪਤਿ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
1168.t: pat kaa dhan pooraa hoaa laagaa sahaj dhiaan ||3||
1168.e: attains the perfect wealth of honor, and intuitively focuses his meditation on the Lord. ||3||

1168.g: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਆਵਣਾ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
1168.t: maahaa rutee aavanaa vekhahu karam kamai ||
1168.e: The months and the seasons come; see, and do your deeds.

1168.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰੇ ਨ ਸੂਕਹੀ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
1168.t: naanak hare na sookahee j gurmukh rahe samai ||4||1||
1168.e: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs who remain merged in the Lord do not wither away; they remain green forever. ||4||1||
First Mehla, Basant:
The season of spring, so delightful, has come.

1168.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਵਹਿ ਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
1168.t: ra(n)g raate raveh s terai chai ||
1168.e: Those who are imbued with love for You, O Lord, chant Your Name with joy.
Whom else should I worship? At whose feet should I bow? ||1||
I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Sovereign Lord King.

1168.g: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1168.t: jagajeevan jugat na milai kai ||1|| rahaau ||
1168.e: O Life of the Universe, there is no other way to meet You. ||1||Pause||
You have only One Form, and yet You have countless forms.
Which one should I worship? Before which one should I burn incense?

1168.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਹਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
1168.t: teraa a(n)t na paiaa kahaa pai ||
1168.e: Your limits cannot be found. How can anyone find them?
I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Sovereign Lord King. ||2||
The cycles of years and the places of pilgrimage are Yours, O Lord.
Your Name is True, O Transcendent Lord God.
Your State cannot be known, O Eternal, Unchanging Lord God.
Although You are unknown, still we chant Your Name. ||3||
What can poor Nanak say?
All people praise the One Lord.
Nanak places his head on the feet of such people.

1168.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ ਜੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
1168.t: balihaaree jaau jete tere naav hai ||4||2||
1168.e: I am a sacrifice to Your Names, as many as there are, O Lord. ||4||2||
Basant, First Mehla:
The kitchen is golden, and the cooking pots are golden.
The lines marking the cooking square are silver.

1168.g: ਗੰਗਾ ਕਾ ਉਦਕੁ ਕਰੰਤੇ ਕੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
1168.t: ga(n)gaa kaa udhak kara(n)te kee aag ||
1168.e: The water is from the Ganges, and the firewood is sanctified.
The food is soft rice, cooked in milk. ||1||

1168.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
1168.t: re man lekhai kabahoo na pai ||
1168.e: O my mind, these things are worthless,

1169.g: ਜਾਮਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਚ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1169.t: jaam na bheejai saach nai ||1|| rahaau ||
1169.e: if you are not drenched with the True Name. ||1||Pause||
One may have the eighteen Puraanas written in his own hand;
he may recite the four Vedas by heart,
and take ritual baths at holy festivals and give charitable donations;
he may observe the ritual fasts, and perform religious ceremonies day and night. ||2||
He may be a Qazi, a Mullah or a Shaykh,
a Yogi or a wandering hermit wearing saffron-colored robes;
he may be a householder, working at his job;
but without understanding the essence of devotional worship, all people are eventually bound and gagged, and driven along by the Messenger of Death. ||3||
Each person's karma is written on his forehead.
According to their deeds, they shall be judged.
Only the foolish and the ignorant issue commands.
O Nanak, the treasure of praise belongs to the True Lord alone. ||4||3||
Basant, Third Mehla:
A person may take off his clothes and be naked.
What Yoga does he practice by having matted and tangled hair?
If the mind is not pure, what use is it to hold the breath at the Tenth Gate?

1169.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਮੂੜੑਾ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
1169.t: bhram bhram aavai mooR(h)aa vaaro vaar ||1||
1169.e: The fool wanders and wanders, entering the cycle of reincarnation again and again. ||1||
Meditate on the One Lord, O my foolish mind,

1169.g: ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਇਕ ਖਿਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1169.t: paar utar jaeh ik khinaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
1169.e: and you shall cross over to the other side in an instant. ||1||Pause||
Some recite and expound on the Simritees and the Shaastras;
some sing the Vedas and read the Puraanas;
but they practice hypocrisy and deception with their eyes and minds.
The Lord does not even come near them. ||2||
Even if someone practices such self-discipline,
compassion and devotional worship
- if he is filled with greed, and his mind is engrossed in corruption,
how can he find the Immaculate Lord? ||3||
What can the created being do?
The Lord Himself moves him.
If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then his doubts are dispelled.
If the mortal realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he obtains the True Lord. ||4||
If someone's soul is polluted within,
what is the use of his traveling to sacred shrines of pilgrimage all over the world?
O Nanak, when one joins the Society of the True Guru,
then the bonds of the terrifying world-ocean are broken. ||5||4||
Basant, First Mehla:
All the worlds have been fascinated and enchanted by Your Maya, O Lord.

1169.g: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਰਬ ਤੋਹ ॥
1169.t: mai avar na dheesai sarab toh ||
1169.e: I do not see any other at all - You are everywhere.
You are the Master of Yogis, the Divinity of the divine.

1169.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
1169.t: har naam milai gur charan sev ||1||
1169.e: Serving at the Guru's Feet, the Name of the Lord is received. ||1||
O my Beauteous, Deep and Profound Beloved Lord.

1169.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਤੂ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1169.t: gurmukh raam naam gun gaae too apara(n)par sarab paal ||1|| rahaau ||
1169.e: As Gurmukh, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name. You are Infinite, the Cherisher of all. ||1||Pause||

1169.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
1169.t: bin saadh na paieeaai har kaa sa(n)g ||
1169.e: Without the Holy Saint, association with the Lord is not obtained.
Without the Guru, one's very fiber is stained with filth.

1169.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1169.t: bin har naam na sudh hoi ||
1169.e: Without the Lord's Name, one cannot become pure.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sing the Praises of the True Lord. ||2||
O Savior Lord, that person whom You have saved
- You lead him to meet the True Guru, and so take care of him.
You take away his poisonous egotism and attachment.
You dispel all his sufferings, O Sovereign Lord God. ||3||

1169.g: ਊਤਮ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
1169.t: uootam gat mit har gun sareer ||
1169.e: His state and condition are sublime; the Lord's Glorious Virtues permeate his body.
Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the diamond of the Lord's Name is revealed.

1169.g: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਜਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
1169.t: liv laagee naam taj dhoojaa bhaau ||
1169.e: He is lovingly attuned to the Naam; he is rid of the love of duality.

1169.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੪॥੫॥
1169.t: jan naanak har gur gur milaau ||4||5||
1169.e: O Lord, let servant Nanak meet the Guru. ||4||5||
Basant, First Mehla:
O my friends and companions, listen with love in your heart.
My Husband Lord is Incomparably Beautiful; He is always with me.

1169.g: ਓਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਾਇ ॥
1169.t: oh alakh na lakheeaai kahahu kai ||
1169.e: He is Unseen - He cannot be seen. How can I describe Him?

1170.e: The Guru has shown me that my Sovereign Lord God is with me. ||1||

1170.g: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਨੇ ॥
1170.t: mil sakhee sahelee har gun bane ||
1170.e: Joining together with my friends and companions, I am adorned with the Lord's Glorious Virtues.

1170.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਮਨ ਮਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1170.t: har prabh sa(n)g kheleh var kaaman gurmukh khojat man mane ||1|| rahaau ||
1170.e: The sublime soul-brides play with their Lord God. The Gurmukhs look within themselves; their minds are filled with faith. ||1||Pause||
The self-willed manmukhs, suffering in separation, do not understand this mystery.

1170.g: ਓਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੇਉ ॥
1170.t: oh ghaT ghaT raavai sarab preau ||
1170.e: The Beloved Lord of all celebrates in each and every heart.
The Gurmukh is stable, knowing that God is always with him.
The Guru has implanted the Naam within me; I chant it, and meditate on it. ||2||

1170.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
1170.t: bin gur bhagat na bhaau hoi ||
1170.e: Without the Guru, devotional love does not well up within.

1170.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
1170.t: bin gur sa(n)t na sa(n)g dhei ||
1170.e: Without the Guru, one is not blessed with the Society of the Saints.
Without the Guru, the blind cry out, entangled in worldly affairs.

1170.g: ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
1170.t: man gurmukh niramal mal sabadh khoi ||3||
1170.e: That mortal who becomes Gurmukh becomes immaculate; the Word of the Shabad washes away his filth. ||3||
Uniting with the Guru, the mortal conquers and subdues his mind.
Day and night, he savors the Yoga of devotional worship.

1170.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
1170.t: gur sa(n)t sabhaa dhukh miTai rog ||
1170.e: Associating with the Saint Guru, suffering and sickness are ended.

1170.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
1170.t: jan naanak har var sahaj jog ||4||6||
1170.e: Servant Nanak merges with his Husband Lord, in the Yoga of intuitive ease. ||4||6||
Basant, First Mehla:
By His Creative Power, God fashioned the creation.
The King of kings Himself adminsters true justice.
The most sublime Word of the Guru's Teachings is always with us.
The wealth of the Lord's Name, the source of nectar, is easily acquired. ||1||

1170.g: ਮਤ ਬਿਸਰਸਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
1170.t: mat bisaras re man raam bol ||
1170.e: So chant the Name of the Lord; do not forget it, O my mind.

1170.g: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲਾਏ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੋਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1170.t: apara(n)par agam agochar gurmukh har aap tulaae atul tol ||1|| rahaau ||
1170.e: The Lord is Infinite, Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; His weight cannot be weighed, but He Himself allows the Gurmukh to weigh Him. ||1||Pause||
Your GurSikhs serve at the Guru's Feet.

1170.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਤਰੇ ਤਜਿ ਮੇਰ ਤੋਰ ॥
1170.t: gur sev tare taj mer tor ||
1170.e: Serving the Guru, they are carried across; they have abandoned any distinction between 'mine' and 'yours'.
The slanderous and greedy people are hard-hearted.

1170.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਸਿ ਚੋਰ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
1170.t: gur sev na bhaiee s chor chor ||2||
1170.e: Those who do not love to serve the Guru are the most thieving of thieves. ||2||
When the Guru is pleased, He blesses the mortals with loving devotional worship of the Lord.

1170.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
1170.t: gur tuThai paieeaai har mahal Thaau ||
1170.e: When the Guru is pleased, the mortal obtains a place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
So renounce slander, and awaken in devotional worship of the Lord.
Devotion to the Lord is wonderful; it comes through good karma and destiny. ||3||
The Guru unites in union with the Lord, and grants the gift of the Name.
The Guru loves His Sikhs, day and night.

1170.g: ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
1170.t: fal naam paraapat gur tus dhei ||
1170.e: They obtain the fruit of the Naam, when the Guru's favor is bestowed.
Says Nanak, those who receive it are very rare indeed. ||4||7||
Basant, Third Mehla, Ek-Thukay:
When it pleases our Lord and Master, His servant serves Him.
He remains dead while yet alive, and redeems all his ancestors. ||1||

1170.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਹਸੈ ॥
1170.t: teree bhagat na chhoddau kiaa ko hasai ||
1170.e: I shall not renounce Your devotional worship, O Lord; what does it matter if people laugh at me?

1170.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1170.t: saach naam merai hiradhai vasai ||1|| rahaau ||
1170.e: The True Name abides within my heart. ||1||Pause||

1170.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗਲਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
1170.t: jaise maiaa moh praanee galat rahai ||
1170.e: Just as the mortal remains engrossed in attachment to Maya,

1170.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਵਤ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
1170.t: taise sa(n)t jan raam naam ravat rahai ||2||
1170.e: so does the Lord's humble Saint remain absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||2||

1170.g: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ॥
1170.t: mai moorakh mugadh uoopar karahu dhiaa ||
1170.e: I am foolish and ignorant, O Lord; please be merciful to me.
May I remain in Your Sanctuary. ||3||

1170.g: ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
1170.t: kahat naanak sa(n)saar ke nihafal kaamaa ||
1170.e: Says Nanak, worldly affairs are fruitless.

1170.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
1170.t: gur prasaadh ko paavai a(n)mirat naamaa ||4||8||
1170.e: Only by Guru's Grace does one receive the Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||

1170.t: mahalaa pehilaa basa(n)t hi(n)ddol ghar doojaa
1170.e: First Mehla, Basant Hindol, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1170.g: ਸਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਬਿਪ ਪੂਜਿ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
1170.t: saal graam bip pooj manaavahu sukirat tulasee maalaa ||
1170.e: O Brahmin, you worship and believe in your stone-god, and wear your ceremonial rosary beads.

1170.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਬੇੜਾ ਬਾਂਧਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੧॥
1170.t: raam naam jap beRaa baa(n)dhahu dhiaa karahu dhiaalaa ||1||
1170.e: Chant the Name of the Lord. Build your boat, and pray, ""O Merciful Lord, please be merciful to me.""||1||

1171.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਲਰਾ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੁ ॥
1171.t: kaahe kalaraa si(n)chahu janam gavaavahu ||
1171.e: Why do you irrigate the barren, alkaline soil? You are wasting your life away!

1171.g: ਕਾਚੀ ਢਹਗਿ ਦਿਵਾਲ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਚੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1171.t: kaachee ddahag dhivaal kaahe gach laavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
1171.e: This wall of mud is crumbling. Why bother to patch it with plaster? ||1||Pause||

1171.g: ਕਰ ਹਰਿਹਟ ਮਾਲ ਟਿੰਡ ਪਰੋਵਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ॥
1171.t: kar harihaT maal Ti(n)dd parovahu tis bheetar man jovahu ||
1171.e: Let your hands be the buckets, strung on the chain, and yoke the mind as the ox to pull it; draw the water up from the well.

1171.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਭਰਹੁ ਕਿਆਰੇ ਤਉ ਮਾਲੀ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
1171.t: a(n)mrit si(n)chahu bharahu kiaare tau maalee ke hovahu ||2||
1171.e: Irrigate your fields with the Ambrosial Nectar, and you shall be owned by God the Gardener. ||2||

1171.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਸੋਲੇ ਗੋਡਹੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
1171.t: kaam karodh dhui karahu basole goddahu dharatee bhaiee ||
1171.e: Let sexual desire and anger be your two shovels, to dig up the dirt of your farm, O Siblings of Destiny.

1171.g: ਜਿਉ ਗੋਡਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
1171.t: jiau goddahu tiau tum(h) sukh paavahu kirat na meTiaa jaiee ||3||
1171.e: The more you dig, the more peace you shall find. Your past actions cannot be erased. ||3||

1171.g: ਬਗੁਲੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
1171.t: bagule te fun ha(n)sulaa hovai je too kareh dhiaalaa ||
1171.e: The crane is again transformed into a swan, if You so will, O Merciful Lord.

1171.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੯॥
1171.t: pranavat naanak dhaasan dhaasaa dhiaa karahu dhiaalaa ||4||1||9||
1171.e: Prays Nanak, the slave of Your slaves: O Merciful Lord, have mercy on me. ||4||1||9||

1171.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ॥
1171.t: basa(n)t mahalaa pehilaa hi(n)ddol ||
1171.e: Basant, First Mehla, Hindol:

1171.g: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੀ ਵਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਝੀ ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਧਨ ਵਖੇ ॥
1171.t: saahuraRee vath sabh kichh saajhee pevakaRai dhan vakhe ||
1171.e: In the House of the Husband Lord - in the world hereafter, everything is jointly owned; but in this world - in the house of the soul-bride's parents, the soul-bride owns them separately.

1171.g: ਆਪਿ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਊ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਖੇ ॥੧॥
1171.t: aap kuchajee dhos na dheuoo jaanaa naahee rakhe ||1||
1171.e: She herself is ill-mannered; how can she blame anyone else? She does not know how to take care of these things. ||1||

1171.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਹਉ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
1171.t: mere saahibaa hau aape bharam bhulaanee ||
1171.e: O my Lord and Master, I am deluded by doubt.

1171.g: ਅਖਰ ਲਿਖੇ ਸੇਈ ਗਾਵਾ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1171.t: akhar likhe seiee gaavaa avar na jaanaa baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
1171.e: I sing the Word which You have written; I do not know any other Word. ||1||Pause||

1171.g: ਕਢਿ ਕਸੀਦਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਚੋਲੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੁਮੑ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
1171.t: kadd kaseedhaa pahireh cholee taa(n) tum(h) jaanahu naaree ||
1171.e: She alone is known as the Lord's bride, who embroiders her gown in the Name.

1171.g: ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
1171.t: je ghar raakheh buraa na chaakheh hoveh ka(n)t piaaree ||2||
1171.e: She who preserves and protects the home of her own heart and does not taste of evil, shall be the Beloved of her Husband Lord. ||2||

1171.g: ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਦੁਇ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
1171.t: je too(n) paRiaa pa(n)ddit beenaa dhui akhar dhui naavaa ||
1171.e: If you are a learned and wise religious scholar, then make a boat of the letters of the Lord's Name.

1171.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਲੰਘਾਏ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਾਂ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੦॥
1171.t: pranavat naanak ek la(n)ghaae je kar sach samaavaa(n) ||3||2||10||
1171.e: Prays Nanak, the One Lord shall carry you across, if you merge in the True Lord. ||3||2||10||

1171.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1171.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa pehilaa ||
1171.e: Basant Hindol, First Mehla:

1171.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਨਗਰੀ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
1171.t: raajaa baalak nagaree kaachee dhusaTaa naal piaaro ||
1171.e: The king is just a boy, and his city is vulnerable. He is in love with his wicked enemies.

1171.g: ਦੁਇ ਮਾਈ ਦੁਇ ਬਾਪਾ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
1171.t: dhui maiee dhui baapaa paRe'eh pa(n)ddit karahu beechaaro ||1||
1171.e: He reads of his two mothers and his two fathers; O Pandit, reflect on this. ||1||

1171.g: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੰਡਿਤਾ ਤੁਮੑ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ॥
1171.t: suaamee pa(n)dditaa tum(h) dheh matee ||
1171.e: O Master Pandit, teach me about this.

1171.g: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1171.t: kin bidh paavau praanapatee ||1|| rahaau ||
1171.e: How can I obtain the Lord of life? ||1||Pause||

1171.g: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪੰਡੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1171.t: bheetar agan banaasapat maulee saagar pa(n)ddai paiaa ||
1171.e: There is fire within the plants which bloom; the ocean is tied into a bundle.

1171.g: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1171.t: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui ghar hee bheetar aaisaa giaan na paiaa ||2||
1171.e: The sun and the moon dwell in the same home in the sky. You have not obtained this knowledge. ||2||

1171.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਵੰਤਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਇਕ ਮਾਈ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
1171.t: raam rava(n)taa jaaneeaai ik maiee bhog karei ||
1171.e: One who knows the All-pervading Lord, eats up the one mother - Maya.

1171.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਖਿਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੇਇ ॥੩॥
1171.t: taa ke lakhan jaane'eeh khimaa dhan sa(n)grahei ||3||
1171.e: Know that the sign of such a person is that he gathers the wealth of compassion. ||3||

1171.g: ਕਹਿਆ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਨ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
1171.t: kahiaa suneh na khaiaa maaneh tin(h)aa hee setee vaasaa ||
1171.e: The mind lives with those who do not listen, and do not admit what they eat.

1171.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਤੋਲਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੧॥
1171.t: pranavat naanak dhaasan dhaasaa khin tolaa khin maasaa ||4||3||11||
1171.e: Prays Nanak, the slave of the Lord's slave: one instant the mind is huge, and the next instant, it is tiny. ||4||3||11||

1171.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1171.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa pehilaa ||
1171.e: Basant Hindol, First Mehla:

1171.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
1171.t: saachaa saahu guroo sukhadhaataa har mele bhukh gavaae ||
1171.e: The Guru is the True Banker, the Giver of peace; He unites the mortal with the Lord, and satisfies his hunger.

1171.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
1171.t: kar kirapaa har bhagat dhiraRaae anadhin har gun gaae ||1||
1171.e: Granting His Grace, He implants devotional worship of the Lord within; and then night and day, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

1171.g: ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
1171.t: mat bhooleh re man chet haree ||
1171.e: O my mind, do not forget the Lord; keep Him in your consciousness.

1171.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1171.t: bin gur mukat naahee trai loiee gurmukh paieeaai naam haree ||1|| rahaau ||
1171.e: Without the Guru, no one is liberated anywhere in the three worlds. The Gurmukh obtains the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

1171.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਨਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
1171.t: bin bhagatee nahee satigur paieeaai bin bhaagaa nahee bhagat haree ||
1171.e: Without devotional worship, the True Guru is not obtained. Without good destiny, devotional worship of the Lord is not obtained.

1171.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
1171.t: bin bhaagaa satasa(n)g na paieeaai karam milai har naam haree ||2||
1171.e: Without good destiny, the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is not obtained. By the grace of one's good karma, the Lord's Name is received. ||2||

1171.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥
1171.t: ghaT ghaT gupat upaae vekhai paragaT gurmukh sa(n)t janaa ||
1171.e: In each and every heart, the Lord is hidden; He creates and watches over all. He reveals Himself in the humble, Saintly Gurmukhs.

1171.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥
1171.t: har har kareh su har ra(n)g bheene har jal a(n)mirat naam manaa ||3||
1171.e: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are drenched with the Lord's Love. Their minds are drenched with the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

1172.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤਖਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਕੀਏ ॥
1172.t: jin kau takhat milai vaddiaaiee gurmukh se paradhaan ke'ee ||
1172.e: Those who are blessed with the glory of the Lord's Throne - those Gurmukhs are renowned as supreme.

1172.g: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਥੀਏ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨॥
1172.t: paaras bheT bhe se paaras naanak har gur sa(n)g the'ee ||4||4||12||
1172.e: Touching the philosopher's stone, they themselves becomes the philosopher's stone; they become the companions of the Lord, the Guru. ||4||4||12||

1172.t: basa(n)t mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa dhutuke
1172.e: Basant, Third Mehla, First House, Dho-Thukay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Throughout the months and the seasons, the Lord is always in bloom.
He rejuvenates all beings and creatures.
What can I say? I am just a worm.

1172.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
1172.t: teraa kinai na paiaa aadh a(n)t ||1||
1172.e: No one has found Your beginning or Your end, O Lord. ||1||
Those who serve You, Lord,

1172.g: ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1172.t: param sukh paaveh aatam dhev ||1|| rahaau ||
1172.e: obtain the greatest peace; their souls are so divine. ||1||Pause||
If the Lord is merciful, then the mortal is allowed to serve Him.
By Guru's Grace, he remains dead while yet alive.
Night and day, he chants the True Name;
in this way, he crosses over the treacherous world-ocean. ||2||
The Creator created both poison and nectar.

1172.g: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਕਉ ਦੁਇ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ ॥
1172.t: sa(n)saar birakh kau dhui fal laae ||
1172.e: He attached these two fruits to the world-plant.
The Creator Himself is the Doer, the Cause of all.
He feeds all as He pleases. ||3||
O Nanak, when He casts His Glance of Grace,
He Himself bestows His Ambrosial Naam.
Thus, the desire for sin and corruption is ended.
The Lord Himself carries out His Own Will. ||4||1||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Those who are attuned to the True Lord's Name are happy and exalted.
Take pity on me, O God, Merciful to the meek.

1172.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
1172.t: tis bin avar nahee mai koi ||
1172.e: Without Him, I have no other at all.
As it pleases His Will, He keeps me. ||1||
The Guru, the Lord, is pleasing to my mind.

1172.g: ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1172.t: reh na sakau dharasan dhekhe bin sahaj milau gur mel milaae ||1|| rahaau ||
1172.e: I cannot even survive, without the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. But I shall easily unite with the Guru, if He unites me in His Union. ||1||Pause||
The greedy mind is enticed by greed.
Forgetting the Lord, it regrets and repents in the end.
The separated ones are reunited, when they are inspired to serve the Guru.
They are blessed with the Lord's Name - such is the destiny written on their foreheads. ||2||

1172.g: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
1172.t: paun paanee kee ieh dheh sareeraa ||
1172.e: This body is built of air and water.
The body is afflicted with the terribly painful illness of egotism.

1172.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
1172.t: gurmukh raam naam dhaaroo gun gaiaa ||
1172.e: The Gurmukh has the Medicine: singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.
Granting His Grace, the Guru has cured the illness. ||3||
The four evils are the four rivers of fire flowing through the body.
It is burning in desire, and burning in egotism.
Those whom the Guru protects and saves are very fortunate.

1172.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
1172.t: jan naanak ur har a(n)mrit dhaare ||4||2||
1172.e: Servant Nanak enshrines the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in his heart. ||4||2||
Basant, Third Mehla:

1172.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
1172.t: har seve so har kaa log ||
1172.e: One who serves the Lord is the Lord's person.

1172.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
1172.t: saach sahaj kadhe na hovai sog ||
1172.e: He dwells in intuitive peace, and never suffers in sorrow.

1172.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1172.t: manmukh mue naahee har man maeh ||
1172.e: The self-willed manmukhs are dead; the Lord is not within their minds.

1172.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਭੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
1172.t: mar mar ja(n)meh bhee mar jaeh ||1||
1172.e: They die and die again and again, and are reincarnated, only to die once more. ||1||

1172.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੀਵੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1172.t: se jan jeeve jin har man maeh ||
1172.e: They alone are alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.
They contemplate the True Lord, and are absorbed in the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

1172.g: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
1172.t: har na seveh te har te dhoor ||
1172.e: Those who do not serve the Lord are far away from the Lord.
They wander in foreign lands, with dust thrown on their heads.
The Lord Himself enjoins His humble servants to serve Him.

1172.g: ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
1172.t: tin sadhaa sukh hai til na tamai ||2||
1172.e: They live in peace forever, and have no greed at all. ||2||

1173.e: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, egotism is eradicated.
Then, the mortal is honored in the Court of the True Lord.
He sees the Dear Lord always close at hand, ever-present.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he sees the Lord pervading and permeating all. ||3||
The Lord cherishes all beings and creatures.
By Guru's Grace, contemplate Him forever.

1173.g: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
1173.t: dhar saachai pat siau ghar jai ||
1173.e: You shall go to your true home in the Lord's Court with honor.
O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall be blessed with glorious greatness. ||4||3||
Basant, Third Mehla:
One who worships the Lord within his mind,
sees the One and Only Lord, and no other.
People in duality suffer terrible pain.
The True Guru has shown me the One Lord. ||1||
My God is in bloom, forever in spring.

1173.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1173.t: eih man mauliaa gai gun gobi(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
1173.e: This mind blossoms forth, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
So consult the Guru, and reflect upon His wisdom;
then, you shall be in love with the True Lord God.
Abandon your self-conceit, and be His loving servant.
Then, the Life of the World shall come to dwell in your mind. ||2||
Worship Him with devotion, and see Him always ever-present, close at hand.
My God is forever permeating and pervading all.

1173.g: ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
1173.t: eis bhagatee kaa koiee jaanai bheau ||
1173.e: Only a rare few know the mystery of this devotional worship.
My God is the Enlightener of all souls. ||3||
The True Guru Himself unites us in His Union.
He Himself links our consciousness to the Lord, the Life of the World.
Thus, our minds and bodies are rejuvenated with intuitive ease.
O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we remain attuned to the String of His Love. ||4||4||
Basant, Third Mehla:

1173.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
1173.t: bhagat vachhal har vasai man aai ||
1173.e: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells within their minds,
by Guru's Grace, with intuitive ease.
Through devotional worship, self-conceit is eradicated from within,
and then, one meets the True Lord. ||1||

1173.g: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
1173.t: bhagat soheh sadhaa har prabh dhuaar ||
1173.e: His devotees are forever beauteous at the Door of the Lord God.

1173.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1173.t: gur kai het saachai prem piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1173.e: Loving the Guru, they have love and affection for the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

1173.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1173.t: bhagat kare so jan niramal hoi ||
1173.e: That humble being who worships the Lord with devotion becomes immaculate and pure.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism is eradicated from within.

1173.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
1173.t: har jeeau aap vasai man aai ||
1173.e: The Dear Lord Himself comes to dwell within the mind,
and the mortal remains immersed in peace, tranquility and intuitive ease. ||2||
Those who are imbued with Truth, are forever in the bloom of spring.

1173.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਰਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਵਿੰਦ ॥
1173.t: man tan hariaa rav gun guvi(n)dh ||
1173.e: Their minds and bodies are rejuvenated, uttering the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
Without the Lord's Name, the world is dry and parched.
It burns in the fire of desire, over and over again. ||3||

1173.g: ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1173.t: soiee kare j har jeeau bhaavai ||
1173.e: One who does only that which is pleasing to the Dear Lord

1173.g: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
1173.t: sadhaa sukh sareer bhaanai chit laavai ||
1173.e: - his body is forever at peace, and his consciousness is attached to the Lord's Will.
He serves His God with intuitive ease.
O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in his mind. ||4||5||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.
The mind and body are rejuvenated by the Love of the True Guru.
The tree bears fruit at the Lord's Door,
in love with the True Bani of the Guru's Word, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
This mind is rejuvenated, with intuitive ease;

1173.g: ਸਚ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1173.t: sach fal laagai satigur bhai ||1|| rahaau ||
1173.e: loving the True Guru, it bears the fruit of truth. ||1||Pause||
He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away.

1173.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
1173.t: gur kai sabadh vekhai sadh hajoor ||
1173.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is seen to be ever-present, close at hand.
The plants have blossomed forth, giving a dense shade.
The Gurmukh blossoms forth, with intuitive ease. ||2||
Night and day, he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night.
The True Guru drives out sin and doubt from within.

1174.e: Gazing upon the wonder of God's Creation, I am wonder-struck and amazed.
The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, by His Grace. ||3||
The Creator Himself enjoys all delights.

1174.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਹੋਗ ॥
1174.t: jo kichh kare soiee par hog ||
1174.e: Whatever He does, surely comes to pass.
He is the Great Giver; He has no greed at all.
O Nanak, living the Word of the Shabad, the mortal meets with God. ||4||6||
Basant, Third Mehla:
By perfect destiny, one acts in truth.

1174.g: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
1174.t: eko chetai fir jon na aavai ||
1174.e: Remembering the One Lord, one does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation.

1174.g: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
1174.t: safal janam is jag meh aaiaa ||
1174.e: Fruitful is the coming into the world, and the life of one
who remains intuitively absorbed in the True Name. ||1||
The Gurmukh acts, lovingly attuned to the Lord.

1174.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1174.t: har naam sevahu vichahu aap gavai ||1|| rahaau ||
1174.e: Be dedicated to the Lord's Name, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||1||Pause||

1174.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1174.t: tis jan kee hai saachee baanee ||
1174.e: True is the speech of that humble being;

1174.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
1174.t: gur kai sabadh jag maeh samaanee ||
1174.e: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is spread throughout the world.
Throughout the four ages, his fame and glory spread.
Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Lord's humble servant is recognized and renowned. ||2||

1174.g: ਇਕਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
1174.t: eik saachai sabadh rahe liv lai ||
1174.e: Some remain lovingly attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.
True are those humble beings who love the True Lord.
They meditate on the True Lord, and behold Him near at hand, ever-present.

1174.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
1174.t: sa(n)t janaa kee pag pa(n)kaj dhoor ||3||
1174.e: They are the dust of the lotus feet of the humble Saints. ||3||
There is only One Creator Lord; there is no other at all.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, comes Union with the Lord.

1174.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1174.t: jin sach seviaa tin ras paiaa ||
1174.e: Whoever serves the True Lord finds joy.
O Nanak, he is intuitively absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||7||
Basant, Third Mehla:
The Lord's humble servant worships Him, and beholds Him ever-present, near at hand.

1174.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
1174.t: sa(n)t janaa kee pag pa(n)kaj dhoor ||
1174.e: He is the dust of the lotus feet of the humble Saints.

1174.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
1174.t: har setee sadh raheh liv lai ||
1174.e: Those who remain lovingly attuned to the Lord forever
are blessed with understanding by the Perfect True Guru. ||1||

1174.g: ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
1174.t: dhaasaa kaa dhaas viralaa koiee hoi ||
1174.e: How rare are those who become the slave of the Lord's slaves.
They attain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||
So serve the One Lord, and no other.
Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.

1174.g: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
1174.t: naa oh marai na aavai jai ||
1174.e: He does not die; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

1174.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
1174.t: tis bin avar sevee kiau mai ||2||
1174.e: Why should I serve any other than Him, O my mother? ||2||

1174.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
1174.t: se jan saache jinee saach pachhaaniaa ||
1174.e: True are those humble beings who realize the True Lord.
Conquering their self-conceit, they merge intuitively into the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Gurmukhs gather in the Naam.
Their minds are immaculate, and their reputations are immaculate. ||3||

1174.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
1174.t: jin giaan keeaa tis har too jaan ||
1174.e: Know the Lord, who gave you spiritual wisdom,
and realize the One God, through the True Word of the Shabad.

1174.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
1174.t: har ras chaakhai taa(n) sudh hoi ||
1174.e: When the mortal tastes the sublime essence of the Lord, he becomes pure and holy.
O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam - their reputations are true. ||4||8||
Basant, Third Mehla:

1174.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਕੁਲਾਂ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
1174.t: naam rate kulaa(n) kaa kareh udhaar ||
1174.e: Those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord - their generations are redeemed and saved.
True is their speech; they love the Naam.
Why have the wandering self-willed manmukhs even come into the world?
Forgetting the Naam, the mortals waste their lives away. ||1||
One who dies while yet alive, truly dies, and embellishes his death.

1174.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1174.t: gur kai sabadh saach ur dhaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
1174.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he enshrines the True Lord within his heart. ||1||Pause||
Truth is the food of the Gurmukh; his body is sanctified and pure.
His mind is immaculate; he is forever the ocean of virtue.
He is not forced to come and go in the cycle of birth and death.
By Guru's Grace, he merges in the True Lord. ||2||
Serving the True Lord, one realizes Truth.

1174.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
1174.t: gur kai sabadh har dhar neesaanai ||
1174.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he goes to the Lord's Court with his banners flying proudly.

1175.e: In the Court of the True Lord, he obtains true glory.
He comes to dwell in the home of his own inner being. ||3||
He cannot be fooled; He is the Truest of the True.

1175.g: ਹੋਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਲਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
1175.t: hor sabh bhooleh dhoojai pat khoi ||
1175.e: All others are deluded; in duality, they lose their honor.
So serve the True Lord, through the True Bani of His Word.
O Nanak, through the Naam, merge in the True Lord. ||4||9||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Without the grace of good karma, all are deluded by doubt.
In attachment to Maya, they suffer in terrible pain.
The blind, self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest.

1175.g: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
1175.t: bisaTaa kaa keeRaa bisaTaa maeh samaiee ||1||
1175.e: They are like maggots in manure, rotting away in manure. ||1||
That humble being who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command is accepted.

1175.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1175.t: gur kai sabadh naam neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
1175.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is blessed with the insignia and the banner of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1175.g: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1175.t: saach rate jin(h)aa dhur likh paiaa ||
1175.e: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny are imbued with the Naam.

1175.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1175.t: har kaa naam sadhaa man bhaiaa ||
1175.e: The Name of the Lord is forever pleasing to their minds.

1175.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1175.t: satigur kee baanee sadhaa sukh hoi ||
1175.e: Through the Bani, the Word of the True Guru, eternal peace is found.
Through it, one's light merges into the Light. ||2||
Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, can save the world.
By Guru's Grace, one comes to love the Naam.

1175.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1175.t: bin naamai mukat kinai na paiee ||
1175.e: Without the Naam, no one obtains liberation.

1175.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
1175.t: poore gur te naam palai paiee ||3||
1175.e: Through the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained. ||3||
He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself causes to understand.
Serving the True Guru, the Naam is implanted within.

1175.g: ਜਿਨ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
1175.t: jin ik jaataa se jan paravaan ||
1175.e: Those humble beings who know the One Lord are approved and accepted.
O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, they go to the Lord's Court with His banner and insignia. ||4||10||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Granting His Grace, the Lord leads the mortal to meet the True Guru.
The Lord Himself comes to abide in his mind.
His intellect becomes steady and stable, and his mind is strengthened forever.
He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Ocean of Virtue. ||1||
Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord - those mortals die eating poison.

1175.g: ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1175.t: birathaa janam fir aaveh jai ||1|| rahaau ||
1175.e: Their lives are wasted uselessly, and they continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

1175.g: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
1175.t: bahu bhekh kareh man saa(n)t na hoi ||
1175.e: They wear all sorts of religious robes, but their minds are not at peace.
In great egotism, they lose their honor.
But those who realize the Word of the Shabad, are blessed by great good fortune.
They bring their distractible minds back home. ||2||
Within the home of the inner self is the inaccessible and infinite substance.
Those who find it, by following the Guru's Teachings, contemplate the Shabad.

1175.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1175.t: naam nav nidh paiee ghar hee maeh ||
1175.e: Those who obtain the nine treasures of the Naam within the home of their own inner being,
are forever dyed in the color of the Lord's Love; they are absorbed in the Truth. ||3||

1175.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1175.t: aap kare kichh karan na jai ||
1175.e: God Himself does everything; no one can do anything at all by himself.
When God so wills, He merges the mortal into Himself.

1175.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
1175.t: tis te neRai naahee ko dhoor ||
1175.e: All are near Him; no one is far away from Him.
O Nanak, the Naam is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||11||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remember the Lord with love,
and you shall remain satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord's Name.

1175.g: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
1175.t: koT koTa(n)tar ke paap jal jaeh ||
1175.e: The sins of millions upon millions of lifetimes shall be burnt away.
Remaining dead while yet alive, you shall be absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||

1175.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
1175.t: har kee dhaat har jeeau jaanai ||
1175.e: The Dear Lord Himself knows His own bountiful blessings.

1175.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1175.t: gur kai sabadh ih man mauliaa har gunadhaataa naam vakhaanai ||1|| rahaau ||
1175.e: This mind blossoms forth in the Guru's Shabad, chanting the Name of the Lord, the Giver of virtue. ||1||Pause||

1175.g: ਭਗਵੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
1175.t: bhagavai ves bhram mukat na hoi ||
1175.e: No one is liberated by wandering around in saffron-colored robes.

1175.g: ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
1175.t: bahu sa(n)jam saa(n)t na paavai koi ||
1175.e: Tranquility is not found by strict self-discipline.
But by following the Guru's Teachings, one is blessed to receive the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
By great good fortune, one finds the Lord. ||2||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, glorious greatness comes through the Lord's Name.

1176.e: Through the Perfect Guru, it is obtained.
Those who are imbued with the Naam find everlasting peace.
But without the Naam, mortals burn in egotism. ||3||
By great good furtune, some contemplate the Lord's Name.
Through the Lord's Name, all sorrows are eradicated.
He dwells within the heart, and pervades the external universe as well.
O Nanak, the Creator Lord knows all. ||4||12||
Basant, Third Mehla, Ek-Thukay:
I am just a worm, created by You, O Lord.
If you bless me, then I chant Your Primal Mantra. ||1||
I chant and reflect on His Glorious Virtues, O my mother.

1176.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1176.t: har jap har kai lagau pai ||1|| rahaau ||
1176.e: Meditating on the Lord, I fall at the Lord's Feet. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's Grace, I am addicted to the favor of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Why waste your life in hatred, vengeance and conflict? ||2||
When the Guru granted His Grace, my egotism was eradicated,
and then, I obtained the Lord's Name with intuitive ease. ||3||
The most lofty and exalted occupation is to contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
Nanak chants the True Name. ||4||1||13||
Basant, Third Mehla:
The season of spring has come, and all the plants have blossomed forth.
This mind blossoms forth, in association with the True Guru. ||1||
So meditate on the True Lord, O my foolish mind.

1176.g: ਤਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1176.t: taa(n) sukh paavahu mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1176.e: Only then shall you find peace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
This mind blossoms forth, and I am in ecstasy.
I am blessed with the Ambrosial Fruit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
Everyone speaks and says that the Lord is the One and Only.
By understanding the Hukam of His Command, we come to know the One Lord. ||3||

1176.g: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
1176.t: kahat naanak haumai kahai na koi ||
1176.e: Says Nanak, no one can describe the Lord by speaking through ego.

1176.g: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
1176.t: aakhan vekhan sabh saahib te hoi ||4||2||14||
1176.e: All speech and insight comes from our Lord and Master. ||4||2||14||
Basant, Third Mehla:
All the ages were created by You, O Lord.
Meeting with the True Guru, one's intellect is awakened. ||1||
O Dear Lord, please blend me with Yourself;

1176.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1176.t: gur kai sabadh sach naam samai ||1|| rahaau ||
1176.e: let me merge in the True Name, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
When the mind is in spring, all people are rejuvenated.

1176.g: ਫਲਹਿ ਫੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
1176.t: faleh fule'eeh raam naam sukh hoi ||2||
1176.e: Blossoming forth and flowering through the Lord's Name, peace is obtained. ||2||
Contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is in spring forever,
with the Lord's Name enshrined in the heart. ||3||

1176.g: ਮਨਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
1176.t: man basa(n)t tan man hariaa hoi ||
1176.e: When the mind is in spring, the body and mind are rejuvenated.

1176.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
1176.t: naanak ih tan birakh raam naam fal paae soi ||4||3||15||
1176.e: O Nanak, this body is the tree which bears the fruit of the Lord's Name. ||4||3||15||
Basant, Third Mehla:

1176.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
1176.t: tin(h) basa(n)t jo har gun gai ||
1176.e: They alone are in the spring season, who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
They come to worship the Lord with devotion, through their perfect destiny. ||1||

1176.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਬਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
1176.t: eis man kau basa(n)t kee lagai na soi ||
1176.e: This mind is not even touched by spring.

1176.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਦੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1176.t: eih man jaliaa dhoojai dhoi ||1|| rahaau ||
1176.e: This mind is burnt by duality and double-mindedness. ||1||Pause||

1176.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਬਾਂਧਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
1176.t: eih man dha(n)dhai baa(n)dhaa karam kamai ||
1176.e: This mind is entangled in worldly affairs, creating more and more karma.
Enchanted by Maya, it cries out in suffering forever. ||2||

1176.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ॥
1176.t: eih man chhooTai jaa(n) satigur bheTai ||
1176.e: This mind is released, only when it meets with the True Guru.

1176.g: ਜਮਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਫੇਟੈ ॥੩॥
1176.t: jamakaal kee fir aavai na feTai ||3||
1176.e: Then, it does not suffer beatings by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

1176.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਲੀਆ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
1176.t: eih man chhooTaa gur leeaa chhaddai ||
1176.e: This mind is released, when the Guru emancipates it.
O Nanak, attachment to Maya is burnt away through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||4||16||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Spring has come, and all the plants are flowering.

1176.g: ਏਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
1176.t: eh jeea ja(n)t fooleh har chit lai ||1||
1176.e: These beings and creatures blossom forth when they focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1||

1177.g: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
1177.t: ein bidh ih man hariaa hoi ||
1177.e: In this way, this mind is rejuvenated.

1177.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1177.t: har har naam japai dhin raatee gurmukh haumai kaddai dhoi ||1|| rahaau ||
1177.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night, egotism is removed and washed away from the Gurmukhs. ||1||Pause||

1177.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
1177.t: satigur baanee sabadh sunaae ||
1177.e: The True Guru speaks the Bani of the Word, and the Shabad, the Word of God.

1177.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
1177.t: eih jag hariaa satigur bhaae ||2||
1177.e: This world blossoms forth in its greenery, through the love of the True Guru. ||2||

1177.g: ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
1177.t: fal fool laage jaa(n) aape laae ||
1177.e: The mortal blossoms forth in flower and fruit, when the Lord Himself so wills.

1177.g: ਮੂਲਿ ਲਗੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
1177.t: mool lagai taa(n) satigur paae ||3||
1177.e: He is attached to the Lord, the Primal Root of all, when he finds the True Guru. ||3||

1177.g: ਆਪਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਵਾੜੀ ॥
1177.t: aap basa(n)t jagat sabh vaaRee ||
1177.e: The Lord Himself is the season of spring; the whole world is His Garden.

1177.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੭॥
1177.t: naanak poorai bhaag bhagat niraalee ||4||5||17||
1177.e: O Nanak, this most unique devotional worship comes only by perfect destiny. ||4||5||17||

1177.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨
1177.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa teejaa ghar doojaa
1177.e: Basant Hindol, Third Mehla, Second House:

1177.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1177.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1177.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
1177.t: gur kee baanee viTahu vaariaa bhaiee gur sabadh viTahu bal jaiee ||
1177.e: I am a sacrifice to the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny. I am devoted and dedicated to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1177.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
1177.t: gur saalaahee sadh apanaa bhaiee gur charanee chit laiee ||1||
1177.e: I praise my Guru forever, O Siblings of Destiny. I focus my consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||1||

1177.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
1177.t: mere man raam naam chit lai ||
1177.e: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Lord's Name.

1177.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1177.t: man tan teraa hariaa hovai ik har naamaa fal pai ||1|| rahaau ||
1177.e: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in lush greenery, and you shall obtain the fruit of the Name of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

1177.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇ ॥
1177.t: gur raakhe se ubare bhaiee har ras a(n)mrit peeaai ||
1177.e: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, O Siblings of Destiny. They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime essence.

1177.g: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਉਠਿ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
1177.t: vichahu haumai dhukh uTh giaa bhaiee sukh vuThaa man aai ||2||
1177.e: The pain of egotism within is eradicated and banished, O Siblings of Destiny, and peace comes to dwell in their minds. ||2||

1177.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
1177.t: dhur aape jin(h)aa no bakhasion bhaiee sabadhe lian milai ||
1177.e: Those whom the Primal Lord Himself forgives, O Siblings of Destiny, are united with the Word of the Shabad.

1177.g: ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕੀ ਅਘੁਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
1177.t: dhooR tin(h)aa kee aghuleeaai bhaiee satasa(n)gat mel milai ||3||
1177.e: The dust of their feet brings emancipation; in the company of Sadh Sangat, the True Congregation, we are united with the Lord. ||3||

1177.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
1177.t: aap karaae kare aap bhaiee jin hariaa keeaa sabh koi ||
1177.e: He Himself does, and causes all to be done, O Siblings of Destiny; He makes everything blossom forth in green abundance.

1177.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੩੦॥
1177.t: naanak man tan sukh sadh vasai bhaiee sabadh milaavaa hoi ||4||1||18||12||18||30||
1177.e: O Nanak, peace fills their minds and bodies forever, O Siblings of Destiny; they are united with the Shabad. ||4||1||18||12||18||30||

1177.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਇਕ ਤੁਕੇ
1177.t: raag basa(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa ik tuke
1177.e: Raag Basant, Fourth Mehla, First House, Ik-Thukay:

1177.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1177.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1177.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1177.g: ਜਿਉ ਪਸਰੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
1177.t: jiau pasaree sooraj kiran jot ||
1177.e: Just as the light of the sun's rays spread out,

1177.g: ਤਿਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥੧॥
1177.t: tiau ghaT ghaT ramieeaa ot pot ||1||
1177.e: the Lord permeates each and every heart, through and through. ||1||

1177.g: ਏਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਇ ॥
1177.t: eko har raviaa srab thai ||
1177.e: The One Lord is permeating and pervading all places.

1177.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1177.t: gur sabadhee mileeaai meree mai ||1|| rahaau ||
1177.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with Him, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

1177.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
1177.t: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar eko har soi ||
1177.e: The One Lord is deep within each and every heart.

1177.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਇਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
1177.t: gur miliaai ik pragaT hoi ||2||
1177.e: Meeting with the Guru, the One Lord becomes manifest, radiating forth. ||2||

1177.g: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
1177.t: eko ek rahiaa bharapoor ||
1177.e: The One and Only Lord is present and prevailing everywhere.

1177.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਲੋਭੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
1177.t: saakat nar lobhee jaaneh dhoor ||3||
1177.e: The greedy, faithless cynic thinks that God is far away. ||3||

1177.g: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
1177.t: eko ek varatai har loi ||
1177.e: The One and Only Lord permeates and pervades the world.

1177.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
1177.t: naanak har ekuo kare su hoi ||4||1||
1177.e: O Nanak, whatever the One Lord does comes to pass. ||4||1||

1177.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1177.t: basa(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1177.e: Basant, Fourth Mehla:

1177.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਦੇ ਪਏ ॥
1177.t: rain dhinas dhui sadhe pe ||
1177.e: Day and night, the two calls are sent out.

1177.g: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਿ ਲਏ ॥੧॥
1177.t: man har simarahu a(n)t sadhaa rakh le ||1||
1177.e: O mortal, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, who protects you forever, and saves you in the end. ||1||

1177.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
1177.t: har har chet sadhaa man mere ||
1177.e: Concentrate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind.

1177.g: ਸਭੁ ਆਲਸੁ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1177.t: sabh aalas dhookh bha(n)j prabh paiaa gurmat gaavahu gun prabh kere ||1|| rahaau ||
1177.e: God the Destroyer of all depression and suffering is found, through the Guru's Teachings, singing the Glorious Praises of God. ||1||Pause||

1177.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੁਏ ॥
1177.t: manmukh fir fir haumai mue ||
1177.e: The self-willed manmukhs die of their egotism, over and over again.

1178.g: ਕਾਲਿ ਦੈਤਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥
1178.t: kaal dhait sa(n)ghaare jam pur ge ||2||
1178.e: They are destroyed by Death's demons, and they must go to the City of Death. ||2||

1178.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
1178.t: gurmukh har har har liv laage ||
1178.e: The Gurmukhs are lovingly attached to the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

1178.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਊ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
1178.t: janam maran dhouoo dhukh bhaage ||3||
1178.e: Their pains of both birth and death are taken away. ||3||

1178.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
1178.t: bhagat janaa kau har kirapaa dhaaree ||
1178.e: The Lord showers His Mercy on His humble devotees.

1178.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
1178.t: gur naanak tuThaa miliaa banavaaree ||4||2||
1178.e: Guru Nanak has shown mercy to me; I have met the Lord, the Lord of the forest. ||4||2||

1178.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨
1178.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
1178.e: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

1178.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1178.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1178.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1178.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਲੁਕਾਨੀ ॥
1178.t: raam naam ratan koThaRee gaR ma(n)dhar ek lukaanee ||
1178.e: The Lord's Name is a jewel, hidden in a chamber of the palace of the body-fortress.

1178.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
1178.t: satigur milai ta khojeeaai mil jotee jot samaanee ||1||
1178.e: When one meets the True Guru, then he searches and finds it, and his light merges with the Divine Light. ||1||

1178.g: ਮਾਧੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
1178.t: maadho saadhoo jan dheh milai ||
1178.e: O Lord, lead me to meet with the Holy Person, the Guru.

1178.g: ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1178.t: dhekhat dharas paap sabh naaseh pavitr param padh pai ||1|| rahaau ||
1178.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my sins are erased, and I obtain the supreme, sublime, sanctified status. ||1||Pause||

1178.g: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਗਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
1178.t: pa(n)ch chor mil laage nagareeaa raam naam dhan hiriaa ||
1178.e: The five thieves join together and plunder the body-village, stealing the wealth of the Lord's Name.

1178.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜ ਪਰੇ ਤਬ ਪਕਰੇ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਉਬਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
1178.t: gurmat khoj pare tab pakare dhan saabat raas ubariaa ||2||
1178.e: But through the Guru's Teachings, they are traced and caught, and this wealth is recovered intact. ||2||

1178.g: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਭਰਮ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1178.t: paakha(n)dd bharam upaav kar thaake ridh a(n)tar maiaa maiaa ||
1178.e: Practicing hypocrisy and superstition, people have grown weary of the effort, but still, deep within their hearts, they yearn for Maya, Maya.

1178.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1178.t: saadhoo purakh purakhapat paiaa agiaan a(n)dher gavaiaa ||3||
1178.e: By the Grace of the Holy Person, I have met with the Lord, the Primal Being, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||

1178.g: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
1178.t: jaga(n)naath jagadhees gusaiee kar kirapaa saadh milaavai ||
1178.e: The Lord, the Lord of the Earth, the Lord of the Universe, in His Mercy, leads me to meet the Holy Person, the Guru.

1178.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
1178.t: naanak saa(n)t hovai man a(n)tar nit hiradhai har gun gaavai ||4||1||3||
1178.e: O Nanak, peace then comes to abide deep within my mind, and I constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord within my heart. ||4||1||3||

1178.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ॥
1178.t: basa(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa hi(n)ddol ||
1178.e: Basant, Fourth Mehla, Hindol:

1178.g: ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਤੁਮਨਛੇ ॥
1178.t: tum(h) vadd purakh vadd agam gusaiee ham keere kiram tumanachhe ||
1178.e: You are the Great Supreme Being, the Vast and Inaccessible Lord of the World; I am a mere insect, a worm created by You.

1178.g: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਹਮ ਬਨਛੇ ॥੧॥
1178.t: har dheen dhiaal karahu prabh kirapaa gur satigur charan ham banachhe ||1||
1178.e: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, please grant Your Grace; O God, I long for the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||

1178.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਛੇ ॥
1178.t: gobi(n)dh jeeau satasa(n)gat mel kar kirapachhe ||
1178.e: O Dear Lord of the Universe, please be merciful and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

1178.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮਲੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਨਛੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1178.t: janam janam ke kilavikh mal bhariaa mil sa(n)gat kar prabh hanachhe ||1|| rahaau ||
1178.e: I was overflowing with the filthy sins of countless past lives. But joining the Sangat, God made me pure again. ||1||Pause||

1178.g: ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਵਿਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥
1178.t: tum(h)raa jan jaat avijaataa har japio patit paveechhe ||
1178.e: Your humble servant, whether of high class or low class, O Lord - by meditating on You, the sinner becomes pure.

1178.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਿਨਛੇ ॥੨॥
1178.t: har keeo sagal bhavan te uoopar har sobhaa har prabh dhinachhe ||2||
1178.e: The Lord exalts and elevates him above the whole world, and the Lord God blesses him with the Lord's Glory. ||2||

1178.g: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਨਸ ਤਿਨਛੇ ॥
1178.t: jaat ajaat koiee prabh dhiaavai sabh poore maanas tinachhe ||
1178.e: Anyone who meditates on God, whether of high class or low class, will have all of his hopes and desires fulfilled.

1178.g: ਸੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਛੇ ॥੩॥
1178.t: se dha(n)n vadde vadd poore har jan jin(h) har dhaario har urachhe ||3||
1178.e: Those humble servants of the Lord who enshrine the Lord within their hearts, are blessed, and are made great and totally perfect. ||3||

1178.g: ਹਮ ਢੀਂਢੇ ਢੀਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਛੇ ॥
1178.t: ham ddee(n)dde ddeem bahut at bhaaree har dhaar kirapaa prabh milachhe ||
1178.e: I am so low, I am an utterly heavy lump of clay. Please shower Your Mercy on me, Lord, and unite me with Yourself.

1178.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੂਠੇ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
1178.t: jan naanak gur paiaa har tooThe ham ke'ee patit paveechhe ||4||2||4||
1178.e: The Lord, in His Mercy, has led servant Nanak to find the Guru; I was a sinner, and now I have become immaculate and pure. ||||4||2||4||

1178.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1178.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1178.e: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehla:

1178.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਗੀਧੇ ॥
1178.t: meraa ik khin manooaa reh na sakai nit har har naam ras geedhe ||
1178.e: My mind cannot survive, even for an instant, without the Lord. I drink in continually the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

1178.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਰਸਕਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਥਨਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਥਨਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲੀਧੇ ॥੧॥
1178.t: jiau baarik rasak pario than maataa than kaadde bilal bileedhe ||1||
1178.e: It is like a baby, who joyfully sucks at his mother's breast; when the breast is withdrawn, he weeps and cries. ||1||

1178.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
1178.t: gobi(n)dh jeeau mere man tan naam har beedhe ||
1178.e: O Dear Lord of the Universe, my mind and body are pierced through by the Name of the Lord.

1178.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1178.t: vaddai bhaag gur satigur paiaa vich kaiaa nagar har seedhe ||1|| rahaau ||
1178.e: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru, and in the body-village, the Lord has revealed Himself. ||1||Pause||

1179.g: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
1179.t: jan ke saas saas hai jete har bireh prabhoo har beedhe ||
1179.e: Each and every breath of the Lord's humble servant is pierced through with love of the Lord God.

1179.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਦੇਖੇ ਸੁਕਲੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
1179.t: jiau jal kamal preet at bhaaree bin jal dhekhe sukaleedhe ||2||
1179.e: As the lotus is totally in love with the water and withers away without seeing the water, so am I in love with the Lord. ||2||

1179.g: ਜਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਧੇ ॥
1179.t: jan japio naam nira(n)jan narahar upadhes guroo har preedhe ||
1179.e: The Lord's humble servant chants the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord reveals Himself.

1179.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨੀਧੇ ॥੩॥
1179.t: janam janam kee haumai mal nikasee har a(n)mirat har jal needhe ||3||
1179.e: The filth of egotism which stained me for countless lifetimes has been washed away, by the Ambrosial Water of the Ocean of the Lord. ||3||

1179.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਬਿਚਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀਧੇ ॥
1179.t: hamare karam na bicharahu Thaakur tum(h) paij rakhahu apaneedhe ||
1179.e: Please, do not take my karma into account, O my Lord and Master; please save the honor of Your slave.

1179.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੀਧੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
1179.t: har bhaavai sun binau benatee jan naanak saran paveedhe ||4||3||5||
1179.e: O Lord, if it pleases You, hear my prayer; servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||4||3||5||

1179.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1179.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1179.e: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehla:

1179.g: ਮਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
1179.t: man khin khin bharam bharam bahu dhaavai til ghar nahee vaasaa paieeaai ||
1179.e: Each and every moment, my mind roams and rambles, and runs all over the place. It does not stay in its own home, even for an instant.

1179.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਣਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
1179.t: gur a(n)kas sabadh dhaaroo sir dhaario ghar ma(n)dhar aan vasaieeaai ||1||
1179.e: But when the bridle of the Shabad, the Word of God, is placed over its head, it returns to dwell in its own home. ||1||

1179.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
1179.t: gobi(n)dh jeeau satasa(n)gat mel har dhiaaieeaai ||
1179.e: O Dear Lord of the Universe, lead me to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, so that I may meditate on You, Lord.

1179.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1179.t: haumai rog giaa sukh paiaa har sahaj samaadh lagaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
1179.e: I am cured of the disease of egotism, and I have found peace; I have intuitively entered into the state of Samaadhi. ||1||Pause||

1179.g: ਘਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਦੇ ਮਨੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਈਐ ॥
1179.t: ghar ratan laal bahu maanak laadhe man bhramiaa leh na sakaieeaai ||
1179.e: This house is loaded with countless gems, jewels, rubies and emeralds, but the wandering mind cannot find them.

1179.g: ਜਿਉ ਓਡਾ ਕੂਪੁ ਗੁਹਜ ਖਿਨ ਕਾਢੈ ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
1179.t: jiau oddaa koop guhaj khin kaaddai tiau satigur vasat lahaieeaai ||2||
1179.e: As the water-diviner finds the hidden water, and the well is then dug in an instant, so do we find the object of the Name through the True Guru. ||2||

1179.g: ਜਿਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
1179.t: jin aaisaa satigur saadh na paiaa te dhirag dhirag nar jeevaieeaai ||
1179.e: Those who do not find such a Holy True Guru - cursed, cursed are the lives of those people.

1179.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
1179.t: janam padhaarath pu(n)n fal paiaa kauddee badhalai jaieeaai ||3||
1179.e: The treasure of this human life is obtained when one's virtues bear fruit, but it is lost in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||

1179.g: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
1179.t: madhusoodhan har dhaar prabh kirapaa kar kirapaa guroo milaieeaai ||
1179.e: O Lord God, please be merciful to me; be merciful, and lead me to meet the Guru.

1179.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
1179.t: jan naanak nirabaan padh paiaa mil saadhoo har gun gaieeaai ||4||4||6||
1179.e: Servant Nanak has attained the state of Nirvaanaa; meeting with the Holy people, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||4||6||

1179.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1179.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1179.e: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehla:

1179.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੇਹ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੁੰਞੁ ॥
1179.t: aavan jaan bhiaa dhukh bikhiaa dheh manmukh su(n)n(j)ee su(n)n(j) ||
1179.e: Coming and going, he suffers the pains of vice and corruption; the body of the self-willed manmukh is desolate and vacant.

1179.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਜਮਿ ਪਕਰੇ ਕਾਲਿ ਸਲੁੰਞੁ ॥੧॥
1179.t: raam naam khin pal nahee chetiaa jam pakare kaal salu(n)n(j) ||1||
1179.e: He does not dwell on the Lord's Name, even for an instant, and so the Messenger of Death seizes him by his hair. ||1||

1179.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੁੰਞੁ ॥
1179.t: gobi(n)dh jeeau bikh haumai mamataa mu(n)n(j) ||
1179.e: O Dear Lord of the Universe, please rid me of the poison of egotism and attachment.

1179.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਞੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1179.t: satasa(n)gat gur kee har piaaree mil sa(n)gat har ras bhu(n)n(j) ||1|| rahaau ||
1179.e: The Sat Sangat, Guru's True Congregation is so dear to the Lord. So join the Sangat, and taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1179.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੰਞੁ ॥
1179.t: satasa(n)gat saadh dhiaa kar melahu saranaagat saadhoo pa(n)n(j) ||
1179.e: Please be kind to me, and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the Holy; I seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

1179.g: ਹਮ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਞੁ ॥੨॥
1179.t: ham ddubadhe paathar kaadd leh prabh tum(h) dheen dhiaal dhukh bha(n)n(j) ||2||
1179.e: I am a heavy stone, sinking down - please lift me up and pull me out! O God, Merciful to the meek, You are the Destroyer of sorrow. ||2||

1179.g: ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਲੰਞੁ ॥
1179.t: har usatat dhaarahu ridh a(n)tar suaamee satasa(n)gat mil budh la(n)n(j) ||
1179.e: I enshrine the Praises of my Lord and Master within my heart; joining the Sat Sangat, my intellect is enlightened.

1179.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਿ ਵੰਞੁ ॥੩॥
1179.t: har naamai ham preet lagaanee ham har viTahu ghum va(n)n(j) ||3||
1179.e: I have fallen in love with the Lord's Name; I am a sacrifice to the Lord. ||3||

1179.g: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲੰਞੁ ॥
1179.t: jan ke poor manorath har prabh har naam dhevahu har la(n)n(j) ||
1179.e: O Lord God, please fulfill the desires of Your humble servant; please bless me with Your Name, O Lord.

1179.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਭੰਞੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੭॥੩੭॥
1179.t: jan naanak man tan anadh bhiaa hai gur ma(n)tr dheeo har bha(n)n(j) ||4||5||7||12||18||7||37||
1179.e: Servant Nanak's mind and body are filled with ecstasy; the Guru has blessed him with the Mantra of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||7||12||18||7||37||

1180.t: basa(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa dhutuke
1180.e: Basant, Fifth Mehla, First House, Du-Thukay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I serve the Guru, and humbly bow to Him.
Today is a day of celebration for me.
Today I am in supreme bliss.
My anxiety is dispelled, and I have met the Lord of the Universe. ||1||
Today, it is springtime in my household.

1180.g: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1180.t: gun gaae prabh tum(h) bea(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
1180.e: I sing Your Glorious Praises, O Infinite Lord God. ||1||Pause||
Today, I am celebrating the festival of Phalgun.
Joining with God's companions, I have begun to play.
I celebrate the festival of Holi by serving the Saints.
I am imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Divine Love. ||2||
My mind and body have blossomed forth, in utter, incomparable beauty.
They do not dry out in either sunshine or shade;
they flourish in all seasons.
It is always springtime, when I meet with the Divine Guru. ||3||
The wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree has sprouted and grown.
It bears flowers and fruits, jewels of all sorts.
I am satisfied and fulfilled, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

1180.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
1180.t: jan naanak har har har dhiaai ||4||1||
1180.e: Servant Nanak meditates on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||1||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
The shopkeeper deals in merchandise for profit.
The gambler's consciousness is focused on gambling.
The opium addict lives by consuming opium.

1180.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
1180.t: tiau har jan jeevai har dhiaai ||1||
1180.e: In the same way, the humble servant of the Lord lives by meditating on the Lord. ||1||
Everyone is absorbed in his own pleasures.

1180.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1180.t: jit prabh laiaa tit tit lagai ||1|| rahaau ||
1180.e: He is attached to whatever God attaches him to. ||1||Pause||
When the clouds and the rain come, the peacocks dance.
Seeing the moon, the lotus blossoms.
When the mother sees her infant, she is happy.

1180.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
1180.t: tiau har jan jeeveh jap gobi(n)dh ||2||
1180.e: In the same way, the humble servant of the Lord lives by meditating on the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
The tiger always wants to eat meat.
Gazing upon the battlefield, the warrior's mind is exalted.
The miser is totally in love with his wealth.

1180.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
1180.t: har jan kau har har aadhaar ||3||
1180.e: The humble servant of the Lord leans on the Support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
All love is contained in the Love of the One Lord.

1180.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
1180.t: sarab sukhaa sukh har kai nai ||
1180.e: All comforts are contained in the Comfort of the Lord's Name.
He alone receives this treasure,
O Nanak, unto whom the Guru gives His gift. ||4||2||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
He alone experiences this springtime of the soul, unto whom God grants His Grace.
He alone experiences this springtime of the soul, unto whom the Guru is merciful.

1180.g: ਮੰਗਲੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
1180.t: ma(n)gal tis kai jis ek kaam ||
1180.e: He alone is joyful, who works for the One Lord.

1180.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
1180.t: tis sadh basa(n)t jis ridhai naam ||1||
1180.e: He alone experiences this eternal springtime of the soul, within whose heart the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides. ||1||
This spring comes only to those homes,

1180.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1180.t: jaa kai keeratan har dhunee ||1|| rahaau ||
1180.e: in which the melody of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises resounds. ||1||Pause||
O mortal, let your love for the Supreme Lord God blossom forth.
Practice spiritual wisdom, and consult the humble servants of the Lord.
He alone is an ascetic, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
He alone dwells in deep, continual meditation, who loves his Guru. ||2||
He alone is fearless, who has the Fear of God.
He alone is peaceful, whose doubts are dispelled.
He alone is a hermit, who heart is steady and stable.
He alone is steady and unmoving, who has found the true place. ||3||
He seeks the One Lord, and loves the One Lord.
He loves to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
He intuitively enjoys the Love of the Lord.
Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to that humble being. ||4||3||

1181.e: Basant, Fifth Mehla:
You gave us our soul, breath of life and body.
I am a fool, but You have made me beautiful, enshrining Your Light within me.
We are all beggars, O God; You are merciful to us.
Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we are uplifted and exalted. ||1||
O my Beloved, only You have the potency to act,

1181.g: ਹਉ ਪਾਵਉ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਥੋਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1181.t: hau paavau tum te sagal thok ||1|| rahaau ||
1181.e: and cause all to be done. ||1||Pause||
Chanting the Naam, the mortal is saved.
Chanting the Naam, sublime peace and poise are found.
Chanting the Naam, honor and glory are received.
Chanting the Naam, no obstacles shall block your way. ||2||
For this reason, you have been blessed with this body, so difficult to obtain.
O my Dear God, please bless me to speak the Naam.
This tranquil peace is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1181.g: ਸਦਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
1181.t: sadhaa ridhai japee prabh tero naam ||3||
1181.e: May I always chant and meditate within my heart on Your Name, O God. ||3||
Other than You, there is no one at all.

1181.g: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
1181.t: sabh tero khel tujh meh samaeh ||
1181.e: Everything is Your play; it all merges again into You.
As it pleases Your Will, save me, Lord.
O Nanak, peace is obtained by meeting with the Perfect Guru. ||4||4||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
My Beloved God, my King is with me.
Gazing upon Him, I live, O my mother.

1181.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
1181.t: jaa kai simaran dhukh na hoi ||
1181.e: Remembering Him in meditation, there is no pain or suffering.
Please, take pity on me, and lead me on to meet Him. ||1||
My Beloved is the Support of my breath of life and mind.

1181.g: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਧਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1181.t: jeeau praan sabh tero dhan ||1|| rahaau ||
1181.e: This soul, breath of life, and wealth are all Yours, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

1181.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
1181.t: jaa kau khojeh sur nar dhev ||
1181.e: He is sought by the angels, mortals and divine beings.

1181.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ ਨ ਲਹਹਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
1181.t: mun jan sekh na laheh bhev ||
1181.e: The silent sages, the humble, and the religious teachers do not understand His mystery.

1181.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1181.t: jaa kee gat mit kahee na jai ||
1181.e: His state and extent cannot be described.

1181.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
1181.t: ghaT ghaT ghaT ghaT rahiaa samai ||2||
1181.e: In each and every home of each and every heart, He is permeating and pervading. ||2||
His devotees are totally in bliss.

1181.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਖੈ ॥
1181.t: jaa ke bhagat kau naahee khai ||
1181.e: His devotees cannot be destroyed.

1181.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੈ ॥
1181.t: jaa ke bhagat kau naahee bhai ||
1181.e: His devotees are not afraid.

1181.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਜੈ ॥੩॥
1181.t: jaa ke bhagat kau sadhaa jai ||3||
1181.e: His devotees are victorious forever. ||3||
What Praises of Yours can I utter?
God, the Giver of peace, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.
Nanak begs for this one gift.
Be merciful, and bless me with Your Name. ||4||5||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
As the plant turns green upon receiving water,
just so, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, egotism is eradicated.
Just as the servant is encouraged by his ruler,
we are saved by the Guru. ||1||
You are the Great Giver, O Generous Lord God.
Each and every instant, I humbly bow to You. ||1||Pause||
Whoever enters the Saadh Sangat
that humble being is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.
He is liberated from bondage.
His devotees worship Him in adoration; they are united in His Union. ||2||
My eyes are content, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
My tongue sings the Infinite Praises of God.
My thirst is quenched, by Guru's Grace.
My mind is satisfied, with the sublime taste of the Lord's subtle essence. ||3||
Your servant is committed to the service of Your Feet,
O Primal Infinite Divine Being.
Your Name is the Saving Grace of all.
Nanak has received this teasure. ||4||6||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
You are the Great Giver; You continue to give.
You permeate and pervade my soul, and my breath of life.
You have given me all sorts of foods and dishes.

1181.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥
1181.t: moh niragun ik gun na jaan ||1||
1181.e: I am unworthy; I know none of Your Virtues at all. ||1||

1181.g: ਹਉ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
1181.t: hau kachhoo na jaanau teree saar ||
1181.e: I do not understand anything of Your Worth.

1182.g: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1182.t: too kar gat meree prabh dhiaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1182.e: Save me, O my Merciful Lord God. ||1||Pause||
