1182.g: ਜਾਪ ਨ ਤਾਪ ਨ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਤਿ ॥
1182.t: jaap na taap na karam keet ||
1182.e: I have not practiced meditation, austerities or good actions.
I do not know the way to meet You.
Within my mind, I have placed my hopes in the One Lord alone.
The Support of Your Name shall carry me across. ||2||
You are the Expert, O God, in all powers.
The fish cannot find the limits of the water.
You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable, the Highest of the High.
I am small, and You are so very Great. ||3||
Those who meditate on You are wealthy.
Those who attain You are rich.
Those who serve You are peaceful.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||4||7||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:

1182.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ॥
1182.t: tis too sev jin too keeaa ||
1182.e: Serve the One who created You.
Worship the One who gave you life.

1182.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਡਾਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
1182.t: tis kaa chaakar hoh fir ddaan na laagai ||
1182.e: Become His servant, and you shall never again be punished.

1182.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੋਤਦਾਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
1182.t: tis kee kar potadhaaree fir dhookh na laagai ||1||
1182.e: Become His trustee, and you shall never again suffer sorrow. ||1||
That mortal who is blessed with such great good fortune,

1182.g: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਇਹੁ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1182.t: so paae ih padh nirabaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
1182.e: attains this state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||Pause||
Life is wasted uselessly in the service of duality.

1182.g: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਰਥਾ ॥
1182.t: kachhoo na hoiee hai pooran arathaa ||
1182.e: No efforts shall be rewarded, and no works brought to fruition.
It is so painful to serve only mortal beings.
Service to the Holy brings lasting peace and bliss. ||2||
If you long for eternal peace, O Siblings of Destiny,
then join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; this is the Guru's advice.
There, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is meditated on.
In the Saadh Sangat, you shall be emancipated. ||3||
Among all essences, this is the essence of spiritual wisdom.
Among all meditations, meditation on the One Lord is the most sublime.
The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is the ultimate melody.
Meeting with the Guru, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||8||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
Chanting His Name, one's mouth becomes pure.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, one's reputation becomes stainless.

1182.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
1182.t: jis araadhe jam kichh na kahai ||
1182.e: Worshipping Him in adoration, one is not tortured by the Messenger of Death.

1182.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
1182.t: jis kee sevaa sabh kichh lahai ||1||
1182.e: Serving Him, everything is obtained. ||1||
The Lord's Name - chant the Lord's Name.

1182.g: ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1182.t: tiaagahu man ke sagal kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1182.e: Abandon all the desires of your mind. ||1||Pause||
He is the Support of the earth and the sky.

1182.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
1182.t: ghaT ghaT jis kaa hai pragaas ||
1182.e: His Light illuminates each and every heart.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, even fallen sinners are sanctified;

1182.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
1182.t: a(n)t kaal fir fir na roi ||2||
1182.e: in the end, they will not weep and wail over and over again. ||2||
Among all religions, this is the ultimate religion.
Among all rituals and codes of conduct, this is above all.

1182.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
1182.t: jis kau chaaheh sur nar dhev ||
1182.e: The angels, mortals and divine beings long for Him.
To find Him, commit yourself to the service of the Society of the Saints. ||3||
One whom the Primal Lord God blesses with His bounties,
obtains the treasure of the Lord.

1182.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1182.t: tis kee gat mit kahee na jai ||
1182.e: His state and extent cannot be described.
Servant Nanak meditates on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||9||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
My mind and body are gripped by thirst and desire.
The Merciful Guru has fulfilled my hopes.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all my sins have been taken away.
I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; I am in love with the Name of the Lord. ||1||
By Guru's Grace, this spring of the soul has come.

1182.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1182.t: charan kamal hiradhai ur dhaare sadhaa sadhaa har jas sunaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1182.e: I enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within my heart; I listen to the Lord's Praise, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

1183.e: Our All-powerful Lord and Master is the Doer of all, the Cause of all causes.
I am an orphan - I seek Your Sanctuary, God.
All beings and creatures take Your Support.
Be merciful, God, and save me. ||2||
God is the Destroyer of fear, the Remover of pain and suffering.

1183.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
1183.t: sur nar mun jan taa kee sev ||
1183.e: The angelic beings and silent sages serve Him.

1183.g: ਧਰਣਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1183.t: dharan akaas jaa kee kalaa maeh ||
1183.e: The earth and the sky are in His Power.
All beings eat what You give them. ||3||
O Merciful God, O Searcher of hearts,
please bless Your slave with Your Glance of Grace.
Please be kind and bless me with this gift,
that Nanak may live in Your Name. ||4||10||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
Loving the Lord, one's sins are taken away.
Meditating on the Lord, one does not suffer at all.
Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, all darkness is dispelled.
Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the cycle of reincarnation comes to an end. ||1||
The love of the Lord is springtime for me.

1183.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1183.t: sa(n)t janaa siau sadhaa sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
1183.e: I am always with the humble Saints. ||1||Pause||
The Saints have shared the Teachings with me.

1183.g: ਜਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਧੰਨਿ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
1183.t: jeh gobi(n)dh bhagat so dha(n)n dhes ||
1183.e: Blessed is that country where the devotees of the Lord of the Universe dwell.
But that place where the Lord's devotees are not, is wilderness.
By Guru's Grace, realize the Lord in each and every heart. ||2||
Sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and enjoy the nectar of His Love.

1183.g: ਮਨ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
1183.t: man paap karat too sadhaa sa(n)g ||
1183.e: O mortal, you must always restrain yourself from committing sins.
Behold the Creator Lord God near at hand.
Here and hereafter, God shall resolve your affairs. ||3||
I focus my meditation on the Lord's Lotus Feet.
Granting His Grace, God has blessed me with this Gift.

1183.g: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
1183.t: teriaa sa(n)t janaa kee baachhau dhoor ||
1183.e: I yearn for the dust of the feet of Your Saints.
Nanak meditates on his Lord and Master, who is ever-present, near at hand. ||4||11||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
The True Transcendent Lord is always new, forever fresh.
By Guru's Grace, I continually chant His Name.
God is my Protector, my Mother and Father.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, I do not suffer in sorrow. ||1||

1183.g: ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ॥
1183.t: khasam dhiaaiee ik man ik bhai ||
1183.e: I meditate on my Lord and Master, single-mindedly, with love.

1183.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1183.t: gur poore kee sadhaa saranaiee saachai saahib rakhiaa ka(n)Th lai ||1|| rahaau ||
1183.e: I seek the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru forever. My True Lord and Master hugs me close in His Embrace. ||1||Pause||
God Himself protects His humble servants.
The demons and wicked enemies have grown weary of struggling against Him.
Without the True Guru, there is no place to go.
Wandering through the lands and foreign countries, people only grow tired and suffer in pain. ||2||
The record of their past actions cannot be erased.
They harvest and eat what they have planted.
The Lord Himself is the Protector of His humble servants.

1183.g: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
1183.t: jan kau pahuch na sakas koi ||3||
1183.e: No one can rival the humble servant of the Lord. ||3||

1183.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
1183.t: prabh dhaas rakhe kar jatan aap ||
1183.e: By His own efforts, God protects His slave.
God's Glory is perfect and unbroken.
So sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe with your tongue forever.
Nanak lives by meditating on the Feet of the Lord. ||4||12||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
Dwelling at the Guru's Feet, pain and suffering go away.
The Supreme Lord God has shown mercy to me.
All my desires and tasks are fulfilled.
Chanting the Lord's Name, Nanak lives. ||1||

1183.g: ਸਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
1183.t: saa rut suhaavee jit har chit aavai ||
1183.e: How beautiful is that season, when the Lord fills the mind.

1183.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਂਤੀ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1183.t: bin satigur dheesai bilalaa(n)tee saakat fir fir aavai jaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
1183.e: Without the True Guru, the world weeps. The faithless cynic comes and goes in reincarnation, over and over again. ||1||Pause||

1184.g: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
1184.t: se dhanava(n)t jin har prabh raas ||
1184.e: They alone are rich, who have the Wealth of the Lord God.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sexual desire and anger are eradicated.
Their fear is dispelled, and they attain the state of fearlessness.
Meeting with the Guru, Nanak meditates on his Lord and Master. ||2||
God dwells in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1184.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ॥
1184.t: har jap jap hoiee pooran aas ||
1184.e: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, one's hopes are fulfilled.
God permeates and pervades the water, the land and the sky.

1184.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੩॥
1184.t: gur mil naanak har har kahiaa ||3||
1184.e: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

1184.g: ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਏਹ ॥ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
1184.t: asaT sidh nav nidh eh || karam paraapat jis naam dheh ||
1184.e: The eight miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures are contained in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. This is bestowed when God grants His Grace.

1184.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
1184.t: prabh jap jap jeeveh tere dhaas ||
1184.e: Your slaves, O God, live by chanting and meditating on Your Name.
O Nanak, the heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth. ||4||13||

1184.t: basa(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa ik tuke
1184.e: Basant, Fifth Mehla, First House, Ik-Thukay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Meditating on the Lord, all desires are fulfilled,
and the mortal is re-united with God, after having been separated for so long. ||1||
Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, who is worthy of meditation.

1184.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਰਵਿਐ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1184.t: jit raviaai sukh sahaj bhog ||1|| rahaau ||
1184.e: Meditating on Him, enjoy celestial peace and poise. ||1||Pause||
Bestowing His Mercy, He blesses us with His Glance of Grace.
God Himself takes care of His slave. ||2||
My bed has been beautified by His Love.
God, the Giver of Peace, has come to meet me. ||3||
He does not consider my merits and demerits.
Nanak worships at the Feet of God. ||4||1||14||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
The sins are erased, singing the Glories of God;
night and day, celestial joy wells up. ||1||
My mind has blossomed forth, by the touch of the Lord's Feet.

1184.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਤੌ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1184.t: kar kirapaa saadhoo jan bheTe nit raatau har naam ra(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
1184.e: By His Grace, He has led me to meet the Holy men, the humble servants of the Lord. I remain continually imbued with the love of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
In His Mercy, the Lord of the World has revealed Himself to me.
The Lord, Merciful to the meek, has attached me to the hem of His robe and saved me. ||2||
This mind has become the dust of the Holy;
I behold my Lord and Master, continually, ever-present. ||3||
Sexual desire, anger and desire have vanished.
O Nanak, God has become kind to me. ||4||2||15||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
God Himself has cured the disease.
He laid on His Hands, and protected His child. ||1||
Celestial peace and tranquility fill my home forever, in this springtime of the soul.

1184.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰੂਪ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1184.t: gur poore kee saranee aae kaliaan roop jap har har ma(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
1184.e: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru; I chant the Mantra of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Embodiment of emancipation. ||1||Pause||
God Himself has dispelled my sorrow and suffering.

1184.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
1184.t: gur apune kau nit nit jaap ||2||
1184.e: I meditate continually, continuously, on my Guru. ||2||
That humble being who chants Your Name,

1184.g: ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੩॥
1184.t: sabh fal paae nihachal gun gaau ||3||
1184.e: obtains all fruits and rewards; singing the Glories of God, he becomes steady and stable. ||3||
O Nanak, the way of the devotees is good.
They meditate continually, continuously, on the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||4||3||16||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
By His Will, He makes us happy.
He shows Mercy to His servant. ||1||
The Perfect Guru makes everything perfect.

1184.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1184.t: a(n)mirat naam ridh meh dheeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1184.e: He implants the Amrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the heart. ||1||Pause||

1184.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
1184.t: karam dharam meraa kachh na beechaario ||
1184.e: He does not consider the karma of my actions, or my Dharma, my spiritual practice.

1185.e: Taking me by the arm, He saves me and carries me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
God has rid me of my filth, and made me stainless and pure.
I have sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||3||
He Himself does, and causes everything to be done.
By His Grace, O Nanak, He saves us. ||4||4||17||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Behold the flowers flowering, and the blossoms blossoming forth!
Renounce and abandon your egotism.
Grasp hold of His Lotus Feet.
Meet with God, O blessed one.
O my mind, remain conscious of the Lord. ||Pause||
The tender young plants smell so good,
while others remain like dry wood.
The season of spring has come;
it blossoms forth luxuriantly. ||1||
Now, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga has come.
Plant the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
It is not the season to plant other seeds.
Do not wander lost in doubt and delusion.

1185.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੈ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
1185.t: gur mile har paae || jis masatak hai lekhaa ||
1185.e: One who has such destiny written on his forehead, shall meet with the Guru and find the Lord.
O mortal, this is the season of the Naam.

1185.g: ਗੁਨ ਕਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
1185.t: gun kahe naanak har hare har hare ||2||18||
1185.e: Nanak utters the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||2||18||

1185.t: basa(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa hi(n)ddol
1185.e: Basant, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Hindol:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1185.g: ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
1185.t: hoi ikatr milahu mere bhaiee dhubidhaa dhoor karahu liv lai ||
1185.e: Come and join together, O my Siblings of Destiny; dispel your sense of duality and let yourselves be lovingly absorbed in the Lord.

1185.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜੋੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਸਫਾ ਵਿਛਾਇ ॥੧॥
1185.t: har naamai ke hovahu joRee gurmukh baisahu safaa vichhai ||1||
1185.e: Let yourselves be joined to the Name of the Lord; become Gurmukh, spread out your mat, and sit down. ||1||
In this way, throw the dice, O brothers.

1185.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1185.t: gurmukh naam japahu dhin raatee a(n)t kaal neh laagai peer ||1|| rahaau ||
1185.e: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. At the very last moment, you shall not have to suffer in pain. ||1||Pause||

1185.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਸਾਜਹੁ ਸਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
1185.t: karam dharam tum(h) chaupaR saajahu sat karahu tum(h) saaree ||
1185.e: Let righteous actions be your gameboard, and let the truth be your dice.

1185.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜੀਤਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਖੇਲ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
1185.t: kaam karodh lobh moh jeetahu aaisee khel har piaaree ||2||
1185.e: Conquer sexual desire, anger, greed and worldly attachment; only such a game as this is dear to the Lord. ||2||

1185.g: ਉਠਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਸੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥
1185.t: auTh isanaan karahu parabhaate soe har aaraadhe ||
1185.e: Rise in the early hours of the morning, and take your cleansing bath. Before you go to bed at night, remember to worship the Lord.

1185.g: ਬਿਖੜੇ ਦਾਉ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
1185.t: bikhaRe dhaau la(n)ghaavai meraa satigur sukh sahaj setee ghar jaate ||3||
1185.e: My True Guru will assist you, even on your most difficult moves; you shall reach your true home in celestial peace and poise. ||3||

1185.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
1185.t: har aape khelai aape dhekhai har aape rachan rachaiaa ||
1185.e: The Lord Himself plays, and He Himself watches; the Lord Himself created the creation.

1185.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਸੋ ਜਿਣਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
1185.t: jan naanak gurmukh jo nar khelai so jin baajee ghar aaiaa ||4||1||19||
1185.e: O servant Nanak, that person who plays this game as Gurmukh, wins the game of life, and returns to his true home. ||4||1||19||
Basant, Fifth Mehla, Hindol:

1185.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
1185.t: teree kudharat toohai jaaneh aaur na dhoojaa jaanai ||
1185.e: You alone know Your Creative Power, O Lord; no one else knows it.

1185.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
1185.t: jis no kirapaa kareh mere piaare soiee tujhai pachhaanai ||1||
1185.e: He alone realizes You, O my Beloved, unto whom You show Your Mercy. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to Your devotees.

1185.g: ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੰਗ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1185.t: thaan suhaavaa sadhaa prabh teraa ra(n)g tere aapaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
1185.e: Your place is eternally beautiful, God; Your wonders are infinite. ||1||Pause||

1185.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
1185.t: teree sevaa tujh te hovai aaur na dhoojaa karataa ||
1185.e: Only You Yourself can perform Your service. No one else can do it.

1185.g: ਭਗਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰੰਗੁ ਧਰਤਾ ॥੨॥
1185.t: bhagat teraa soiee tudh bhaavai jis no too ra(n)g dharataa ||2||
1185.e: He alone is Your devotee, who is pleasing to You. You bless them with Your Love. ||2||

1186.g: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਨਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
1186.t: too vadd dhaataa too vadd dhaanaa aaur nahee ko dhoojaa ||
1186.e: You are the Great Giver; You are so very Wise. There is no other like You.

1186.g: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੩॥
1186.t: too samarath suaamee meraa hau kiaa jaanaa teree poojaa ||3||
1186.e: You are my All-powerful Lord and Master; I do not know how to worship You. ||3||

1186.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
1186.t: teraa mahal agochar mere piaare bikham teraa hai bhaanaa ||
1186.e: Your Mansion is imperceptible, O my Beloved; it is so difficult to accept Your Will.

1186.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਢਹਿ ਪਇਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
1186.t: kahu naanak ddeh piaa dhuaarai rakh levahu mugadh ajaanaa ||4||2||20||
1186.e: Says Nanak, I have collapsed at Your Door, Lord. I am foolish and ignorant - please save me! ||4||2||20||

1186.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1186.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa panjavaa ||
1186.e: Basant Hindol, Fifth Mehla:

1186.g: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਅਹੰ ਮਨੀ ॥੧॥
1186.t: mool na boojhai aap na soojhai bharam biaapee aha(n) manee ||1||
1186.e: The mortal does not know the Primal Lord God; he does not understand hmself. He is engrossed in doubt and egotism. ||1||

1186.g: ਪਿਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ॥
1186.t: pitaa paarabraham prabh dhanee ||
1186.e: My Father is the Supreme Lord God, my Master.

1186.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1186.t: moh nisataarahu niragunee ||1|| rahaau ||
1186.e: I am unworthy, but please save me anyway. ||1||Pause||

1186.g: ਓਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਹ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੀ ॥੨॥
1186.t: opat paralau prabh te hovai ieh beechaaree har janee ||2||
1186.e: Creation and destruction come only from God; this is what the Lord's humble servants believe. ||2||

1186.g: ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸੇ ਗਨੀ ॥੩॥
1186.t: naam prabhoo ke jo ra(n)g raate kal meh sukhe'ee se ganee ||3||
1186.e: Only those who are imbued with God's Name are judged to be peaceful in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||3||

1186.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੧॥
1186.t: avar upaau na koiee soojhai naanak tareeaai gur bachanee ||4||3||21||
1186.e: It is the Guru's Word that carries us across; Nanak cannot think of any other way. ||4||3||21||

1186.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1186.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1186.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1186.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1186.t: raag basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa nauvaa ||
1186.e: Raag Basant Hindol, Ninth Mehla:

1186.g: ਸਾਧੋ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
1186.t: saadho ih tan mithiaa jaanau ||
1186.e: O Holy Saints, know that this body is false.

1186.g: ਯਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1186.t: yaa bheetar jo raam basat hai saacho taeh pachhaano ||1|| rahaau ||
1186.e: The Lord who dwells within it - recognize that He alone is real. ||1||Pause||

1186.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਾ ਐਡਾਨੋ ॥
1186.t: eih jag hai sa(n)pat supane kee dhekh kahaa aaiddaano ||
1186.e: The wealth of this world is only a dream; why are you so proud of it?

1186.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਕਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
1186.t: sa(n)g tihaarai kachhoo na chaalai taeh kahaa lapaTaano ||1||
1186.e: None of it shall go along with you in the end; why do you cling to it? ||1||

1186.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੋ ॥
1186.t: ausatat ni(n)dhaa dhouoo parahar har keerat ur aano ||
1186.e: Leave behind both praise and slander; enshrine the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises within your heart.

1186.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਏਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧॥
1186.t: jan naanak sabh hee mai pooran ek purakh bhagavaano ||2||1||
1186.e: O servant Nanak, the One Primal Being, the Lord God, is totally permeating everywhere. ||2||1||

1186.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1186.t: basa(n)t mahalaa nauvaa ||
1186.e: Basant, Ninth Mehla:

1186.g: ਪਾਪੀ ਹੀਐ ਮੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
1186.t: paapee heeaai mai kaam basai ||
1186.e: The heart of the sinner is filled with unfulfilled sexual desire.

1186.g: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਯਾ ਤੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1186.t: man cha(n)chal yaa te gahio na jai ||1|| rahaau ||
1186.e: He cannot control his fickle mind. ||1||Pause||

1186.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਅਰੁ ਸੰਨਿਆਸ ॥
1186.t: jogee ja(n)gam ar sa(n)niaas ||
1186.e: The Yogis, wandering ascetics and renunciates

1186.g: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਪਰਿ ਡਾਰੀ ਇਹ ਫਾਸ ॥੧॥
1186.t: sabh hee par ddaaree ieh faas ||1||
1186.e: - this net is cast over them all. ||1||

1186.g: ਜਿਹਿ ਜਿਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥
1186.t: jeh jeh har ko naam sam(h)aar ||
1186.e: Those who contemplate the Name of the Lord

1186.g: ਤੇ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
1186.t: te bhav saagar utare paar ||2||
1186.e: cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

1186.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
1186.t: jan naanak har kee saranai ||
1186.e: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord.

1186.g: ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥੨॥
1186.t: dheejai naam rahai gun gai ||3||2||
1186.e: Please bestow the blessing of Your Name, that he may continue to sing Your Glorious Praises. ||3||2||

1186.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1186.t: basa(n)t mahalaa nauvaa ||
1186.e: Basant, Ninth Mehla:

1186.g: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
1186.t: maiee mai dhan paio har naam ||
1186.e: O mother, I have gathered the wealth of the Lord's Name.

1186.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਧਾਵਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਠੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1186.t: man mero dhaavan te chhooTio kar baiTho bisaraam ||1|| rahaau ||
1186.e: My mind has stopped its wanderings, and now, it has come to rest. ||1||Pause||

1186.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਭਾਗੀ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
1186.t: maiaa mamataa tan te bhaagee upajio niramal giaan ||
1186.e: Attachment to Maya has run away from my body, and immaculate spiritual wisdom has welled up within me.

1186.g: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਏਹ ਪਰਸਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਗਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
1186.t: lobh moh eh paras na saakai gahee bhagat bhagavaan ||1||
1186.e: Greed and attachment cannot even touch me; I have grasped hold of devotional worship of the Lord. ||1||

1186.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਬ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1186.t: janam janam kaa sa(n)saa chookaa ratan naam jab paiaa ||
1186.e: The cynicism of countless lifetimes has been eradicated, since I obtained the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1186.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਿਜ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1186.t: tirasanaa sakal binaasee man te nij sukh maeh samaiaa ||2||
1186.e: My mind was rid of all its desires, and I was absorbed in the peace of my own inner being. ||2||

1186.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
1186.t: jaa kau hot dhiaal kirapaa nidh so gobi(n)dh gun gaavai ||
1186.e: That person, unto whom the Merciful Lord shows compassion, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

1186.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੩॥
1186.t: kahu naanak ieh bidh kee sa(n)pai kouoo gurmukh paavai ||3||3||
1186.e: Says Nanak, this wealth is gathered only by the Gurmukh. ||3||3||

1186.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
1186.t: basa(n)t mahalaa nauvaa ||
1186.e: Basant, Ninth Mehla:

1186.g: ਮਨ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
1186.t: man kahaa bisaario raam naam ||
1186.e: O my mind, how can you forget the Lord's Name?

1186.g: ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਪਰੈ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1186.t: tan binasai jam siau parai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1186.e: When the body perishes, you shall have to deal with the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

1186.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਧੂਏ ਕਾ ਪਹਾਰ ॥
1186.t: eih jag dhooe kaa pahaar ||
1186.e: This world is just a hill of smoke.

1187.e: What makes you think that it is real? ||1||
Wealth, spouse, property and household

1187.g: ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਸਮਝ ਲੇਹ ॥੨॥
1187.t: kachh sa(n)g na chaalai samajh leh ||2||
1187.e: - none of them shall go along with you; you must know that this is true! ||2||
Only devotion to the Lord shall go with you.

1187.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਤਿਹ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥੪॥
1187.t: kahu naanak bhaj teh ek ra(n)g ||3||4||
1187.e: Says Nanak, vibrate and meditate on the Lord with single-minded love. ||3||4||
Basant, Ninth Mehla:

1187.g: ਕਹਾ ਭੂਲਿਓ ਰੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਲੋਭ ਲਾਗ ॥
1187.t: kahaa bhoolio re jhooThe lobh laag ||
1187.e: Why do you wander lost, O mortal, attached to falsehood and greed?

1187.g: ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਅਜਹੁ ਜਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1187.t: kachh bigario naahin ajahu jaag ||1|| rahaau ||
1187.e: Nothing has been lost yet - there is still time to wake up! ||1||Pause||

1187.g: ਸਮ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਕੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
1187.t: sam supanai kai ih jag jaan ||
1187.e: You must realize that this world is nothing more than a dream.
In an instant, it shall perish; know this as true. ||1||
The Lord constantly abides with you.
Night and day, vibrate and meditate on Him, O my friend. ||2||
At the very last instant, He shall be your Help and Support.

1187.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥੫॥
1187.t: kahu naanak gun taa ke gai ||3||5||
1187.e: Says Nanak, sing His Praises. ||3||5||

1187.t: basa(n)t mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar pehilaa dhutukeeaa
1187.e: Basant, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House, Du-Tukees:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The world is a crow; it does not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Forgetting the Naam, it sees the bait, and pecks at it.
The mind wavers unsteadily, in guilt and deceit.
I have shattered my attachment to the false world. ||1||
The burden of sexual desire, anger and corruption is unbearable.

1187.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1187.t: naam binaa kaise gun chaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1187.e: Without the Naam, how can the mortal maintain a virtuous lifestyle? ||1||Pause||
The world is like a house of sand, built on a whirlpool;
it is like a bubble formed by drops of rain.

1187.g: ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਤੇ ਧਰਿ ਚਕੁ ਫੇਰਿ ॥
1187.t: maatr boo(n)dh te dhar chak fer ||
1187.e: It is formed from a mere drop, when the Lord's wheel turns round.
The lights of all souls are the servants of the Lord's Name. ||2||
My Supreme Guru has created everything.
I perform devotional worship service to You, and fall at Your Feet, O Lord.
Imbued with Your Name, I long to be Yours.
Those who do not let the Naam become manifest within themselves, depart like thieves in the end. ||3||
The mortal loses his honor, gathering sin and corruption.

1187.g: ਸਾਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
1187.t: saach naam rato pat siau ghar jai ||
1187.e: But imbued with the Lord's Name, you shall go to your true home with honor.
God does whatever He wills.
One who abides in the Fear of God, becomes fearless, O my mother. ||4||
The woman desires beauty and pleasure.
But betel leaves, garlands of flowers and sweet tastes lead only to disease.
The more she plays and enjoys, the more she suffers in sorrow.
But when she enters into the Sanctuary of God, whatever she wishes comes to pass. ||5||
She wears beautiful clothes with all sorts of decorations.
But the flowers turn to dust, and her beauty leads her into evil.
Hope and desire have blocked the doorway.
Without the Naam, one's hearth and home are deserted. ||6||
O princess, my daughter, run away from this place!
Chant the True Name, and embellish your days.
Serve your Beloved Lord God, and lean on the Support of His Love.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, abandon your thirst for corruption and poison. ||7||
My Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have realized You, Lord.
Nanak stands longingly at God's Door.
I am content and satisfied with Your Name; please shower me with Your Mercy. ||8||1||
Basant, First Mehla:
The mind is deluded by doubt; it comes and goes in reincarnation.
It is lured by the poisonous lure of Maya.
It does not remain stable in the Love of the One Lord.
Like the fish, its neck is pierced by the hook. ||1||
The deluded mind is instructed by the True Name.

1187.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1187.t: gur sabadh beechaare sahaj bhai ||1|| rahaau ||
1187.e: It contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

1188.e: The mind, deluded by doubt, buzzes around like a bumble bee.
The holes of the body are worthless, if the mind is filled with such great desire for corrupt passions.
It is like the elephant, trapped by its own sexual desire.
It is caught and held tight by the chains, and beaten on its head. ||2||
The mind is like a foolish frog, without devotional worship.
It is cursed and condemned in the Court of the Lord, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1188.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨ ॥
1188.t: taa kai jaat na paatee naam leen ||
1188.e: He has no class or honor, and no one even mentions his name.
That person who lacks virtue - all of his pains and sorrows are his only companions. ||3||

1188.g: ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
1188.t: man chalai na jaiee Thaak raakh ||
1188.e: His mind wanders out, and cannot be brought back or restrained.

1188.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
1188.t: bin har ras raate pat na saakh ||
1188.e: Without being imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, it has no honor or credit.
You Yourself are the Listener, Lord, and You Yourself are our Protector.
You are the Support of the earth; You Yourself behold and understand it. ||4||
When You Yourself make me wander, unto whom can I complain?
Meeting the Guru, I will tell Him of my pain, O my mother.
Abandoning my worthless demerits, now I practice virtue.
Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am absorbed in the True Lord. ||5||
Meeting with the True Guru, the intellect is elevated and exalted.
The mind becomes immaculate, and egotism is washed away.

1188.g: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
1188.t: sadhaa mukat ba(n)dh na sakai koi ||
1188.e: He is liberated forever, and no one can put him in bondage.

1188.g: ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੬॥
1188.t: sadhaa naam vakhaanai aaur na koi ||6||
1188.e: He chants the Naam forever, and nothing else. ||6||

1188.g: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
1188.t: man har kai bhaanai aavai jai ||
1188.e: The mind comes and goes according to the Will of the Lord.

1188.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1188.t: sabh meh eko kichh kahan na jai ||
1188.e: The One Lord is contained amongst all; nothing else can be said.
The Hukam of His Command pervades everywhere, and all merge in His Command.
Pain and pleasure all come by His Will. ||7||

1188.g: ਤੂ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੂਲੌ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1188.t: too abhul na bhoolau kadhe naeh ||
1188.e: You are infallible; You never make mistakes.
Those who listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad - their intellects become deep and profound.
You, O my Great Lord and Master, are contained in the Shabad.
O Nanak, my mind is pleased, praising the True Lord. ||8||2||
Basant, First Mehla:

1188.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
1188.t: dharasan kee piaas jis nar hoi ||
1188.e: That person, who thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan,
is absorbed in the One Lord, leaving duality behind.
His pains are taken away, as he churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.
The Gurmukh understands, and merges in the One Lord. ||1||
So many cry out for Your Darshan, Lord.

1188.g: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1188.t: viralaa ko cheenas gur sabadh milai ||1|| rahaau ||
1188.e: How rare are those who realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad and merge with Him. ||1||Pause||
The Vedas say that we should chant the Name of the One Lord.
He is endless; who can find His limits?
There is only One Creator, who created the world.
Without any pillars, He supports the earth and the sky. ||2||
Spiritual wisdom and meditation are contained in the melody of the Bani, the Word of the One Lord.
The One Lord is Untouched and Unstained; His story is unspoken.
The Shabad, the Word, is the Insignia of the One True Lord.
Through the Perfect Guru, the Knowing Lord is known. ||3||
There is only one religion of Dharma; let everyone grasp this truth.
Through the Guru's Teachings, one becomes perfect, all the ages through.
Imbued with the Unmanifest Celestial Lord, and lovingly absorbed in the One,
the Gurmukh attains the invisible and infinite. ||4||
There is one celestial throne, and One Supreme King.
The Independent Lord God is pervading all places.
The three worlds are the creation of that Sublime Lord.
The One Creator of the Creation is Unfathomable and Incomprehensible. ||5||
His Form is One, and True is His Name.
True justice is administered there.
Those who practice Truth are honored and accepted.
They are honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||6||
Devotional worship of the One Lord is the expression of love for the One Lord.
Without the Fear of God and devotional worship of Him, the mortal comes and goes in reincarnation.
One who obtains this understanding from the Guru dwells like an honored guest in this world.

1189.e: That humble being who is imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord is certified and approved. ||7||
I see Him here and there; I dwell on Him intuitively.

1189.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
1189.t: tujh bin Thaakur kisai na bhaavau ||
1189.e: I do not love any other than You, O Lord and Master.
O Nanak, my ego has been burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.
The True Guru has shown me the Blessed Vision of the True Lord. ||8||3||
Basant, First Mehla:
The fickle consciousness cannot find the Lord's limits.
It is caught in non-stop coming and going.
I am suffering and dying, O my Creator.

1189.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
1189.t: bin preetam ko karai na saaraa ||1||
1189.e: No one cares for me, except my Beloved. ||1||
All are high and exalted; how can I call anyone low?

1189.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1189.t: har bhagatee sach naam pateenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1189.e: Devotional worship of the Lord and the True Name has satisfied me. ||1||Pause||
I have taken all sorts of medicines; I am so tired of them.

1189.g: ਕਿਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
1189.t: kiau dhukh chookai bin gur mere ||
1189.e: How can this disease be cured, without my Guru?
Without devotional worship of the Lord, the pain is so great.
My Lord and Master is the Giver of pain and pleasure. ||2||
The disease is so deadly; how can I find the courage?
He knows my disease, and only He can take away the pain.
My mind and body are filled with faults and demerits.
I searched and searched, and found the Guru, O my brother! ||3||

1189.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
1189.t: gur kaa sabadh dhaaroo har naau ||
1189.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the Lord's Name are the cures.
As You keep me, so do I remain.
The world is sick; where should I look?
The Lord is Pure and Immaculate; Immaculate is His Name. ||4||

1189.g: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਜੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
1189.t: ghar meh ghar jo dhekh dhikhaavai ||
1189.e: The Guru sees and reveals the Lord's home, deep within the home of the self;
He ushers the soul-bride into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

1189.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤਾ ॥
1189.t: man meh manooaa chit meh cheetaa ||
1189.e: When the mind remains in the mind, and the consciousness in the consciousness,
such people of the Lord remain unattached. ||5||
They remain free of any desire for happiness or sorrow;
tasting the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, they abide in the Lord's Name.
They recognize their own selves, and remain lovingly attuned to the Lord.
They are victorious on the battlefield of life, following the Guru's Teachings, and their pains run away. ||6||
The Guru has given me the True Ambrosial Nectar; I drink it in.
Of course, I have died, and now I am alive to live.
Please, protect me as Your Own, if it pleases You.
One who is Yours, merges into You. ||7||
Painful diseases afflict those who are sexually promiscuous.

1189.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
1189.t: ghaT ghaT rav rahiaa prabh jaapai ||
1189.e: God appears permeating and pervading in each and every heart.

1189.g: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤਾ ॥
1189.t: sukh dhukh hee te gur sabadh ateetaa ||
1189.e: One who remains unattached, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad
- O Nanak, his heart and consciousness dwell upon and savor the Lord. ||8||4||
Basant, First Mehla, Ik-Tukee:
Do not make such a show of rubbing ashes on your body.
O naked Yogi, this is not the way of Yoga! ||1||

1189.g: ਮੂੜੑੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਤੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ॥
1189.t: mooR(h)e kaahe bisaario tai raam naam ||
1189.e: You fool! How can you have forgotten the Lord's Name?

1189.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1189.t: a(n)t kaal terai aavai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1189.e: At the very last moment, it and it alone shall be of any use to you. ||1||Pause||
Consult the Guru, reflect and think it over.
Wherever I look, I see the Lord of the World. ||2||

1189.g: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਆਖਾ ਜਾਂ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1189.t: kiaa hau aakhaa jaa(n) kachhoo naeh ||
1189.e: What can I say? I am nothing.
All my status and honor are in Your Name. ||3||

1189.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਮਾਲੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
1189.t: kaahe maal dharab dhekh garab jaeh ||
1189.e: Why do you take such pride in gazing upon your property and wealth?
When you must leave, nothing shall go along with you. ||4||
So subdue the five thieves, and hold your consciousness in its place.
This is the basis of the way of Yoga. ||5||
Your mind is tied with the rope of egotism.

1189.g: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
1189.t: har na cheteh mooRe mukat jaeh ||6||
1189.e: You do not even think of the Lord - you fool! He alone shall liberate you. ||6||

1189.g: ਮਤ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਜਮ ਵਸਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
1189.t: mat har visariaai jam vas paeh ||
1189.e: If you forget the Lord, you will fall into the clutches of the Messenger of Death.
At that very last moment, you fool, you shall be beaten. ||7||

1190.e: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and be rid of your ego.
True Yoga shall come to dwell in your mind. ||8||

1190.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1190.t: jin jeeau pi(n)dd dhitaa tis cheteh naeh ||
1190.e: He blessed you with body and soul, but you do not even think of Him.
You fool! Visiting graves and cremation grounds is not Yoga. ||9||
Nanak chants the sublime, glorious Bani of the Word.
Understand it, and appreciate it. ||10||5||
Basant, First Mehla:
In duality and evil-mindedness, the mortal acts blindly.
The self-willed manmukh wanders, lost in the darkness. ||1||
The blind man follows blind advice.

1190.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1190.t: gur karanee bin bharam na bhaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
1190.e: Unless one takes the Guru's Way, his doubt is not dispelled. ||1||Pause||
The manmukh is blind; he does not like the Guru's Teachings.
He has become a beast; he cannot get rid of his egotistical pride. ||2||
God created 8.4 million species of beings.
My Lord and Master, by the Pleasure of His Will, creates and destroys them. ||3||
All are deluded and confused, without the Word of the Shabad and good conduct.
He alone is instructed in this, who is blessed by the Guru, the Creator. ||4||
The Guru's servants are pleasing to our Lord and Master.
The Lord forgives them, and they no longer fear the Messenger of Death. ||5||
Those who love the One Lord with all their heart
- He dispels their doubts and unites them with Himself. ||6||
God is Independent, Endless and Infinite.
The Creator Lord is pleased with Truth. ||7||
O Nanak, the Guru instructs the mistaken soul.
He implants the Truth within him, and shows him the One Lord. ||8||6||
Basant, First Mehla:
He Himself is the bumble bee, the fruit and the vine.
He Himself unites us with the Sangat - the Congregation, and the Guru, our Best Friend. ||1||
O bumble bee, suck in that fragrance,
which causes the trees to flower, and the woods to grow lush foliage. ||1||Pause||
He Himself is Lakshmi, and He Himself is her husband.
He established the world by Word of His Shabad, and He Himself ravishes it. ||2||
He Himself is the calf, the cow and the milk.
He Himself is the Support of the body-mansion. ||3||
He Himself is the Deed, and He Himself is the Doer.
As Gurmukh, He contemplates Himself. ||4||
You create the creation, and gaze upon it, O Creator Lord.
You give Your Support to the uncounted beings and creatures. ||5||
You are the Profound, Unfathomable Ocean of Virtue.
You are the Unknowable, the Immaculate, the most Sublime Jewel. ||6||
You Yourself are the Creator, with the Potency to create.
You are the Independent Ruler, whose people are at peace. ||7||
Nanak is satisfied with the subtle taste of the Lord's Name.

1190.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੮॥੭॥
1190.t: bin har gur preetam janam baadh ||8||7||
1190.e: Without the Beloved Lord and Master, life is meaningless. ||8||7||

1190.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa
1190.e: Basant Hindol, First Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1190.g: ਨਉ ਸਤ ਚਉਦਹ ਤੀਨਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਲਤਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
1190.t: nau sat chaudheh teen chaar kar mahalat chaar bahaalee ||
1190.e: The nine regions, the seven continents, the fourteen worlds, the three qualities and the four ages - You established them all through the four sources of creation, and You seated them in Your mansions.

1190.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਦੀਵੇ ਚਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਦੀਏ ਏਕਾ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
1190.t: chaare dheeve chahu hath dhe'ee ekaa ekaa vaaree ||1||
1190.e: He placed the four lamps, one by one, into the hands of the four ages. ||1||

1190.g: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧੌ ਐਸੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1190.t: miharavaan madhusoodhan maadhau aaisee sakat tum(h)aaree ||1|| rahaau ||
1190.e: O Merciful Lord, Destroyer of demons, Lord of Lakshmi, such is Your Power - Your Shakti. ||1||Pause||

1190.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ॥
1190.t: ghar ghar lasakar paavak teraa dharam kare sikadhaaree ||
1190.e: Your army is the fire in the home of each and every heart. And Dharma - righteous living is the ruling chieftain.

1190.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇਗ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕ ਵੇਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
1190.t: dharatee dheg milai ik veraa bhaag teraa bha(n)ddaaree ||2||
1190.e: The earth is Your great cooking pot; Your beings receive their portions only once. Destiny is Your gate-keeper. ||2||

1190.g: ਨਾ ਸਾਬੂਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
1190.t: naa saaboor hovai fir ma(n)gai naaradh kare khuaaree ||
1190.e: But the mortal becomes unsatisfied, and begs for more; his fickle mind brings him disgrace.

1191.g: ਲਬੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਬੰਦੀਖਾਨਾ ਅਉਗਣ ਪੈਰਿ ਲੁਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
1191.t: lab adheraa ba(n)dheekhaanaa aaugan pair luhaaree ||3||
1191.e: Greed is the dark dungeon, and demerits are the shackles on his feet. ||3||

1191.g: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਮੁਦਗਰ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਕੋੁਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
1191.t: poo(n)jee maar pavai nit mudhagar paap kare kuoTavaaree ||
1191.e: His wealth constantly batters him, and sin acts as the police officer.

1191.g: ਭਾਵੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
1191.t: bhaavai cha(n)gaa bhaavai ma(n)dhaa jaisee nadhar tum(h)aaree ||4||
1191.e: Whether the mortal is good or bad, he is as You look upon him, O Lord. ||4||

1191.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ ਅਲਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੇਖਾਂ ਆਈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
1191.t: aadh purakh kau alahu kaheeaai sekhaa(n) aaiee vaaree ||
1191.e: The Primal Lord God is called Allah. The Shaykh's turn has now come.

1191.g: ਦੇਵਲ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਐਸੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਚਾਲੀ ॥੫॥
1191.t: dheval dhevatiaa kar laagaa aaisee keerat chaalee ||5||
1191.e: The temples of the gods are subject to taxes; this is what it has come to. ||5||

1191.g: ਕੂਜਾ ਬਾਂਗ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਨੀਲ ਰੂਪ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
1191.t: koojaa baa(n)g nivaaj musalaa neel roop banavaaree ||
1191.e: The Muslim devotional pots, calls to prayer, prayers and prayer mats are everywhere; the Lord appears in blue robes.

1191.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੀਆ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਜੀਆਂ ਬੋਲੀ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
1191.t: ghar ghar meeaa sabhanaa(n) jeeaa(n) bolee avar tumaaree ||6||
1191.e: In each and every home, everyone uses Muslim greetings; your speech has changed, O people. ||6||

1191.g: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੀਰ ਮਹੀਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
1191.t: je too meer maheepat saahib kudharat kaun hamaaree ||
1191.e: You, O my Lord and Master, are the King of the earth; what power do I have to challenge You?

1191.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਕਰਹਿਗੇ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
1191.t: chaare ku(n)T salaam karahige ghar ghar sifat tum(h)aaree ||7||
1191.e: In the four directions, people bow in humble adoration to You; Your Praises are sung in each and every heart. ||7||

1191.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ॥
1191.t: teerath si(n)mirat pu(n)n dhaan kichh laahaa milai dhihaaRee ||
1191.e: Making pilgrimages to sacred shrines, reading the Simritees and giving donations in charity - these do bring any profit.

1191.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਸਮੑਾਲੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
1191.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee mekaa ghaRee sam(h)aalee ||8||1||8||
1191.e: O Nanak, glorious greatness is obtained in an instant, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||8||

1191.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲੁ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
1191.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol ghar doojaa mahalaa chauthhaa
1191.e: Basant Hindol, Second House, Fourth Mehla:

1191.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1191.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1191.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1191.g: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
1191.t: kaa(n)iaa nagar ik baalak vasiaa khin pal thir na rahaiee ||
1191.e: Within the body-village there lives a child who cannot hold still, even for an instant.

1191.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
1191.t: anik upaav jatan kar thaake baara(n) baar bharamaiee ||1||
1191.e: It makes so many efforts, and grows weary, but still, it wanders restlessly again and again. ||1||

1191.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੁ ॥
1191.t: mere Thaakur baalak ikat ghar aan ||
1191.e: O my Lord and Master, Your child has come home, to be one with You.

1191.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1191.t: satigur milai ta pooraa paieeaai bhaj raam naam neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
1191.e: Meeting the True Guru, he finds the Perfect Lord. Meditating and vibrating on the Name of the Lord, he receives the Insignia of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1191.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਮੜਾ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
1191.t: eih mritak maRaa sareer hai sabh jag jit raam naam nahee vasiaa ||
1191.e: These are dead corpses, these bodies of all the people of the world; the Name of the Lord does not dwell in them.

1191.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਦਕੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਿਆ ॥੨॥
1191.t: raam naam gur udhak chuaaiaa fir hariaa hoaa rasiaa ||2||
1191.e: The Guru leads us to taste the water of the Lord's Name, and then we savor and enjoy it, and our bodies are rejuvenated. ||2||

1191.g: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
1191.t: mai nirakhat nirakhat sareer sabh khojiaa ik gurmukh chalat dhikhaiaa ||
1191.e: I have examined and studied and searched my entire body, and as Gurmukh, I behold a miraculous wonder.

1191.g: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1191.t: baahar khoj mue sabh saakat har gurmatee ghar paiaa ||3||
1191.e: All the faithless cynics searched outside and died, but following the Guru's Teachings, I have found the Lord within the home of my own heart. ||3||

1191.g: ਦੀਨਾ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
1191.t: dheenaa dheen dhiaal bhe hai jiau kirasan bidhar ghar aaiaa ||
1191.e: God is Merciful to the meekest of the meek; Krishna came to the house of Bidar, a devotee of low social status.

1191.g: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਗੈ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1191.t: milio sudhaamaa bhaavanee dhaar sabh kichh aagai dhaaladh bha(n)j samaiaa ||4||
1191.e: Sudama loved God, who came to meet him; God sent everything to his home, and ended his poverty. ||4||

1191.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਵਡੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
1191.t: raam naam kee paij vadderee mere Thaakur aap rakhaiee ||
1191.e: Great is the glory of the Name of the Lord. My Lord and Master Himself has enshrined it within me.

1191.g: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਘਟਾਈ ॥੫॥
1191.t: je sabh saakat kareh bakheelee ik ratee til na ghaTaiee ||5||
1191.e: Even if all the faithless cynics continue slandering me, it is not diminished by even one iota. ||5||

1191.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
1191.t: jan kee usatat hai raam naamaa dheh dhis sobhaa paiee ||
1191.e: The Lord's Name is the praise of His humble servant. It brings him honor in the ten directions.

1191.g: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਖਵਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੂਕੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
1191.t: ni(n)dhak saakat khav na sakai til apanai ghar lookee laiee ||6||
1191.e: The slanderers and the faithless cynics cannot endure it at all; they have set fire to their own houses. ||6||

1191.g: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
1191.t: jan kau jan mil sobhaa paavai gun meh gun paragaasaa ||
1191.e: The humble person meeting with another humble person obtains honor. In the glory of the Lord, their glory shines forth.

1191.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
1191.t: mere Thaakur ke jan preetam piaare jo hoveh dhaasan dhaasaa ||7||
1191.e: The servants of my Lord and Master are loved by the Beloved. They are the slaves of His slaves. ||7||

1191.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
1191.t: aape jal apara(n)par karataa aape mel milaavai ||
1191.e: The Creator Himself is the Water; He Himself unites us in His Union.

1191.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
1191.t: naanak gurmukh sahaj milaae jiau jal jaleh samaavai ||8||1||9||
1191.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in celestial peace and poise, like water blending with water. ||8||1||9||

1192.t: basa(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa dhutukeeaa
1192.e: Basant, Fifth Mehla, First House, Du-Tukee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Listen to the stories of the devotees, O my mind, and meditate with love.
Ajaamal uttered the Lord's Name once, and was saved.
Baalmeek found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The Lord definitely met Dhroo. ||1||
I beg for the dust of the feet of Your Saints.

1192.g: ਲੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਵਉ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1192.t: le masatak laavau kar kirapaa dhen ||1|| rahaau ||
1192.e: Please bless me with Your Mercy, Lord, that I may apply it to my forehead. ||1||Pause||
Ganika the prostitute was saved, when her parrot uttered the Lord's Name.
The elephant meditated on the Lord, and was saved.
He delivered the poor Brahmin Sudama out of poverty.

1192.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਭਜੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
1192.t: re man too bhee bhaj gobi(n)dh ||2||
1192.e: O my mind, you too must meditate and vibrate on the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
Even the hunter who shot an arrow at Krishna was saved.
Kubija the hunchback was saved, when God placed His Feet on her thumb.
Bidar was saved by his attitude of humility.

1192.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
1192.t: re man too bhee har dhiaai ||3||
1192.e: O my mind, you too must meditate on the Lord. ||3||
The Lord Himself saved the honor of Prahlaad.
Even when she was being disrobed in court, Dropatee's honor was preserved.
Those who have served the Lord, even at the very last instant of their lives, are saved.

1192.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ ਪਰਹਿ ਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
1192.t: re man sev too pareh paar ||4||
1192.e: O my mind, serve Him, and you shall be carried across to the other side. ||4||
Dhanna served the Lord, with the innocence of a child.
Meeting with the Guru, Trilochan attained the perfection of the Siddhas.
The Guru blessed Baynee with His Divine Illumination.

1192.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
1192.t: re man too bhee hoh dhaas ||5||
1192.e: O my mind, you too must be the Lord's slave. ||5||
Jai Dayv gave up his egotism.
Sain the barber was saved through his selfless service.

1192.g: ਮਨੁ ਡੀਗਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਹੂੰ ਜਾਇ ॥
1192.t: man ddeeg na ddolai kahoo(n) jai ||
1192.e: Do not let your mind waver or wander; do not let it go anywhere.

1192.g: ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਤਰਸਹਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
1192.t: man too bhee taraseh saran pai ||6||
1192.e: O my mind, you too shall cross over; seek the Sanctuary of God. ||6||
O my Lord and Master, You have shown Your Mercy to them.
You saved those devotees.

1192.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਕੋਇ ॥
1192.t: tin kaa gun avagan na beechaario koi ||
1192.e: You do not take their merits and demerits into account.

1192.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੭॥
1192.t: eeh bidh dhekh man lagaa sev ||7||
1192.e: Seeing these ways of Yours, I have dedicated my mind to Your service. ||7||
Kabeer meditated on the One Lord with love.
Naam Dayv lived with the Dear Lord.
Ravi Daas meditated on God, the Incomparably Beautiful.
Guru Nanak Dayv is the Embodiment of the Lord of the Universe. ||8||1||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
The mortal wanders in reincarnation through countless lifetimes.
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he falls into hell.
Without devotional worship, he is cut apart into pieces.
Without understanding, he is punished by the Messenger of Death. ||1||
Meditate and vibrate forever on the Lord of the Universe, O my friend.

1192.g: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਕਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1192.t: saach sabadh kar sadhaa preet ||1|| rahaau ||
1192.e: Love forever the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
Contentment does not come by any endeavors.
All the show of Maya is just a cloud of smoke.
The mortal does not hesitate to commit sins.
Intoxicated with poison, he comes and goes in reincarnation. ||2||
Acting in egotism and self-conceit, his corruption only increases.
The world is drowning in attachment and greed.
Sexual desire and anger hold the mind in its power.
Even in his dreams, he does not chant the Lord's Name. ||3||
Sometimes he is a king, and sometimes he is a beggar.
The world is bound by pleasure and pain.
The mortal makes no arrangements to save himself.
The bondage of sin continues to hold him. ||4||
He has no beloved friends or companions.
He himself eats what he himself plants.

1193.e: He gathers up that which brings corruption;

1193.g: ਸੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
1193.t: se chhodd chaliaa khin meh gavaar ||5||
1193.e: leaving them, the fool must depart in an instant. ||5||
He wanders in attachment to Maya.
He acts in accordance with the karma of his past actions.
Only the Creator Himself remains detached.
God is not affected by virtue or vice. ||6||
Please save me, O Merciful Lord of the Universe!
I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Compassionate Lord.
Without You, I have no other place of rest.
Please take pity on me, God, and bless me with Your Name. ||7||
You are the Creator, and You are the Doer.
You are High and Exalted, and You are totally Infinite.
Please be merciful, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.
Slave Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God. ||8||2||
Basant Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1193.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੈ ਹੋਹੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
1193.t: har kaa naam dhiaai kai hoh hariaa bhaiee ||
1193.e: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and blossom forth in green abundance.

1193.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖੰਤੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਇਹ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
1193.t: karam likha(n)tai paieeaai ieh rut suhaiee ||
1193.e: By your high destiny, you have been blessed with this wondrous spring of the soul.

1193.g: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
1193.t: van tiran tirabhavan mauliaa a(n)mirat fal paiee ||
1193.e: See all the three worlds in bloom, and obtain the Fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.

1193.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਲਥੀ ਸਭ ਛਾਈ ॥
1193.t: mil saadhoo sukh uoopajai lathee sabh chhaiee ||
1193.e: Meeting with the Holy Saints, peace wells up, and all sins are erased.

1193.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਈ ॥੧॥
1193.t: naanak simarai ek naam fir bahuR na dhaiee ||1||
1193.e: O Nanak, remember in meditation the One Name, and you shall never again be consigned to the womb of reincarnation.. ||1||

1193.g: ਪੰਜੇ ਬਧੇ ਮਹਾਬਲੀ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
1193.t: pa(n)je badhe mahaabalee kar sachaa ddoaa ||
1193.e: The five powerful desires are bound down, when you lean on the True Lord.

1193.g: ਆਪਣੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਯੁ ਖੜੋਆ ॥
1193.t: aapane charan japaian vich dhay khaRoaa ||
1193.e: The Lord Himself leads us to dwell at His Feet. He stands right in our midst.

1193.g: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
1193.t: rog sog sabh miT ge nit navaa niroaa ||
1193.e: All sorrows and sicknesses are eradicated, and you become ever-fresh and rejuvenated.

1193.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਮੋਆ ॥
1193.t: dhin rain naam dhiaaidhaa fir pai na moaa ||
1193.e: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You shall never again die.

1193.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
1193.t: jis te upajiaa naanakaa soiee fir hoaa ||2||
1193.e: And the One, from whom we came, O Nanak, into Him we merge once again. ||2||

1193.g: ਕਿਥਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਹ ਰਹੈ ਕਹ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
1193.t: kithahu upajai keh rahai keh maeh samaavai ||
1193.e: Where do we come from? Where do we live? Where do we go in the end?

1193.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਖਸਮ ਕੇ ਕਉਣੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1193.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh khasam ke kaun keemat paavai ||
1193.e: All creatures belong to God, our Lord and Master. Who can place a value on Him?

1193.g: ਕਹਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੁਣਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
1193.t: kahan dhiaain sunan nit se bhagat suhaavai ||
1193.e: Those who meditate, listen and chant, those devotees are blessed and beautified.

1193.g: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਦੂਸਰੁ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
1193.t: agam agochar saahibo dhoosar lavai na laavai ||
1193.e: The Lord God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable; there is no other equal to Him.

1193.g: ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੧॥
1193.t: sach poorai gur upadhesiaa naanak sunaavai ||3||1||
1193.e: The Perfect Guru has taught this Truth. Nanak proclaims it to the world. ||3||1||
Basant, The Word Of The Devotees,
Kabeer Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The earth is in bloom, and the sky is in bloom.
Each and every heart has blossomed forth, and the soul is illumined. ||1||
My Sovereign Lord King blossoms forth in countless ways.

1193.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1193.t: jeh dhekhau teh rahiaa samai ||1|| rahaau ||
1193.e: Wherever I look, I see Him there pervading. ||1||Pause||
The four Vedas blossom forth in duality.
The Simritees blossom forth, along with the Koran and the Bible. ||2||
Shiva blossoms forth in Yoga and meditation.
Kabeer's Lord and Master pervades in all alike. ||3||1||
The Pandits, the Hindu religious scholars, are intoxicated, reading the Puraanas.
The Yogis are intoxicated in Yoga and meditation.
The Sannyaasees are intoxicated in egotism.
The penitents are intoxicated with the mystery of penance. ||1||

1193.g: ਸਭ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਜਾਗ ॥
1193.t: sabh madh maate kouoo na jaag ||
1193.e: All are intoxicated with the wine of Maya; no one is awake and aware.

1193.g: ਸੰਗ ਹੀ ਚੋਰ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਸਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1193.t: sa(n)g hee chor ghar musan laag ||1|| rahaau ||
1193.e: The thieves are with them, plundering their homes. ||1||Pause||
Suk Dayv and Akrur are awake and aware.

1194.e: Hanuman with his tail is awake and aware.
Shiva is awake, serving at the Lord's Feet.
Naam Dayv and Jai Dayv are awake in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||2||
There are many ways of being awake, and sleeping.
To be awake as Gurmukh is the most excellent way.
The most sublime of all the actions of this body,
says Kabeer, is to meditate and vibrate on the Lord's Name. ||3||2||
The wife gives birth to her husband.
The son leads his father in play.
Without breasts, the mother nurses her baby. ||1||
Behold, people! This is how it is in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
The son marries his mother. ||1||Pause||
Without feet, the mortal jumps.
Without a mouth, he bursts into laughter.
Without feeling sleepy, he lays down and sleeps.
Without a churn, the milk is churned. ||2||
Without udders, the cow gives milk.
Without travelling, a long journey is made.
Without the True Guru, the path is not found.
Says Kabeer, see this, and understand. ||3||3||
Prahlaad was sent to school.
He took many of his friends along with him.

1194.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਪੜੑਾਵਸਿ ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ॥
1194.t: mo kau kahaa paR(h)aavas aal jaal ||
1194.e: He asked his teacher, ""Why do you teach me about worldly affairs?

1194.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
1194.t: meree paTeeaa likh dheh sree guopaal ||1||
1194.e: Write the Name of the Dear Lord on my tablet.""||1||

1194.g: ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡਉ ਰੇ ਬਾਬਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ॥
1194.t: nahee chhoddau re baabaa raam naam ||
1194.e: O Baba, I will not forsake the Name of the Lord.

1194.g: ਮੇਰੋ ਅਉਰ ਪੜੑਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1194.t: mero aaur paR(h)n siau nahee kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
1194.e: I will not bother with any other lessons. ||1||Pause||
Sanda and Marka went to the king to complain.
He sent for Prahlaad to come at once.

1194.g: ਤੂ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਕੀ ਛੋਡੁ ਬਾਨਿ ॥
1194.t: too raam kahan kee chhodd baan ||
1194.e: He said to him, ""Stop uttering the Lord's Name.

1194.g: ਤੁਝੁ ਤੁਰਤੁ ਛਡਾਊ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
1194.t: tujh turat chhaddaauoo mero kahio maan ||2||
1194.e: I shall release you at once, if you obey my words.""||2||

1194.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਸਤਾਵਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
1194.t: mo kau kahaa sataavahu baar baar ||
1194.e: Prahlaad answered, ""Why do you annoy me, over and over again?

1194.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਹਾਰ ॥
1194.t: prabh jal thal gir ke'ee pahaar ||
1194.e: God created the water, land, hills and mountains.

1194.g: ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਗਾਰਿ ॥
1194.t: eik raam na chhoddau gureh gaar ||
1194.e: I shall not forsake the One Lord; if I did, I would be going against my Guru.

1194.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਘਾਲਿ ਜਾਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
1194.t: mo kau ghaal jaar bhaavai maar ddaar ||3||
1194.e: You might as well throw me into the fire and kill me.""||3||
The king became angry and drew his sword.
"Show me your protector now!"

1194.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਥੰਭ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
1194.t: prabh tha(n)bh te nikase kai bisathaar ||
1194.e: So God emerged out of the pillar, and assumed a mighty form.
He killed Harnaakhash, tearing him apart with his nails. ||4||
The Supreme Lord God, the Divinity of the divine,
for the sake of His devotee, assumed the form of the man-lion.

1194.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
1194.t: keh kabeer ko lakhai na paar ||
1194.e: Says Kabeer, no one can know the Lord's limits.
He saves His devotees like Prahlaad over and over again. ||5||4||

1194.g: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਮਦਨ ਚੋਰ ॥
1194.t: eis tan man madhe madhan chor ||
1194.e: Within the body and mind are thieves like sexual desire,

1194.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
1194.t: jin giaan ratan hir leen mor ||
1194.e: which has stolen my jewel of spiritual wisdom.
I am a poor orphan, O God; unto whom should I complain?

1194.g: ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਬਿਗੂਤੋ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਆਹਿ ॥੧॥
1194.t: ko ko na bigooto mai ko aaeh ||1||
1194.e: Who has not been ruined by sexual desire? What am I? ||1||

1194.g: ਮਾਧਉ ਦਾਰੁਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1194.t: maadhau dhaarun dhukh sahio na jai ||
1194.e: O Lord, I cannot endure this agonizing pain.

1194.g: ਮੇਰੋ ਚਪਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਹਾ ਬਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1194.t: mero chapal budh siau kahaa basai ||1|| rahaau ||
1194.e: What power does my fickle mind have against it? ||1||Pause||
Sanak, Sanandan, Shiva and Suk Dayv
were born out of Brahma's naval chakra.
The poets and the Yogis with their matted hair
all lived their lives with good behavior. ||2||
You are Unfathomable; I cannot know Your depth.

1194.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਉ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
1194.t: prabh dheenaa naath dhukh kahau kaeh ||
1194.e: O God, Master of the meek, unto whom should I tell my pains?

1194.g: ਮੋਰੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਥਿ ਧੀਰ ॥
1194.t: moro janam maran dhukh aath dheer ||
1194.e: Please rid me of the pains of birth and death, and bless me with peace.
Kabeer utters the Glorious Praises of God, the Ocean of peace. ||3||5||
There is one merchant and five traders.
The twenty-five oxen carry false merchandise.
There are nine poles which hold the ten bags.
The body is tied by the seventy-two ropes. ||1||

1194.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਐਸੇ ਬਨਜ ਸਿਉ ਨਹੀਨ ਕਾਜੁ ॥
1194.t: moh aaise banaj siau naheen kaaj ||
1194.e: I don't care at all about such commerce.

1195.g: ਜਿਹ ਘਟੈ ਮੂਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਬਢੈ ਬਿਆਜੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1195.t: jeh ghaTai mool nit baddai biaaj || rahaau ||
1195.e: It depletes my capital, and the interest charges only increase. ||Pause||

1195.g: ਸਾਤ ਸੂਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਨਜੁ ਕੀਨ ॥
1195.t: saat soot mil banaj keen ||
1195.e: Weaving the seven threads together, they carry on their trade.

1195.g: ਕਰਮ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸੰਗ ਲੀਨ ॥
1195.t: karam bhaavanee sa(n)g leen ||
1195.e: They are led on by the karma of their past actions.

1195.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਜਗਾਤੀ ਕਰਤ ਰਾਰਿ ॥
1195.t: teen jagaatee karat raar ||
1195.e: The three tax-collectors argue with them.

1195.g: ਚਲੋ ਬਨਜਾਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਝਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
1195.t: chalo banajaaraa haath jhaar ||2||
1195.e: The traders depart empty-handed. ||2||

1195.g: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਹਿਰਾਨੀ ਬਨਜੁ ਟੂਟ ॥
1195.t: poo(n)jee hiraanee banaj TooT ||
1195.e: Their capital is exhausted, and their trade is ruined.

1195.g: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਟਾਂਡੋ ਗਇਓ ਫੂਟਿ ॥
1195.t: dheh dhis Taa(n)ddo gio fooT ||
1195.e: The caravan is scattered in the ten directions.

1195.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਜ ॥
1195.t: keh kabeer man sarasee kaaj ||
1195.e: Says Kabeer, O mortal, your tasks will be accomplished,

1195.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਤ ਭਰਮ ਭਾਜ ॥੩॥੬॥
1195.t: sahaj samaano ta bharam bhaaj ||3||6||
1195.e: when you merge in the Celestial Lord; let your doubts run away. ||3||6||

1195.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹਿੰਡੋਲੁ ਘਰੁ ੨
1195.t: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol ghar doojaa
1195.e: Basant Hindol, Second House:

1195.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1195.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1195.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1195.g: ਮਾਤਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
1195.t: maataa jooThee pitaa bhee jooThaa jooThe hee fal laage ||
1195.e: The mother is impure, and the father is impure. The fruit they produce is impure.

1195.g: ਆਵਹਿ ਜੂਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੀ ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
1195.t: aaveh jooThe jaeh bhee jooThe jooThe mareh abhaage ||1||
1195.e: Impure they come, and impure they go. The unfortunate ones die in impurity. ||1||

1195.g: ਕਹੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਠਾਉ ॥
1195.t: kahu pa(n)ddit soochaa kavan Thaau ||
1195.e: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar, which place is uncontaminated?

1195.g: ਜਹਾਂ ਬੈਸਿ ਹਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1195.t: jahaa(n) bais hau bhojan khaau ||1|| rahaau ||
1195.e: Where should I sit to eat my meal? ||1||Pause||

1195.g: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਬੋਲਤ ਜੂਠਾ ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਜੂਠੇ ॥
1195.t: jihabaa jooThee bolat jooThaa karan netr sabh jooThe ||
1195.e: The tongue is impure, and its speech is impure. The eyes and ears are totally impure.

1195.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੇ ਲੂਠੇ ॥੨॥
1195.t: ei(n)dhree kee jooTh utaras naahee braham agan ke looThe ||2||
1195.e: The impurity of the sexual organs does not depart; the Brahmin is burnt by the fire. ||2||

1195.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਭੀ ਜੂਠੀ ਪਾਨੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
1195.t: agan bhee jooThee paanee jooThaa jooThee bais pakaiaa ||
1195.e: The fire is impure, and the water is impure. The place where you sit and cook is impure.

1195.g: ਜੂਠੀ ਕਰਛੀ ਪਰੋਸਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਬੈਠਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1195.t: jooThee karachhee parosan laagaa jooThe hee baiTh khaiaa ||3||
1195.e: Impure is the ladle which serves the food. Impure is the one who sits down to eat it. ||3||

1195.g: ਗੋਬਰੁ ਜੂਠਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਜੂਠਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
1195.t: gobar jooThaa chaukaa jooThaa jooThee dheenee kaaraa ||
1195.e: Impure is the cow dung, and impure is the kitchen square. Impure are the lines that mark it off.

1195.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇਈ ਨਰ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਰੀ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥
1195.t: keh kabeer teiee nar sooche saachee paree bichaaraa ||4||1||7||
1195.e: Says Kabeer, they alone are pure, who have obtained pure understanding. ||4||1||7||

1195.g: ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦ ਜੀ ਘਰੁ ੧
1195.t: raamaana(n)dh jee ghar pehilaa
1195.e: Raamaanand Jee, First House:

1195.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1195.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1195.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1195.g: ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਰੇ ਘਰ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
1195.t: kat jaieeaai re ghar laago ra(n)g ||
1195.e: Where should I go? My home is filled with bliss.

1195.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1195.t: meraa chit na chalai man bhio pa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
1195.e: My consciousness does not go out wandering. My mind has become crippled. ||1||Pause||

1195.g: ਏਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਮਨ ਭਈ ਉਮੰਗ ॥
1195.t: ek dhivas man bhiee uma(n)g ||
1195.e: One day, a desire welled up in my mind.

1195.g: ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਚੋਆ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ॥
1195.t: ghas cha(n)dhan choaa bahu suga(n)dh ||
1195.e: I ground up sandalwood, along with several fragrant oils.

1195.g: ਪੂਜਨ ਚਾਲੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਠਾਇ ॥
1195.t: poojan chaalee braham Thai ||
1195.e: I went to God's place, and worshipped Him there.

1195.g: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
1195.t: so braham bataio gur man hee maeh ||1||
1195.e: That God showed me the Guru, within my own mind. ||1||

1195.g: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਜਲ ਪਖਾਨ ॥
1195.t: jahaa jaieeaai teh jal pakhaan ||
1195.e: Wherever I go, I find water and stones.

1195.g: ਤੂ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
1195.t: too poor rahio hai sabh samaan ||
1195.e: You are totally pervading and permeating in all.

1195.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੋਇ ॥
1195.t: bedh puraan sabh dhekhe joi ||
1195.e: I have searched through all the Vedas and the Puraanas.

1195.g: ਊਹਾਂ ਤਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਈਹਾਂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
1195.t: uoohaa(n) tau jaieeaai jau ieehaa(n) na hoi ||2||
1195.e: I would go there, only if the Lord were not here. ||2||

1195.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤੋਰ ॥
1195.t: satigur mai balihaaree tor ||
1195.e: I am a sacrifice to You, O my True Guru.

1195.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਰ ॥
1195.t: jin sakal bikal bhram kaaTe mor ||
1195.e: You have cut through all my confusion and doubt.

1195.g: ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਮਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
1195.t: raamaana(n)dh suaamee ramat braham ||
1195.e: Raamaanand's Lord and Master is the All-pervading Lord God.

1195.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥੧॥
1195.t: gur kaa sabadh kaaTai koT karam ||3||1||
1195.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad eradicates the karma of millions of past actions. ||3||1||

1195.g: ਬਸੰਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ
1195.t: basa(n)t baanee naamadheau jee kee
1195.e: Basant, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

1195.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1195.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1195.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1195.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਕਟਵੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਭਜੈ ॥
1195.t: saahib sa(n)kaTavai sevak bhajai ||
1195.e: If the servant runs away when his master is in trouble,

1195.g: ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੋਊ ਕੁਲ ਲਜੈ ॥੧॥
1195.t: chira(n)kaal na jeevai dhouoo kul lajai ||1||
1195.e: he will not have a long life, and he brings shame to all his family. ||1||

1195.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਲੋਗੁ ਹਸੈ ॥
1195.t: teree bhagat na chhoddau bhaavai log hasai ||
1195.e: I shall not abandon devotional worship of You, O Lord, even if the people laugh at me.

1195.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਬਸੈਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1195.t: charan kamal mere heeare basai(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
1195.e: The Lord's Lotus Feet abide within my heart. ||1||Pause||

1195.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਧਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਰਨੁ ਮਾਂਡੈ ॥
1195.t: jaise apane dhaneh praanee maran maa(n)ddai ||
1195.e: The mortal will even die for the sake of his wealth;

1195.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛਾਡੈਂ ॥੨॥
1195.t: taise sa(n)t janaa(n) raam naam na chhaaddai(n) ||2||
1195.e: in the same way, the Saints do not forsake the Lord's Name. ||2||

1195.g: ਗੰਗਾ ਗਇਆ ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
1195.t: ga(n)gaa giaa godhaavaree sa(n)saar ke kaamaa ||
1195.e: Pilgrimages to the Ganges, the Gaya and the Godawari are merely worldly affairs.

1196.g: ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
1196.t: naarain suprasa(n)n hoi ta sevak naamaa ||3||1||
1196.e: If the Lord were totally pleased, then He would let Naam Dayv be His servant. ||3||1||
The tidal waves of greed constantly assault me.
My body is drowning, O Lord. ||1||
Please carry me across the world-ocean, O Lord of the Universe.
Carry me across, O Beloved Father. ||1||Pause||

1196.g: ਅਨਿਲ ਬੇੜਾ ਹਉ ਖੇਵਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ॥
1196.t: anil beRaa hau khev na saakau ||
1196.e: I cannot steer my ship in this storm.
I cannot find the other shore, O Beloved Lord. ||2||

1196.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੂ ਮੋ ਕਉ ॥
1196.t: hoh dhiaal satigur mel too mo kau ||
1196.e: Please be merciful, and unite me with the True Guru;
carry me across, O Lord. ||3||

1196.g: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਹਉ ਤਰਿ ਭੀ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
1196.t: naamaa kahai hau tar bhee na jaanau ||
1196.e: Says Naam Dayv, I do not know how to swim.

1196.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਹਿ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
1196.t: mo kau baeh dheh baeh dheh beeThulaa ||4||2||
1196.e: Give me Your Arm, give me Your Arm, O Beloved Lord. ||4||2||

1196.g: ਸਹਜ ਅਵਲਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਮਣੀ ਗਾਡੀ ਚਾਲਤੀ ॥
1196.t: sahaj aval dhooR manee gaaddee chaalatee ||
1196.e: Slowly at first, the body-cart loaded with dust starts to move.
Later, it is driven on by the stick. ||1||
The body moves along like the ball of dung, driven on by the dung-beetle.
The beloved soul goes down to the pool to wash itself clean. ||1||Pause||
The washerman washes, imbued with the Lord's Love.
My mind is imbued with the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||
Prays Naam Dayv, O Lord, You are All-pervading.
Please be kind to Your devotee. ||3||3||
Basant, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
You know nothing.
Seeing your clothes, you are so proud of yourself.
The proud bride shall not find a place with the Lord.
Above your head, the crow of death is cawing. ||1||
Why are you so proud? You are insane.

1196.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਭਾਦਉ ਖੂੰਬਰਾਜੁ ਤੂ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਖਰੀ ਉਤਾਵਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1196.t: jaise bhaadhau khoo(n)baraaj too tis te kharee utaavalee ||1|| rahaau ||
1196.e: Even the mushrooms of summer live longer than you. ||1||Pause||
The deer does not know the secret;
the musk is within its own body, but it searches for it outside.

1196.g: ਅਪ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1196.t: ap tan kaa jo kare beechaar ||
1196.e: Whoever reflects on his own body
- the Messenger of Death does not abuse him. ||2||
The man is so proud of his sons and his wife;
his Lord and Master shall call for his account.
The soul suffers in pain for the actions it has committed.
Afterwards, whom shall you call, ""Dear, Dear.""||3||
If you seek the Support of the Holy,

1196.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਸਭ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
1196.t: tere miTeh paap sabh koT koT ||
1196.e: millions upon millions of your sins shall be totally erased.
Says Ravi Daas, one who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

1196.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
1196.t: tis jaat na janam na jon kaam ||4||1||
1196.e: is not concerned with social class, birth and rebirth. ||4||1||
Basant, Kabeer Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
You walk like a cow.
The hair on your tail is shiny and lustrous. ||1||

1196.g: ਇਸ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੈ ਸੁ ਤੂ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
1196.t: eis ghar meh hai su too ddoo(n)dd khaeh ||
1196.e: Look around, and eat anything in this house.

1196.g: ਅਉਰ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਤੂ ਮਤਿ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1196.t: aaur kis hee ke too mat hee jaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
1196.e: But do not go out to any other. ||1||Pause||
You lick the grinding bowl, and eat the flour.

1196.g: ਚਾਕੀ ਕਾ ਚੀਥਰਾ ਕਹਾਂ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
1196.t: chaakee kaa cheetharaa kahaa(n) lai jaeh ||2||
1196.e: Where have you taken the kitchen rags? ||2||
Your gaze is fixed on the basket in the cupboard.

1196.g: ਮਤੁ ਲਕਰੀ ਸੋਟਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰੈ ਪੀਠਿ ॥੩॥
1196.t: mat lakaree soTaa teree parai peeTh ||3||
1196.e: Watch out - a stick may strike you from behind. ||3||
Says Kabeer, you have over-indulged in your pleasures.
Watch out - someone may throw a brick at you. ||4||1||

1197.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰਗ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
1197.t: raag saarag chaupadhe mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
1197.e: Raag Saarang, Chau-Padhay, First Mehla, First House:

1197.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1197.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
1197.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

1197.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੀ ॥
1197.t: apune Thaakur kee hau cheree ||
1197.e: I am the hand-maiden of my Lord and Master.

1197.g: ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1197.t: charan gahe jagajeevan prabh ke haumai maar niberee ||1|| rahaau ||
1197.e: I have grasped the Feet of God, the Life of the world. He has killed and eradicated my egotism. ||1||Pause||

1197.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
1197.t: pooran param jot paramesar preetam praan hamaare ||
1197.e: He is the Perfect, Supreme Light, the Supreme Lord God, my Beloved, my Breath of Life.

1197.g: ਮੋਹਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਮਝਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
1197.t: mohan moh leeaa man meraa samajhas sabadh beechaare ||1||
1197.e: The Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind; contemplating the Word of the Shabad, I have come to understand. ||1||

1197.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਨ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੀਰ ਸਰੀਰੇ ॥
1197.t: manmukh heen hochhee mat jhooThee man tan peer sareere ||
1197.e: The worthless self-willed manmukh, with false and shallow understanding - his mind and body are held in pain's grip.

1197.g: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੀਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੨॥
1197.t: jab kee raam ra(n)geelai raatee raam japat man dheere ||2||
1197.e: Since I came to be imbued with the Love of my Beautiful Lord, I meditate on the Lord, and my mind is encouraged. ||2||

1197.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਤਬ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
1197.t: haumai chhodd bhiee bairaagan tab saachee surat samaanee ||
1197.e: Abandoning egotism, I have become detached. And now, I absorb true intuitive understanding.

1197.g: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਲੋੁਕਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
1197.t: akul nira(n)jan siau man maaniaa bisaree laaj luokaanee ||3||
1197.e: The mind is pleased and appeased by the Pure, Immaculate Lord; the opinions of other people are irrelevant. ||3||

1197.g: ਭੂਰ ਭਵਿਖ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
1197.t: bhoor bhavikh naahee tum jaise mere preetam praan adhaaraa ||
1197.e: There is no other like You, in the past or in the future, O my Beloved, my Breath of Life, my Support.

1197.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
1197.t: har kai naam ratee sohaagan naanak raam bhataaraa ||4||1||
1197.e: The soul-bride is imbued with the Name of the Lord; O Nanak, the Lord is her Husband. ||4||1||

1197.g: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1197.t: saarag mahalaa pehilaa ||
1197.e: Saarang, First Mehla:

1197.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
1197.t: har bin kiau raheeaai dhukh biaapai ||
1197.e: How can I survive without the Lord? I am suffering in pain.

1197.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਫੀਕੀ ਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1197.t: jihavaa saadh na feekee ras bin bin prabh kaal sa(n)taapai ||1|| rahaau ||
1197.e: My tongue does not taste - all is bland without the Lord's sublime essence. Without God, I suffer and die. ||1||Pause||

1197.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਰਸੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੀ ॥
1197.t: jab lag dharas na parasai preetam tab lag bhookh piaasee ||
1197.e: As long as I do not attain the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, I remain hungry and thirsty.
